instruction:
Write a story about: A fat kitten shrinks magically and enjoys exploring his house in his new small size, but grows back to his normal size the next day.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a fat kitten. He was so big he couldn't fit in his bed. One day he had a magical surprise! He went to sleep and when he woke up, he had shrunk! He was so small he could fit in his bed. He was so happy that he could fit in his bed again. Now he could play in all the tiny places in his house.
The kitten had lots of fun exploring his new small size. He played with his toys and rolled in the grass. He even tried to climb a tree but it was too tall.
One night, the kitten went to sleep in his little bed and he started growing again! He grew back to his normal size by morning. He was so excited about his magical shrinking experience and he loved being able to explore all the little places in his house.
The fat kitten never forgot the magical day he could shrink. He often daydreamed about it and he'd tell all his friends about his exciting adventure.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl asks her mom for a dress, but when her dad brings her one, she learns that he stole it and decides to put it away. She learns that persistence doesn't justify doing something wrong to get what you want.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, a little girl was walking with her mom. Suddenly, the girl said, "Mom, can I have a dress?" Her mom replied, "No, we cannot afford one". But the little girl wouldn't give up, she was persistent.
So a few days later, the little girl went on a trip with her dad. When they returned, the girl ran into the house and found a dress in her room! She was so happy that she shouted, "I got the dress!"
But her mom wasn't happy. She said, "No, you didn't get that dress. Your dad stole it!" The little girl was so sad. She realized that the dress was wrong, so she put it away.
The little girl learned a good lesson that day. No matter how persistent you are, it doesn't mean you should do something wrong to get what you want.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim meets Sue and asks to play with her cloth, but she says no and calls him rude. Tim jumps in a mud puddle and asks Sue to wipe him, but she gets mad and runs away, leaving Tim sad and alone.
With: sad ending
response:
"Hi Sue, can I play with your cloth?" Tim asked.
"No, you are rude!" Sue said.
Tim was sad and walked away. Later, he saw a big mud puddle. He had an idea. He took his sword and jumped in the mud. He got very dirty. Then, he went back to Sue.
"Look, I am dirty! Can you wipe me now?" Tim asked.
Sue was mad. She threw the cloth at Tim and ran away. Tim tried to wipe himself, but he was still dirty. No one wanted to play with him. Tim was sad and alone.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max's owner forgot to put on his fancy leash and Max got hit by a car while chasing a squirrel.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Max's owner forgot to put the fancy leash on Max. Max saw a squirrel and ran after it. Max's owner couldn't catch him because he didn't have the fancy leash on. Max ran into the street and got hit by a car. Max's owner was very sad because Max was hurt and couldn't be fixed. 
Max's owner learned a lesson to always put the fancy leash on Max so he could be safe.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily asks for a cookie in a room where people are working with staffs, and a kind man allows her to have one as long as she doesn't disturb them.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, a little girl named Lily walked into the room. She saw a plate of delicious cookies on the table. She wanted one so badly. Lily said, "Can I have a cookie, please?"
A kind man looked up from his work and said, "Yes, you can have one, but please do not disturb us when we are working."
Lily took a cookie and left the room. She was happy with her delicious cookie and did not disturb the people with their staffs again. They all worked happily ever after.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds a bunny in a pit and hurts it by squeezing it too hard. His mom gets angry and teaches him to be more careful with animals. Timmy learns his lesson and regrets hurting the bunny.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy picked up the bunny and squeezed it too hard. The bunny was hurt and scared. It ran away from Timmy and never came back. Timmy felt sad and regretful. He wished he had been more careful with the bunny.
Later that day, Timmy's mom asked him where the bunny went. Timmy told her what happened and his mom was very angry. She told Timmy that he should never hurt animals and that he should be more careful next time. Timmy felt fearful of his mom's anger.
From that day on, Timmy remembered to be gentle with animals and never hurt them again. But he still felt sad about the bunny he hurt and wished he could make it right.
Summary: Timmy finds a bunny in a pit and hurts it by squeezing it too hard. His mom gets angry and teaches him to be more careful with animals. Timmy learns his lesson and regrets hurting the bunny.

instruction:
Write a story about: A group of friends went on a charming yacht for a ride but got caught in bad weather and the yacht sank. They were rescued but learned a lesson about the dangers of bad weather.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, a group of friends went on the yacht for a ride. They were very happy and sang songs. They counted the waves and saw lots of fish. They had so much fun that they didn't notice the dark clouds. 
Suddenly, the wind started to blow very hard and the waves got very big. The friends were scared and tried to hold on, but the yacht couldn't handle the strong wind. The yacht hit a rock and sank. The friends were very sad and cold. They tried to swim to the shore, but the waves were too big. 
In the end, the friends were rescued by a number of people, but the yacht was lost forever. The friends learned that even a charming yacht can be dangerous in bad weather.

instruction:
Write a story about: Fluffy, a lazy cat, asks his friend Squeaky the mouse for help to get a shiny marble, but they wake up a dog and get trapped. Fluffy uses the marble to distract the dog and escape, learning to appreciate his friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Fluffy decided to ask his friend, a little mouse named Squeaky, for help. Squeaky agreed to help, but warned Fluffy to be quiet and whisper, so they wouldn't wake up the sleeping dog.
As they tiptoed towards the marble, they heard a loud bark. The dog had woken up! Fluffy and Squeaky ran as fast as they could, but the dog was too quick. They were trapped!
Suddenly, Fluffy had an idea. He whispered to Squeaky to give him the marble. Fluffy then rolled the marble towards the dog, distracting him long enough for Fluffy and Squeaky to escape. From that day on, Fluffy learned to appreciate his friends and never took their help for granted.

instruction:
Write a story about: A brave girl tames a wild mess with the help of a friendly stranger.
With: happy ending
response: Once upon a time, there was a wild mess. One day, a brave girl looked at the mess and decided to tidy it up. She grabbed a comb and started to fix her hair. Then, it happened. Her comb got stuck in the wild mess. She quickly began to panic. She pulled and pulled, but the comb wouldn't come out. Suddenly, a friendly voice said "Don't worry, I can help you." She looked up and saw a friendly face. He showed her how to tame the mess. She was able to get her comb out. The wild mess was no more!

instruction:
Write a story about: A gifted season that made people happy was destroyed by a monster despite the efforts of brave people to protect it, leaving everyone sad and longing for its return.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a gifted season. It was very special and it made people so happy. But then something terrible happened.
One day, a monster came and tried to destroy the season. He was huge. He had sharp teeth and he roared and roared. Everyone was so scared.
But then! Some brave people came to fight the monster. They tried to protect the season, but they couldn't. The monster was too strong. He destroyed the season and everything went away.
Everyone was so sad. They missed the beautiful, gifted season. Things were never the same again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A funny figure asks a boy for a hug, but when the boy hugs too tight, the figure breaks into pieces and cannot be fixed.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a figure. The figure was very funny looking. Everyone liked to laugh when they saw the figure. One day, the figure wanted a hug. So the figure asked a small boy to hug it. 
The boy was happy to hug the funny figure. He hugged it tight. Suddenly, the figure started to move. It wobbled back and forth. The boy was scared.
"What's happening?" he asked. 
The figure laughed and said, "I am shaking to make our hug more fun!"
The boy couldn't believe his ears. He hugged the figure even tighter, scared that it would run away. Suddenly the figure broke into hundreds of pieces.
"Oh no!" the figure shouted.
The boy had broken the funny figure. He was very sad. The figure couldn't be fixed. Unfortunately, the bad ending meant the boy and the figure never hugged again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl saves everyone on a subway by shouting for them to pay attention to the warnings, and from then on, everyone listens and stays safe.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a modest subway. It rumbled down the tracks each day, taking people to their destinations. But the subway had a problem. No one was paying attention to the warnings. People would ignore the signs, the flags, and everything else.
One day, a 3 year old child stepped onto the subway. She could see that people were ignoring the warnings. Thinking quickly, the girl shouted as loud as she could "Please stop ignoring the warnings and be safe!" Everyone on the subway stopped and looked at her.
The little girl smiled. She knew she had made a difference and saved everyone from danger. From that day onward, no one ever ignored the warnings again. Everyone knew they could look to the modest subway, and that 3 year old girl, for safety.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny finds a fragile glass jar with a butterfly inside, but accidentally breaks it and learns the importance of being careful with delicate things.
With: sad ending
response:
"Wow! What is that?" Benny asked himself. 
He dug and dug until he finally found a fragile glass jar. Inside the jar was a beautiful butterfly. Benny was so happy! He held the jar carefully and showed it to his friends. 
But then, Benny accidentally dropped the jar and it broke into a million pieces. The butterfly flew away, and Benny felt very sad. 
"I'm sorry butterfly," Benny said. "I didn't mean to break your home." 
Benny learned that sometimes things can be delicate and we need to be careful when we hold them.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sarah finds a box in the garden and discovers a shiny yellow truck inside, which she gets to keep.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sarah. She found a nice box in the garden. It was hot from the sun. Sarah was very curious.
"What's inside the box?" Sarah asked her mom. 
Her Mom smiled. "Let's have a look. You can examine the box," she said.
Sarah carefully opened the box. Inside the box was a toy. It was a shiny, yellow truck. Sarah was so excited!
"Mommy, I like this toy. Can I keep it?" Sarah asked.
"Yes, you can keep it," said Mom.
Sarah smiled and hugged the box tight. She was so happy. 
The End.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves playing basketball with his friends until a big dog scares them away, leaving his basketball behind, and he is never able to retrieve it.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Timmy and his friends went to the park to play basketball. They were having so much fun until a big dog came running towards them. Timmy's friend said, "Be alert, guys! The dog looks angry!" They all ran away, but Timmy's basketball got left behind.
Timmy was sad because he loved that basketball. He went back to the park to get it, but the dog was still there. The dog growled at Timmy and scared him. Timmy ran away and never got his basketball back.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily enters a fruit-eating contest to become famous for her love of fruit, but ends up getting sick and learning a valuable lesson about taking care of her body.
With: sad ending
response:
Her parents warned her that eating too much fruit could make her sick, but Lily didn't listen. She ate and ate until she couldn't eat anymore. Suddenly, she felt very sick and started to vomit. Her parents tried to prevent her from eating too much, but it was too late.
Lily had to go to the hospital and she never became famous for her love of fruit. Instead, she learned a valuable lesson about listening to her parents and taking care of her body. The end.
Summary: Lily enters a fruit-eating contest to become famous for her love of fruit, but ends up getting sick and learning a valuable lesson about taking care of her body.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mary is a kind little girl who loves to slide down the big slide with her friends and always makes sure everyone has a turn.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a kind little girl named Mary. Mary loved to go outside and slide down the big slide. Every day she would pull the slide frame out of the shed and it made her giggle with delight.
Mary would fly down the slide, faster than a bird in the sky. She would squeal in delight as the cold metal frame tickled her tummy.
When she got to the bottom, she would stand up and run back up the slide to do it all again. She would take turns with her friends Maurice and Ashley; they would slide down together and count to three!
After a while, Mary’s mom would call them in for lunch. Mary would be sad that she had to leave, but she was happy to have such fun friends to play with. She was so kind and always made sure everyone had a turn on the slide.
That's why Mary was the best slide-slider in town!

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a can of tuna that turns out to be a magic can that grants her one wish, which she uses to get a new toy.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily was playing with the can of tuna when something unexpected happened. The can of tuna started to talk! It said, "Hello, Lily! I am not an ordinary can of tuna. I am a magic can of tuna."
Lily was surprised and did not understand what was happening. The magic can of tuna told her that it could grant her one wish. Lily thought for a moment and wished for a new toy to play with. The magic can of tuna made her wish come true, and a beautiful new toy appeared. From that day on, Lily knew that even ordinary things could be very special.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves cookies but throws a tantrum when his mom won't give him more, causing him to be taken away from his mom and learn the importance of controlling his anger.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy ate all the cookies and wanted more, but his mom said no. Timmy got angry and threw a tantrum. He started to break things and hurt his mom. Timmy's mom was sad and had to call the police to help her.
In the end, Timmy was taken away from his mom and sent to live with strangers. Timmy missed his mom and wished he had not thrown a tantrum. He learned that it is important to control his anger and be kind to others.
Summary: Timmy loves cookies but throws a tantrum when his mom won't give him more, causing him to be taken away from his mom and learn the importance of controlling his anger.

instruction:
Write a story about: Ted feels troubled in the park until a kind old lady appears and plays a game of catch with him, teaching him how to play and cheering him on when he wins.
With: happy ending
response:
One day Ted was feeling very troubled. He was in the park and threw a rubber ball onto the ground. He wanted to win but couldn't find anyone to play with him.
Suddenly a kind old lady appeared and smiled at him. She bent down and picked up the rubber ball and asked Ted to join her. They played together with the rubber ball and Ted soon started to feel happy.
The old lady was a very good player and Ted found it difficult to keep up. But after a while, Ted was able to catch the ball and he won the game.
The old lady cheered for Ted and gave him a big hug. Ted was so happy that he had won the game and he was no longer troubled. He thanked the old lady for teaching him how to play.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily rubs her head on a soft pillow and her mom kisses it every night, but when she tries to rub her head on a big dog, she gets bitten and has to go to the hospital.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily liked to rub her head on the soft pillow. It made her feel good and sleepy. She had a big head with many curls. Her mom said her head was attractive and kissed it every night.
One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a big dog with a shiny coat. She wanted to rub her head on the dog. She thought the dog would like it too. She ran to the dog and smiled.
But the dog did not like it. The dog barked and bit Lily's head. It hurt a lot and made her bleed. Her mom screamed and ran to help her. She took her to the hospital. Lily cried and wished she never rubbed her head on the dog.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily discovers that fresh shrimp from the beach tastes better than expensive shrimp from a restaurant.
With: happy ending
response: Later, Lily and her family went for a walk on the beach. They saw a man fishing and he gave them some fresh shrimp. Lily was so happy and they tasted delicious! Lily thought they seemed even better than the expensive shrimp at the restaurant. From then on, Lily always looked for fresh shrimp on the beach instead of buying the expensive ones at the restaurant.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves to help her mommy in the kitchen and is asked to pour milk into her cereal bowl. When an emergency occurs, Lily stays inside while her mommy checks it out and is relieved when her mommy returns safely.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, they heard a loud noise outside. It was an emergency! Lily's mommy told her to stay inside while she went to see what was happening. Lily was scared, but she knew her mommy would keep her safe.
After a few minutes, her mommy came back inside and told her everything was fine. Lily was relieved and gave her mommy a big hug. She was happy to be with her mommy and help her pour the milk again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loved potatoes and introduced them to her friends, who also loved them. However, when Lily's mom bought bad potatoes, Lily got sick and had to stay in the hospital, making her friends regret trying them.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Lily's mom bought some potatoes from the store. But when Lily took a bite, she realized that they tasted funny. She told her mom, "Mom, these potatoes don't taste good." But her mom said, "It's okay, just eat them." So Lily ate them anyway.
Later that day, Lily started feeling sick. She told her mom, "Mom, I don't feel good." Her mom took her to the doctor and they found out that the potatoes were bad. Lily got very sick and had to stay in the hospital for a long time. Her friends felt very sad and wished they never tried the potatoes.

instruction:
Write a story about: A wealthy duck found a shiny button and loved to play with it in the pond, but a mean cat took it away, leaving the duck sad and unable to enjoy anything else in the pond.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, a mean cat came to the pond. The cat saw the wealthy duck playing with the button and wanted it for himself. The cat snatched the button from the duck and ran away. The duck was very sad and didn't want to play anymore. 
From that day on, the duck never played in the pond again. The cat had taken away the duck's favorite toy and the duck was too sad to enjoy anything else. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A farmer's hoe, a useful tool for harvesting crops, was stolen by a thief and despite his efforts, the farmer was not able to get it back.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a farmer who worked hard to harvest his crops. He used a very useful tool to help him. The tool was a hoe and he recommended it to everyone.
One day, the farmer went out to harvest his crop and he noticed something strange. His hoe was gone! He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it. He was very sad.
The farmer asked his neighbour if they had seen it, but they didn't know. Suddenly, the neighbour noticed a thief running away with the hoe. The thief had taken his hoe!
The farmer was very sad, but he was determined to get his hoe back. He ran after the thief, but the thief was too fast. The farmer was too slow and soon the thief had disappeared.
The farmer never got his hoe back and he had to start from scratch finding a new tool that was just as useful. He was very sad and he warned others not to leave their tools alone.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily ate too many peanuts and got sick, learning to only eat a few at a time.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily decided to eat the peanut and it tasted really good. She ate another and another until she had eaten too many. Suddenly, she started to feel sick and her tummy hurt. Her mommy took her to the hospital, but it was too late. Lily had eaten too many peanuts and became very sick. 
From that day on, Lily knew that she should only eat a few peanuts at a time. She was sad that she had to learn this lesson the hard way. The end.
Summary: Lily ate too many peanuts and got sick, learning to only eat a few at a time.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim explores a hidden path in the park and meets Twisty, a tree with magic powers. Twisty twists Tim's game so he can win every time, but Tim realizes winning all the time isn't fun and asks Twisty to change the game back to normal.
With: happy ending
response:
As Tim walked, he saw a twisty tree. He heard a voice from the tree. "Hello, who are you?" said the voice. Tim was scared but answered, "I am Tim, the player. Who are you?" The voice said, "I am Twisty, the twisty tree."
Twisty told Tim that he had a magic power. He could twist anything he wanted. Tim asked if Twisty could twist his game so he would win. Twisty agreed and twisted the game. When Tim played with his friends, he won every time. But soon, his friends didn't want to play with him anymore. Tim learned that winning all the time wasn't fun. He went back to Twisty and asked him to twist the game back to normal. Twisty did, and Tim played happily with his friends again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A cheerful hero helps a sad little boy find his missing toy and promises to buy him a new one, making him happy again.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who was very cheerful. She didn't worry very much. She was always so joyful and happy.
One day, while the hero was playing in the park, she met a little boy who was very sad. He looked like he was worried about something. She asked him what was wrong, and he said he was missing his toy. 
The hero was filled with kindness, so she decided to help the little boy find his toy. She looked everywhere with him, but they still could not find it.
The hero told the little boy not to worry--she said she would buy him a new toy. The little boy was so happy, and he thanked the hero with a big hug. 
The two were so happy they ran around the park together, laughing and playing. The little boy had forgotten all about his worries. The hero had made him cheerful again!

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy named Sam likes to play with frogs in a lake until a bully scares him and throws him into a cave.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Sam, a little boy, was walking along the beach. He saw a pretty little lake, with some frogs swimming in it. He waved to the frogs and they waved back.
Sam liked playing with the frogs and they liked playing with him too. Sam liked to take his name tag to the lake and show the frogs his name.
But one day, something bad happened. A big, mean bully saw Sam in the lake, playing with the frogs, and shouted his name. Sam was so scared that he tried to run away.
But it was too late. The bully caught up with Sam and shouted, "You're Mine!" Sam was so scared he couldn't move. The bully grabbed Sam and squeezed him so tightly that Sam couldn't breathe. The bully then threw Sam in a big, dark cave with no way out. 
Sam was never seen again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A squirrel finds a big nut but can't open it, so it seeks help from a friend who is gifted at opening nuts and discovers a delicious treat inside.
With: happy ending
response:
But when the squirrel tried to open the nut, it wouldn't budge. The squirrel tried and tried, but the nut wouldn't open. The squirrel was so sad. 
Then, the squirrel remembered a friend who was gifted at opening nuts. The squirrel went to find the friend and asked for help. The friend came and opened the nut with ease! Inside the nut was a delicious treat. The squirrel was so happy and grateful to the gifted friend. From that day on, the squirrel knew who to go to when it needed help opening nuts.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy goes to school without studying for his quiz and gets his phone taken away by his rude teacher during the quiz, leading to a bad grade. He learns the importance of studying and being respectful in class.
With: sad ending
response:
During the quiz, Timmy's phone started to ring. It was his mom calling. The teacher was very rude and took Timmy's phone away. Timmy felt embarrassed and sad.
After the quiz, Timmy found out that he got a bad grade. He wished he had studied and not let his phone ring. Timmy learned that it's important to study and not be rude in class.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy gets a bad sunburn after playing outside on a hot day and has to stay in bed for many days until he feels better.
With: sad ending
response:
After a while, Timmy realized he was thirsty. He looked around but there was no water fountain in sight. He decided to go home to get a drink. As he walked home, he felt the heat getting stronger and stronger. He started to feel very tired and his head hurt.
Finally, Timmy arrived home and drank some water. But it was too late. He had gotten a bad sunburn and felt sick. His parents took him to the hospital but the doctors couldn't help him. Timmy had to stay in bed for many days until he felt better. From then on, he always put on sunscreen and drank lots of water when playing outside.
Summary: Timmy gets a bad sunburn after playing outside on a hot day and has to stay in bed for many days until he feels better.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her mommy get into a car accident with a big truck, but her mommy reassures her that they will be okay.
With: sad ending
response:
Her mommy said, "Yes, it is. That's why it's important to be careful around big trucks."
As they continued driving, they saw the same truck again. This time, it was driving very fast. "I feel scared," said Lily.
"Don't worry," said her mommy. "We'll be safe."
But then, the truck hit their car. Lily and her mommy were hurt and the driver of the truck didn't stop to help. Lily felt sad and scared, but her mommy held her hand and said, "It's okay. We'll be okay."

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny finds a diamond in a root and shows it to his friends, but a sly fox tricks him and steals the diamond, leaving Benny heartbroken.
With: sad ending
response:
Benny was surprised when he saw a shiny diamond hidden inside the root. He was so happy and excited that he ran to show his friends. Benny's friends were happy for him, but one of them, a sly fox, saw the diamond and became jealous.
The fox told Benny that he knew of a place where he could keep the diamond safe. Benny trusted the fox because he thought he was reliable. But the fox was not reliable at all. He took the diamond and ran away, leaving Benny heartbroken.
The moral of the story is to be careful who you trust, and that sometimes the things that surprise us can end up causing us great sadness.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy with a loud voice and big muscle goes around his neighborhood showing off his muscle, but when no one wants to see it, he gets angry and uses his muscle to smash windows, causing damage and making everyone sad. He is then told he can never come back.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little boy with a big voice. He was always making loud noises and singing. He was very proud of his muscle too.
One day the boy decided to introduce his muscle to everyone. He went from house to house shouting 'Come see my muscle!'
Everyone was scared. They didn't want to come out and see his muscle. The boy shouted louder and louder but no one wanted to see it.
Finally, the boy got angry. He used his muscle to smash all the windows in the neighbourhood. He felt happy but everyone around him was very sad. His loud muscle had caused lots of damage.
The people were very angry and told him he could never come back.The boy never got to show off his muscle again and he was sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds a pretty blue stick, plays with it all day, but accidentally breaks it and feels sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy's mommy was very happy to see the stick and thanked him for finding it. Timmy felt proud and happy. He played with the stick all day long, pretending it was a sword and he was a brave knight.
But then, something bad happened. Timmy accidentally broke the stick while playing. He felt very sad and cried. His mommy hugged him and told him it was okay, but Timmy still felt bad. He wished he could find another pretty blue stick, but he never did.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily accidentally breaks her mommy's favorite ornament and asks for forgiveness, which is granted. Later, she forgives her friend Tommy for being mean and teaches him how to share.
With: happy ending
response: Later that day, Lily went to play with her friend Tommy. Tommy didn't know how to share his toys and was being mean to Lily. Lily didn't understand why Tommy was being so mean. She thought he was just ignorant and didn't know how to play nicely. She forgave him and taught him how to share. They had a fun time playing together after that. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim refuses to clean his room despite his mother's constant reminders, but when a spider makes a home in his junk, he realizes the consequences of his actions and cleans up his room.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Tim's friend, Sam, came over to play. They played with Tim's toys and had a lot of fun. But then, Sam saw a big spider on the junk. Sam said, "Tim, we need to tell your mom about the spider!" Tim did not want to tell his mom because he knew she would make him clean his room.
Later, Tim's mom found out about the spider. She was very sad and said, "Tim, I told you to clean your room. Now, the spider has made a home in your junk." Tim felt bad. He knew he should have cleaned his room. Now, the spider had to go, and Tim had to clean up all his junk.
Summary: Tim refuses to clean his room despite his mother's constant reminders, but when a spider makes a home in his junk, he realizes the consequences of his actions and cleans up his room.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim learns how to use the toilet and feels proud of becoming a big boy.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Tim's mom said, "Tim, it's time to load your toys in the box and go to the toilet." Tim put his toys in the box and went to the bathroom. He was a little scared, but he knew it was important to learn.
In the bathroom, Tim talked to his toy bear. "Bear, I am going to use the toilet like a big boy," he said. The bear smiled and said, "You can do it, Tim!" Tim used the toilet and felt very proud. From that day on, Tim knew he was growing up.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Sue falls into a stream while playing near it and gets scared.
With: sad ending
response:
Sue wanted to play near the stream. She walked closer and closer. She saw pretty fish and fun stones. Sue was very happy.
But then, Sue walked too close to the stream. She fell in the water. The water was cold and fast. Sue was scared and cried. The end.

She hugged her parents, and showed them the ruler. Everyone was happy. Her mom said, "This is the point.It opened the door." And they all laughed.
The little girl was so happy she had figured out the point. She knew she could always rely on her smart ideas.
Summary: A little girl figures out how to open a locked door using a ruler, and is happy to have solved the problem.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mark the cat tries to climb a tree to play with a bird, but can't reach the first branch. A dog tries to help him, but they both end up getting hurt.
With: sad ending
response:

A dog came by and saw Mark. The dog said, "Why are you jumping, Mark?" Mark told the dog about the bird and the tree. The dog wanted to help Mark. They tried to climb the tree together, but they still could not reach the branch.
Then, the curious cat had an idea. He asked the dog to stand on his back. Mark climbed on the dog's back and jumped. He reached the branch! But as he climbed higher, the branch broke. Mark and the dog fell down and got hurt. They were both very sad and went home.

instruction:

instruction:

As the day went on, the sun started to set and the bird knew it was time to go back to its nest. The bird felt tired but happy after a long day of flying. It went to sleep dreaming of all the new things it would see and do tomorrow.

instruction:

instruction:

response:
Tim climbed the tree and picked some apples. He put them in a bag and took them home. He showed his mom the apples with a big smile. His mom said, "Good job, Tim! But we must eat them soon or they will rot."
After a few days, Tim forgot about the apples. He played with his toys and had fun. Then, he remembered the apples and went to look at them. He saw that the apples had become brown and yucky. They had started to rot.
Tim felt sad because he couldn't eat the apples anymore. His mom told him, "Next time, remember to eat the apples before they rot." Tim learned his lesson and promised to eat the apples sooner next time. But for now, he couldn't enjoy the tasty apples he picked.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves eating celery sticks but gets sick after washing her hands in a dirty river while playing hide-and-seek with her friend.

Billy said, "Don't worry, I know a reliable place to wash your hands." They went to the nearby river and Lily washed her hands. But after playing, Lily got sick from the dirty water. Tom made the event and invited his friends. They played with toys and had lots of fun. But then, a big rain cloud came. The rain started to fall very hard. Tom and his friends had to go inside.

instruction:

response:

The squirrel looked at the novel and said, "Oh no! This novel can make time delay! We need to hide it." Tim and the squirrel hid the novel in a secret place under the tree. They promised to keep the novel safe, so no one could use it to delay time. From that day, Tim and the squirrel became best friends and had many fun adventures together.
Summary: Tim finds a novel under a tall tree in a park and starts reading it. A squirrel tells him the novel can delay time, so they hide it and become best friends.

She remembered what her tutor said and realized that the sky must have been striking together to make such a pretty rainbow. From then on, Lily didn't mind her tutor so much because she taught her something new.

The queen was determined to become popular. She decided to try something that nobody had ever done before. She started to give out candy to everyone. Soon, the people stopped paying attention to the other popular people, and began to flock to the queen.
The queen became even more popular than the people she had given candy to. Everyone adored her. But the queen was upset. The people were becoming greedy, wanting more and more candy from her. She couldn't keep up with their demands.
Finally, she couldn't take it anymore and made an unpopular decision. She declared that no more candy would be given out. This made people very angry. They started to shout and throw things at the queen. The queen felt sad and alone. She had become unpopular, just like before.

The potato thanked him for the help. He said, "Thank you, Mr. Frog! You are so kind and nice. Now I can run and play again!" The friendly frog smiled and said, "I'm so happy to help, little potato! See you later!" The frog hopped away and the potato watched him go with a smile. And they all lived happily ever after.

They hopped back together and when they arrived, the little frog thanked her again. The smart rabbit smiled, glad that she had helped. They said goodbye and she hopped off to enjoy the rest of her day.

The flea decided to try talking to the dragon. He flew up to the dragon and began to talk. But the dragon didn’t want to listen. He shouted at the flea in a very harsh voice and flew away.

In the end, the church was safe, and the people were happy. They had saved their church from the fire. The bitter wind stopped blowing, and the town was warm again. The people went back to the church to sing songs and be happy together. And they all lived happily ever after.

But something bad happened. The potion was not magic, it was poison! The hunter fell down and couldn't move. The rabbit ran away and the man who sold the potion took all the hunter's money. 
The hunter never caught the rabbit and he never came back home. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A curious lion discovers a car wash and starts using soap and water to clean himself, enjoying the experience and returning often.

response:

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy ignores his dad's warning and drives his new motorcycle too fast, causing it to overheat and break down. He regrets not listening to his dad.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy was so excited to take his new motorcycle for a ride. He said, "I'm gonna zoom all around town on my motorcycle!" His dad said, "Be careful Timmy, a motorcycle is fast and can be dangerous if you're not careful."
Timmy ignored his dad and started the engine. He was so proud of his new motorcycle, it was orange and shiny! As he zoomed around town, his friends watched in awe. He wanted to show off so he drove even faster. 
But soon Timmy noticed a spicy smell in the air. His engine was too hot! The motorcycle slowed down and then stopped completely. Timmy was really sad but luckily his dad was there to help. It was too late though, the motorcycle was broken. 
Timmy cried and said, "I wish I had listened to daddy. Now I can't zoom anymore."

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl sends her grandma a bottle of clean perfume while she is baking a cake, and the grandma is grateful for the thoughtful gift.
With: happy ending
response:
Grandma was in the kitchen baking a cake. She sang a song while she mixed the ingredients and she smiled when the scent of the cake filled the air.
But then the doorbell rang. Grandma opened the door and saw a smiling little girl holding a big box.
"Hello dear, what do you have there?" asked Grandma. 
"I sent you a present!" said the girl.
Grandma opened the box and smiled. Inside was a big bottle of clean perfume that smelled like roses.
"Thank you, sweetheart!" said Grandma, giving the girl a hug. "I will always remember your gift".
The little girl smiled and waved goodbye as she skipped away. Grandma closed the door and went back to baking, but this time with the sweet smell of a special present - clean perfume from her special friend!

instruction:
Write a story about: Ben receives a new game called the Lucky Game from his parents, stores it away, and later plays it with his dad, winning the game and feeling lucky.
With: happy ending

Dad was busy but he said he was very lucky to have such a great game. He said to store it away so it would not get damaged. So Ben stored the game away nicely in his room.
Later that night, Ben and his dad played the Lucky Game. It was lots of fun! Ben was so lucky to have such a great game. Dad won the game, but that didn't matter. They played again and Ben was even luckier this time! He won!
Ben was so happy, he laughed and jumped around the room. He was lucky to have such a fun game.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little mouse named Timmy is scared to explore a dark hole, but with the help of his wise friend Hootie, he learns not to be scared of the dark or things he doesn't understand.

response:

Hootie explained to Timmy that sometimes things that look scary aren't really scary at all. Hootie also showed Timmy a pattern of stars in the sky, telling him that everything in the world has a pattern. 
Timmy learned that he shouldn't be scared of the dark or things that he doesn't understand. From that day on, Timmy explored the world with bravery and curiosity, and he always remembered Hootie's wise words.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the beach with her mommy and plays a game to see who can hold the most salt, but gets scared by a crab. Her mommy reassures her and they build a sandcastle together.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mommy said, "Let's play a game. Who can hold the most salt in their hand?"
Lily was excited to play. She picked up some salt and put it in her hand. She held it tight and showed her mommy. "Look, I'm holding lots of salt!" she said.
Suddenly, a crab came out of the sand and scared Lily. She dropped the salt and ran to her mommy. "Mommy, I'm scared!" she said.
"It's okay, Lily. You're very brave. Let's go build a sandcastle instead," her mommy said.
Lily smiled and they built a big sandcastle together. She felt happy and brave again.

instruction:

response:
Mommy checked the tank and saw that there was a leak. She said, "Oh no! We need to fix the leak so Goldie can stay in his tank." Daddy came to fix the leak, but it was too slow. The water kept disappearing until Goldie was left with only a little bit of water.
Lily said to Goldie, "Don't worry, Goldie. We'll get you more water soon." But before they could get more water, Goldie disappeared. Lily was very sad and cried a lot. She missed her little fish friend. From that day on, Lily always made sure to check Goldie's tank for leaks and to keep his water full.

instruction:

response:

They sat together and watched the lightning. Suddenly, a big bolt of lightning struck the old man's house. The house caught fire and the old man couldn't escape.
The little girl cried and cried. She knew she should have yielded to the old man's warning about the lightning. Now, she was all alone without her friend.

instruction:

With: sad ending
response:
One day, Sarah was excited to go on a ride with her parents. She found her hat and looked in the mirror to make sure she looked awesome. Sarah jumped in the car with her parents and off they went.
On the ride, Sarah noticed that her dad was looking at a calendar. She asked him what he was looking at, and her dad replied "I'm looking at this calendar. It's very fragile." Sarah thought the calendar was beautiful and asked if she could see it. "No," her dad said. 
But Sarah was persistent, so her dad eventually gave in and handed the calendar to her. As soon as she touched it, the calendar broke into pieces!
"Oh no! What did you do?!" her dad yelled. He looked very angry. Sarah was scared and felt terrible. She had ruined the fragile calendar and knew she was in big trouble.

One day the other cars got tired of his honking. They all begged him to quit.
The stubborn little car refused to quit. He was having too much fun!
Finally, the other cars had had enough. They joined together and surrounded the stubborn little car.
"Please quit," they all asked again.
But the stubborn little car wouldn't budge. He honked his horn and drove away.
The other cars could do nothing but watch him go. They laughed and waved goodbye to the stubborn little car. 
And they all lived happily ever after. The end.

instruction:

But then, the power went out and it became very dark. Lily was scared and started to cry. Her mommy tried to comfort her, but they couldn't bake cookies anymore. Lily was sad because she really wanted to bake cookies.
In the end, the storm passed and the power came back on. But they didn't have enough time to bake cookies anymore. Lily learned that sometimes things don't go as planned, but it's okay to try again another day.
Summary: Lily and her mommy wanted to bake cookies but a storm caused the power to go out, making it impossible to bake. Lily learned that sometimes things don't go as planned, but it's okay to try again another day.

Mittens thought for a moment and then agreed. Timmy led Mittens to the cheese, but as soon as Mittens took a bite, he fell over and started to shake. The cheese was old and moldy. Timmy felt sad that he couldn't help Mittens and ran away to find some fresh cheese.

Lily and Tom are scared. They hug their moms. The dog jumps on the blanket. He takes Lily's cheese sandwich. He eats it fast. Lily cries. She is sad.
The dog wants more. He takes Tom's ham sandwich. He eats it fast. Tom cries. He is mad.

The wind started to howl and the rain pounded against the windows. Timmy and his mom cuddled up on the couch and watched the storm. Suddenly, there was a loud crash and the power went out. Timmy was scared and asked, "What happened?" His mom said, "A tree fell on our house." 
Timmy and his mom were okay, but their house was damaged. They had to move out and find a new place to live. Timmy was sad to leave his old home, but he knew he could still jump and play outside in their new home.

instruction:

Suddenly, a storm came and destroyed Jack's field. Jack was sad and his friend tried to comfort him. "Don't worry, Jack. You can always plant again next season."

instruction:

His friend was confused. "What do you mean, fake fish?" he asked.
"It was a fish that wasn't real," the fisherman explained. "It was made of plastic or something. I don't know how it got in the river."
The next day, the fisherman went back to the river to catch real fish. But he couldn't find any. He looked and looked, but there were no fish. He realized that the fake fish had scared all the real fish away. He was sad and went home empty-handed.
Summary: A fisherman tries to catch a fake fish in the river, mistaking it for a real one. He later realizes that the fake fish scared away all the real fish, leaving him empty-handed.

instruction:

John said to Jane, “Let’s take some of the food, okay?” Jane was very happy and she agreed. So, they started to remove some of the food from the pile. 
Suddenly, a big, mean monster appeared from behind the pile. He growled in a very scary way. He said, “It’s my food! All of it! You cannot remove it!” 
John and Jane were very scared. They ran away as fast as they could. The monster was very angry and he followed them. John and Jane were too scared to even look back.
In the end, the monster was able to catch them and took all the food back. They never saw each other again. The end.

instruction:

Ben thought that was a great idea and he rushed over to the box and opened it up. Inside was a lovely pink toy elephant. They both smiled and hugged each other.
Daisy said, “Let’s play a game! We can split the elephant into two pieces.”
Ben thought this was a great idea and he carefully split the plastic elephant into two pieces. Both Ben and Daisy squealed with delight and hugged the two halves of the elephant. 
They played with the elephant for hours. Ben and Daisy had a lovely time together, playing and laughing with the elephant. When it was time to go, they said goodbye and both hugged the plastic elephant goodbye. 
And they all lived happily ever after.

The days passed, but soon it was time for Thomas to come home. Grace smiled when she saw him. They talked and talked, and worked out how to make their marriage happy again. 
The marriage was no longer troubled. Thomas and Grace were happy and together again.

The driver got back in the truck and drove away, never to be seen again. Jim was left on the ground, dead. His bicycle was there too, with its pedals still spinning. Now, no one can ever ride it again.
