response:
"Hello, snake," Tim said. "Do you want to be my friend?" The snake looked at Tim and said, "Yes, I want to be your friend, but I am not a snake. I am a magic worm."
Tim was very surprised. "Wow! A magic worm? What can you do?" he asked. The magic worm smiled and said, "I can change colors. Watch!" And just like that, the magic worm turned from green to red, then blue, and then yellow.
Tim and the magic worm became best friends. They played and had fun all day. And that is how Tim found a magic friend in the deep grass.
Summary: Tim finds a magic worm in the deep grass, who can change colors, and they become best friends.

instruction:

Lily's mom heard her crying and came to help. She tried to pull Lily out of the creek, but the water was too strong. Sadly, Lily drowned in the creek. Her mom was very sad and missed her sweet little girl.

The adult was very angry, so Therese returned the creature. Marcus and Therese were sad, but they had to obey the man. After the man took the animal, he left the park. Marcus and Therese never saw the light creature again.

Billy rolled and rolled until he saw a big hill. He thought, "I can roll down this hill very fast!" So, he rolled up the hill and then rolled down very fast. But at the bottom of the hill, there was a big hole. Billy rolled right into the hole and couldn't get out. He was stuck, and he felt sad.

instruction:

instruction:

response:

She carefully moved closer and closer, until the flame began to burn her. She jumped away, scared of the flame. 
Other people nearby heard her crying and came to help. They warned her to never mention the flame again. She shook her head but never fully listened to them.

The little girl learned an important lesson that day, never to ignore what other people tell you. It's better to be safe than sorry.
Summary: A curious girl gets burned by a flame in the forest and learns the lesson to listen to warnings.

instruction:

From that day on, the little birdie sang quietly and only when she felt safe. She missed singing loudly and bringing peace to the forest, but she knew she had to be careful. She never forgot the lesson she learned and always watched out for danger.

instruction:
Write a story about: A 3-year-old boy successfully ties a knot with a fake peanut and feels proud of his accomplishment.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was only 3 years old. His mommy gave him a special peanut to tie. The little boy quickly tied a big knot with the peanut, but it came undone. He looked around for something else to tie, but there was nothing.
Suddenly, the little boy noticed a fake peanut on the ground. He picked it up and tried to tie the knot again. This time, it stayed tied! He smiled in triumph, happy with his work. 
The little boy was so proud that he ran to show his mommy. When he showed it to her, he boasted, ‘Look mommy! I tied it!’
His mommy smiled and praised him, saying ‘Good job! You are so clever!’ The little boy felt so proud that he ran off to show all of his friends. The little boy had successfully tied a peanut, even though it was fake!

instruction:
Write a story about: A gray bunny overcomes a challenge to get a carrot and later helps his friend retrieve a balloon stuck in a tree.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a gray bunny. He hopped around in the garden, looking for something to eat. He spotted a juicy carrot, but it was just out of reach. He hopped closer and reached out with his paws, but he just couldn't get it. Then he saw a string. He pulled at it, and the carrot suddenly was in front of him! He grabbed it with his mouth and hopped off, feeling satisfied.
Later he joined his gray squirrel friend. They saw a gray balloon, but it was stuck in a tree. The bunny had an idea. He slowly crawled up the tree and tugged on the string. The balloon slowly came down, and the bunny grabbed it. The squirell was so excited, he jumped around with joy. They tugged the balloon between them until they reached the garden. They let go and watched the balloon float away in the sky.
Summary: A gray bunny overcomes a challenge to get a carrot and later helps his friend retrieve a balloon stuck in a tree.

instruction:
Write a story about: A tiny mouse helps a large bear by marking it with a special weight so that the bear can be found more easily.
With: happy ending
response:
The bear was large and heavy. It was so big that no one could mark it. One day, a tiny mouse came along and wanted to help. He was so small that he could easily mark the bear.
The mouse found a special weight that was just the right size. He put the weight on the big bear and then marked it with a pencil. The mouse was so proud of himself!
The bear was happy, too. After being marked with the special weight, he knew that he could be found more easily. Now, instead of being lost all the time, he could be found wherever he went!

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim is scared of the laundry room and encounters a scary monster while helping his mom with the laundry, causing him to never want to help with laundry again.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, while Tim was putting the clothes in the washing machine, he heard a loud sound. It was a big, scary monster! The monster was mad because Tim was in his room. The monster did not like people in his room. Tim was very scared.
Tim tried to run away from the monster, but the monster chased him. The monster was big and loud, just like the washing machine. Tim could not hide from the monster. In the end, the monster found Tim and scared him so much that he never went back to the laundry room again. Tim's mom had to do the laundry all by herself, and Tim was too scared to help her ever again.
Summary: Tim is scared of the laundry room and encounters a scary monster while helping his mom with the laundry, causing him to never want to help with laundry again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily invites her best friend Max to play with her toys, but when she falls and hurts her knee, Max helps her and later has to leave. The moral is to be grateful for the time spent with friends.
With: sad ending
response:
While they were playing, Lily fell down and hurt her knee. Max quickly ran to get a bandage from his house. He helped Lily put it on her knee and made sure she felt better.
After playing for a while longer, Max had to go home. Lily wanted him to stay longer, but Max had to go. Lily felt sad and didn't want to play anymore.
The moral of the story is that we should always be grateful for the time we have with our friends. Even if they have to leave, we should be happy for the time we spent together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny becomes friends with a sneaky fox who has been stealing from other animals, but when the fox is caught, Benny learns the importance of being careful about who he spends time with and doing the right thing.
With: sad ending
response:
But one day, the other animals found out about the fox's bad deeds. They were very angry and wanted to punish him. Benny felt guilty because he had been friends with the fox and didn't know about his bad behavior. The fox was caught and taken away. Benny was sad and realized that he should have been more careful about who he made friends with.
The moral of the story is that it's important to be careful about who we spend time with and to always do the right thing. Even if we don't know it, our actions can have consequences.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack sees a fancy cake in the park, but when he falls onto the table, the cake falls onto the ground and Jack is covered in salt. The moral of the story is to listen to our parents and not touch things that don't belong to us.
With: sad ending
response:
Suddenly, Jack tripped and fell onto the table. The cake fell onto the ground and Jack was covered in salt. Jack was very sad because he ruined the fancy cake and he knew he shouldn't have touched it.
The moral of the story is that we should always listen to our parents and not touch things that don't belong to us. If we do, bad things can happen and we might end up feeling sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: An old rabbit learns the importance of sharing after a sneaky fox tries to steal his carrot.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, a sneaky fox appeared and wanted the carrot too. The rabbit didn't want to share, so the fox chased him. The rabbit ran and ran until he was too tired to go on. 
The fox caught up to him and snatched the carrot away. The poor rabbit was so sad. He realized that his wisdom couldn't protect him from the fox. From then on, he always shared his food with others.

instruction:
Write a story about: Nemo and his friends found a calendar underwater, but a boat hit them and Nemo died.
With: sad ending
response: Suddenly, the boat started moving and Nemo and his friends got scared. They tried to swim away, but it was too late. The boat hit them and they couldn't swim anymore. Nemo's friends were gone and Nemo was hurt. He swam as fast as he could, but he couldn't make it. Sadly, Nemo died and went to fish heaven.

instruction:
Write a story about: Grandma, Mummy and Daddy went on a march but Grandma fell and hurt her leg, which led to her having to stay in the hospital for a few days.
With: sad ending
response:
Mummy and Daddy took Grandma on a march. They all went outside and marched around the town. Grandma loved to march, she always said it was a sweet feeling.
Mummy asked Grandma,"What do you like to replace?" Grandma said, "I like to replace my coffee with a sweet tea!" 
They all laughed. But then, disaster struck. Suddenly, Grandma tripped on a tree root and fell to the ground. Daddy rushed to her and saw that her leg was badly hurt. He shouted for help and soon an ambulance came.
The doctors said that Grandma had to stay in the hospital for a few days. Mummy, Daddy and Grandma all felt very sad. Grandma's sweet march was now replaced with a visit to the hospital.
Summary: Grandma, Mummy and Daddy went on a march but Grandma fell and hurt her leg, which led to her having to stay in the hospital for a few days.

instruction:
Write a story about: A noisy dog named Spot stole a wallet but was chased by a man who caught him and took the wallet back, teaching Spot that stealing is wrong.
With: sad ending
response:
Spot wanted the wallet, so he decided to steal it. He picked it up with his mouth and ran away. He thought it was a fun game. But then, a man saw Spot and started to chase him. The man wanted his wallet back.
Spot ran and ran, but the man caught him. The man was very angry. He took the wallet from Spot and went away. Spot felt sad and scared. He learned that stealing is not a good thing to do.

instruction:
Write a story about: A brave and weird zero goes on an adventure, fixes a broken bridge with a magic tool, and returns safely to its friends.
With: happy ending
response: Once upon a time there was a weird little zero. It wasn't like an ordinary zero - it had eyes and legs and a mouth! The weird zero was a very brave zero and one day it decided to go on an adventure. The zero split up from its friends and set off. The brave zero walked and walked through the forest until it reached a big lake. To its delight the zero found a bridge across the lake. But oh no! The bridge was broken in two and the brave zero had to cross the lake. The zero looked around and saw a strange thing that was split in two. It was a magic quick-fix tool! The brave zero grabbed it and - poof! - the bridge was fixed. The weird little zero had a great adventure, and made it back safely to its friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: John goes on his first trip but is abducted by an evil stranger while trying to join a group of children playing in a park. He is never seen again.
With: sad ending
response:
John took a big step forward to go on his very first trip. He was so excited and he couldn't wait to explore the world. He was completely ignorant of the danger that awaited him.
John stepped out of his house and began walking down the street. He quickly reached the park and saw a group of children playing on the playground. He stepped closer and asked the group if he could join them.
The group however, ignored John and kept playing. John felt sad and stepped away from the group. Suddenly, someone grabbed him from behind. It was an evil stranger! 
John was scared and tried to escape but the stranger was too strong and dragged him away. John screamed and shouted but nobody heard him. He was taken away and never seen again. 
John's family was heartbroken and never stopped looking for him. To this day, everybody is still ignorant of what happened to him.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy gets lost at a parade after releasing a balloon and is unable to find his parents. He becomes sad and scared and never wants to attend a parade again.
With: sad ending
response:
Suddenly, Timmy saw a balloon on the ground. He wanted to raise it up to the sky. Timmy was very intelligent and he knew how to do it. He grabbed the string and pulled it up, up, up. The balloon went higher and higher until it was out of sight.
But then, Timmy realized he had let go of his mommy and daddy's hands. He couldn't find them in the big crowd of people. Timmy was scared and didn't know what to do. He cried and cried, but no one could hear him.
In the end, Timmy was lost and alone. He never found his mommy and daddy again. The parade was over and everyone went home. Timmy was sad and scared, and he never wanted to go to a parade again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy helps a kitty whose paw was stuck in a can and feels proud of himself for rescuing the animal.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a small kitty whose paw was stuck in a can. The kitty was sad, so she meowed for help. 
A nice boy heard the meow and came to help. He got a clean cloth and wrapped the can tightly. Then he lifted the can with both hands and pulled the paw of the kitty out.
The boy was happy, and so was the kitty. The kitty purred, thanked him and ran off happily. 
The boy felt proud and went home. He knew he had rescued the kitty and was happy that he was able to help.

instruction:
Write a story about: Steve and his dad sail in a pretty blue boat and wave at a driver in an automobile before sailing off into the sunset.
With: happy ending
response:
Steve and his dad went to the beach. They saw a boat. It was a pretty blue boat. Steve asked, "Can we sail in it, Dad?" "Yes," said Dad.
They both got in the boat and Dad untied it from the shore. He used a big stick to push it into the water. Then he grabbed the oars. He rowed the boat and they sailed further and further away.
Suddenly, there was a loud noise. It was an automobile. Dad stopped rowing and the boat floated quietly. They saw the automobile parked near the shore. They both waved and the driver waved back.
The dad started rowing again and they sailed off into the sunset. It was a beautiful and quiet night.

instruction:
Write a story about: A humble rabbit learns the importance of asking questions when trying to figure out the best way to do something, and becomes smarter and more skilled as a result.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a rabbit. It was humble and liked to fold things. One day the rabbit was folding a blanket when it started to have a question. What was the best way to fold the blanket?
The rabbit thought and thought as it folded the blanket. Then it suddenly knew the right way, so it quickly folded the blanket and put it away. The rabbit had learned an important lesson, that questions can help you figure out the best way to do something.
The rabbit kept asking questions, and soon it had learned many things. The rabbit was much smarter and more humble than before, because it had learned to ask questions. 
The rabbit kept folding things and kept asking questions, and it became the best folder and smartest rabbit around!
Summary: A humble rabbit learns the importance of asking questions when trying to figure out the best way to do something, and becomes smarter and more skilled as a result.

instruction:
Write a story about: A monkey named Max tries to climb to the top of the tallest tree in the jungle using a vine, but it breaks and he falls to the ground, leading him to vow to never climb a vine again.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a monkey named Max. He was very original and loved to explore. One day he was looking for a way to get to the top of the tallest tree in the jungle. He noticed a long vine hanging from the tree and thought it might fit.
Max pulled on the vine and it seemed to fit perfectly. He started climbing the vine to the top of the tree. But some of the leaves started to rip and Max knew he had to hurry. As he got closer to the top, he realized the vine was getting really weak.
Max: "Help! The vine is going to break!"
Suddenly, the vine snapped and Max fell down to the ground. He was very sad. All his original exploring had led to a bad ending. He vowed to never climb a vine again. The End.

instruction:
Write a story about: John feels lucky because everyone is nice to him. He goes for a walk and tries to touch a friendly cat, but it runs away. He tries again later and successfully touches the cat, feeling even luckier.
With: happy ending
response:
John was lucky because he knew he was special. Everyone was so nice to him. One day, he went for a walk. Along the way, a friendly cat came close. John was excited and he put out his hand to touch the fur. Slowly, he moved closer, but the cat ran away quickly. John was sad and a little disappointed.
Days passed, and John kept walking. He was sure he was really lucky, and he was excited to see the same friendly cat that he had seen before. Sure enough, there it was. He slowly moved towards it, and this time, the cat stayed. John was so pleased he could hardly contain himself. He put out his hand, and just as before, the cat let him touch its fur. 
John chuckled to himself. He was so lucky that he was able to move close to the cat and touch it. It was a perfect day. And he knew that he was lucky.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily tries to catch a butterfly but it flies away, causing her to scratch an itch on her arm. Her mommy gives her lotion to make the itch feel better and a modern water bottle with a straw to quench her thirst.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily started to feel an itch on her arm. She scratched and scratched, but it wouldn't go away. Her mommy saw her scratching and gave her some lotion to make the itch feel better. 
After playing for a while, Lily got thirsty. She went inside and asked her mommy for some water. Her mommy gave her a modern water bottle with a straw. Lily liked the bottle and drank all the water. She felt better and went back outside to play some more. The end.
Summary: Lily tries to catch a butterfly but it flies away, causing her to scratch an itch on her arm. Her mommy gives her lotion to make the itch feel better and a modern water bottle with a straw to quench her thirst.

instruction:
Write a story about: A determined bee finds an empty hive to live in but is confronted by a bigger bee who claims the hive as their own, teaching the lesson that sometimes you have to accept that you won't always get what you want.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a bee who was looking for a new home. She was a strong bee, determined to make it work. She looked all around until she found an empty hive. It was a perfect place for her to stay.
The bee was excited and started to attach to the hive. After a while, she felt something tugging on her back. She turned around to find a very big bee.
The bee said, “That hive is mine.”
The little bee felt very scared and tried to explain that she only wanted a place to live. The big bee didn't listen and kept tugging. The little bee could not get away and eventually had to give up.
The moral of the story is that sometimes life can be difficult and you have to accept that you will not always get what you want. Trying to get what you want at all costs can be dangerous. You must use caution before you attach to something.

instruction:
Write a story about: A cat named Tom and a bird named Tim become friends and play near some rail tracks, but they are hit by a train and die.
With: sad ending
response:
One sunny day, a new friend appeared. It was a little bird named Tim. "Hi, Tom! Can I play with you?" asked Tim. "Yes, let's play!" said Tom. They played together near the rails, having a lot of fun.
But one day, while they were playing, they didn't hear the train coming. The train was very fast and loud. Tom and Tim were too close to the rails. The train hit them, and they were gone. The end.
Summary: A cat named Tom and a bird named Tim become friends and play near some rail tracks, but they are hit by a train and die.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim presses a button on a magic machine in the park and is given a talking blue bird as his special gift.
With: happy ending
response:
"Hello!" said the machine. Tim was very surprised. He did not know that machines could talk. "I am a magic machine. If you rub me, I will give you a special gift."
Tim rubbed the machine and waited. The machine made a funny noise and then stopped. Tim looked around, but he did not see a gift. He felt sad.
Just then, a big, blue bird flew down from the sky. The bird landed on Tim's shoulder and said, "I am your special gift! I can talk, and I will be your friend forever." Tim was very happy. He and the big, blue bird played together in the park all day long.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max, a restless dog, found an old bone in the park and ate it, making him very sick and eventually causing his death.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Max found an old bone in the park. The bone was very old and had started to rot. Max didn't know that it was bad for him to eat it, so he started to chew on it. Max's owner didn't notice and let him keep chewing.
Later that night, Max started to feel sick. He couldn't stop throwing up and his owner rushed him to the vet. The vet said that Max had eaten something bad and the bone had made him very sick. Max's owner was very sad and wished he had been more careful. Max never got better and eventually passed away.
Summary: Max, a restless dog, found an old bone in the park and ate it, making him very sick and eventually causing his death.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sue played with Tim's toy jet at the park, but a dog took it. The dog later returned the jet and they all played together happily.
With: happy ending
response:
At the park, Tim met a girl named Sue. "Do you want to play with my jet?" Tim asked. Sue said, "Yes, I would love to!" So Tim and Sue played together, taking turns to hold the jet and make it fly.
Suddenly, a big dog came running to them. The dog jumped and took the jet in its mouth. Tim and Sue were very sad. They thought the jet was gone forever. But then, the dog came back and dropped the jet at their feet. Tim picked it up, and they all played together happily.
Summary: Tim and Sue played with Tim's toy jet at the park, but a dog took it. The dog later returned the jet and they all played together happily.

instruction:
Write a story about: An old man finds a sandwich in the park but shares it with someone else who had already taken a bite, learning the lesson that sharing brings more happiness than keeping things for oneself.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was an old man who was very poor. Every day he went to the park, looking for food. One day, he found a sandwich in the park. He was really happy, but as he reached to pick it up, he saw that someone else had already taken a bite out of it.
The man thought for a moment and then decided to cut the sandwich in two. He gave one half to the other person and kept the other half for himself.
He then realized that by sharing, he was able to receive more than what he had before. So, the man taught himself a lesson that day — always be generous and kind and share what you have with others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A gentle rabbit finds a safe and welcoming burrow to hide in, where he feels happy and content.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a gentle rabbit who hopped through the forest.  He was looking for a safe place to hide. Everywhere he went, he heard sounds that made him scared.
Until one day, he came to a place that felt warm and welcoming. He could tell that no bad things happened here. He looked around and saw a cozy burrow with a round, warm entrance.
The rabbit hopped inside and found it was a perfect spot to hide. He made himself at home and felt safe and happy. Even though he was far away from his family, he felt like he belonged.
He stayed in that safe shelter for a long time, finding comfort and happiness in his gentle home. Early every morning the rabbit hopped out to the nearby river to drink and eat.
And so the gentle rabbit spent his days hiding in the burrow, content and safe.
Summary: A gentle rabbit finds a safe and welcoming burrow to hide in, where he feels happy and content.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl accidentally kills a spider while trying to paint its cobweb, and learns to be more careful when interacting with nature.
With: sad ending
response:
The spider watched as the little girl painted the cobweb with bright colors. It was so pretty! But then, the little girl accidentally knocked over the paint can. The paint spilled all over the spider and the cobweb. The spider couldn't breathe and tried to run away, but it was too late. The spider died, and the cobweb was ruined.
The little girl felt very sad and knew she shouldn't have painted the cobweb. She promised to never hurt another spider again. From that day on, she always looked carefully before she painted anything in nature.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lawyer receives a talking bird as a gift and they become good friends, but the bird eventually flies away and the lawyer is left alone and sad.
With: sad ending
response:
The lawyer opened the box and found a talking bird. The bird said, "Hello, I am your new friend!" The lawyer was surprised but happy to have a new friend. They talked and played all day.
But one day, the talking bird flew away. The lawyer was very sad and cried. He looked for the bird everywhere, but he could not find it. In the end, the lawyer was alone again, and he missed his friend very much.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily spills orange juice at breakfast in a hotel, but helps her mom clean it up. Later, she finds a lost toy for a little boy and feels proud of herself for helping.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom was frustrated and said, "Oh no, now we have to clean up the mess!" Lily felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Mommy." Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, accidents happen. Let's clean it up together." 
Lily helped her mom wipe the table with a towel. Then, they went to the hotel pool and had fun swimming together. Later that day, Lily saw a little boy who looked sad. She asked him what was wrong and he said he lost his toy. Lily wanted to help, so she looked around and found the toy. The little boy was happy and thanked her. Lily felt proud of herself for helping someone else.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little bird tries to fly high like its parent but gets tired and falls down, learning that it was not ready yet.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the little bird decided to try to fly high, just like its parent. It flapped its wings and flew higher and higher. The little bird was so happy to be flying high in the smooth sky.
But suddenly, the little bird got tired. Its wings were not strong enough to keep flying high. The little bird fell down and down, and it could not fly anymore. The little bird's parent was sad, and the little bird learned that it was not ready to fly high in the smooth sky yet.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy ignores his mom's warning about rain and hurts his leg while playing outside. He learns to listen to his mom and be safe.
With: sad ending
response:
As Timmy played, the sky got dark and the wind started to blow. Suddenly, it started to rain. Timmy was having so much fun that he didn't want to go inside. But then, he slipped and fell. He hurt his leg and couldn't get up.
Timmy's friends tried to help him, but they couldn't. They were too small to carry him. Timmy was scared and grateful when his mom came to rescue him. She took him to the hospital, but the doctor said that Timmy's leg was broken. Timmy realized that he should have listened to his mom's warning and gone inside. From then on, he promised to always listen to his mom and be safe.
Summary: Timmy ignores his mom's warning about rain and hurts his leg while playing outside. He learns to listen to his mom and be safe.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl buys a microphone and sings with it happily until she starts using it to scream and behave badly. Her parents take it away and she never learns to behave properly.
With: sad ending
response:
There was a little girl who bought an attractive microphone. She was very excited and couldn't wait to use it. Every day, the little girl sang with her microphone and sang for her family and friends. For a while, she was happy and behaved well.
But then one day, the little girl started to use her microphone in ways it was not meant to be used. Instead of singing, she started to scream into it. She wanted everyone to hear her voice and began to become rude and loud. 
No matter what her family said, the little girl continued to behave badly. She tried many times to be nice, but she just couldn't control her emotions.
Eventually, the little girl's parents became so frustrated that they took away the microphone. The little girl was sad and never got to use it again. She never learned how to behave properly and was never able to get the microphone back.

instruction:
Write a story about: A farmer loses everything he has worked hard for due to a big storm, and despite the help of his family and friends, he is left feeling sad and unsure of how to start again.
With: sad ending
response: The farmer's family and friends came to help, but it was still too much. The farmer lost everything he had worked so hard for. He was very sad and didn't know how to start again. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily learns to be careful around big dogs after one scares her and her friends at the park, and later bites one of her friends.
With: sad ending
response:
Then, one of her friends started to clap her hands loudly. The dog got scared and ran away. Everyone felt relieved and happy again. But later that day, Lily's mom got a call from the park. The dog had come back and bitten one of Lily's friends. Lily felt so sad and scared. She didn't want to go to the park anymore. 
From that day on, Lily learned to be careful around big dogs. She never forgot the time when her friend got hurt. She always remembered to clap her hands if a dog came near her. And even though she still loved to sing and dance, she knew that sometimes it was better to be safe than sorry.

instruction:
Write a story about: A graceful skeleton who was lonely went to the playground to find friends. He joined some children who were counting and was very good at it, making him happy and no longer lonely.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a skeleton who was very graceful. Everyone loved his gracefulness, but the skeleton was lonely. So, he decided to go find some friends. He went to the playground and saw all the children playing. He wanted to join them, but he wasn't sure how.
Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was a little girl. She said, "Come and play with us! We're counting!" So, the skeleton joined them as they counted. He was very good at it. He could quickly number much higher than the other kids.
Together they counted all the way to one hundred. Then, they all ran around and jumped in the air. The skeleton was very happy. He was proud of himself that he was able to make some friends. He was now no longer lonely.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sammy the squirrel befriends a bird by offering it a large peanut and they become best friends.
With: happy ending
response:
But before he could eat it, he saw something adorable hanging from a tree. It was a little bird, chirping and singing a happy tune. Sammy wanted to be friends with the bird, but he didn't know how to reach it.
He remembered the peanut and had an idea. He hung the peanut from a branch, and soon enough, the bird flew down to take a bite. Sammy and the bird became the best of friends, and they lived happily ever after, sharing nuts and singing songs together in the park.

instruction:
Write a story about: A new brave captain takes charge of an important ship that supplies various things to different places, making people happy with the supplies it brings.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big ship. This ship was very important. It had to supply all sorts of things to different places. It had to take lots of boxes of things from one place to the other.
One day, the ship got a new captain. He was very brave and he knew lots about ships. He told the ship that it was very important and that it had to supply things to lots of different places.
So the ship started its journey. It went from one place to the other, supplying things like food, clothes and toys. Everyone was happy when the ship arrived with the supplies.
That's why the ship was so very important. It supplied happy things to make people smile.
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Maria plays her drum in the bath and annoys her neighbors, causing her mother to tell her to stop and get out of the bath.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Maria. She had a drum which she loved playing every day.
One Sunday morning, Maria wanted to play her drum but it was raining outside. She thought, "How can I play my drum if it's raining?"
So she decided to have a bath and take her drum into the bathroom with her! She filled her bath with bubbles and began to play her drum. But the sound of it was so loud that it annoyed the neighbours. Mr Hater, who lived next door called her mum and said, "Your daughter is being very rude. She's making too much noise!"
Maria's mum came into the bathroom to find Maria still playing her drum in the bath. She said, "Maria, you shouldn't be so loud. Put your drum away and get out of the bath! You don't want to soak for too long!"
So Maria said goodbye to her drum and stepped out of the bath. She promised never to play it in the bath again!

instruction:

Her mom looked at the leak and said, "Oh dear, we must fix it!" They went to the store and bought an attractive bucket to catch the water. They put the bucket under the leak and it helped.
The next day, the leak was still there. Lily's mom said, "Lily, we need to repeat what we did yesterday." So they went to the store again and bought another attractive bucket. When they came home, they saw that the leak had stopped. It was a surprise! The leak was gone and they didn't need the new bucket. They were very happy and used the new bucket to make a pretty flower pot.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily the bunny bakes a fancy cake with her friend Tom the cat and they enjoy eating it together.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily mixed flour, sugar, and eggs in the big bowl. She stirred and stirred with the small spoon. Then, she poured the mix into a cake pan. She put the pan in the oven and waited.
After some time, her friend Tom the cat came in. He said, "Wow, what are you making, Lily?" Lily smiled and said, "I am baking a fancy cake for us!" Tom was happy and clapped his paws. They both waited for the cake to be ready.
When the cake was ready, Lily and Tom took it out of the oven. They decorated it with colorful icing and sprinkles. The fancy cake looked very pretty.
Lily and Tom sat down to eat the cake. They both took big bites and smiled. The fancy cake was very yummy. Lily and Tom were so happy to share the cake they baked together.
Summary: Lily the bunny bakes a fancy cake with her friend Tom the cat and they enjoy eating it together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily cuts her finger while playing with scissors and learns to be more careful.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily's mom saw her playing with the scissors and told her to be careful, but Lily didn't listen. She kept playing with them and accidentally cut her finger. It hurt a lot and Lily started to cry. 
Her mom took her to the fair to cheer her up, but Lily couldn't dance or play because her finger hurt too much. She felt sad and wished she had listened to her mom. From that day on, Lily always remembered to be careful with scissors.
Summary: Lily cuts her finger while playing with scissors and learns to be more careful.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily receives a ball of wool from her mom and decides to make a decoration out of it, which she hangs on her wall.
With: happy ending
response:
"Lily, what are you going to do with the wool?" asked her mom.
"I want to hang it on my wall," replied Lily.
"Good idea, Lily. You can make a beautiful decoration with it," said her mom.
Lily smiled and ran to her room to hang the wool on her wall. She showed it to her teddy bear and said, "Look, Teddy! I made a beautiful decoration with the wool!" Teddy hugged Lily and said, "You're so clever, Lily!"

instruction:
Write a story about: A big dog named Longer gets a lie license so he can lie in the sun for hours every day.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big dog who was always lying in the sun. His name was Longer and he loved to lie in the sun for hours every day.
One day, Longer decided he wanted to get a lie license so he could lie in the sun all he wanted. He went to the lie office, filled out some forms and waited for his license card to arrive.
Finally, after waiting a long time, Longer's license arrived. He couldn't wait to get back outside in the sun to lie. He went outside, lay down and didn't get up for hours!
Longer loved having his lie license. He could lie in the sun for as long as he wanted every day. Life was good!
Summary: A big dog named Longer gets a lie license so he can lie in the sun for hours every day.

instruction:
Write a story about: A man tries to make the patch of brown grass outside his house greener but fails, leaving him sad and giving up.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a man who lived in a small house with nothing but a patch of brown grass outside of his front door. Every day, he would look out of his window and worry about the grass because it was the only thing he could see.
One day, the man decided he could make things better. He put on his regular shoes and went outside to work. He touched the brown grass, and it started to turn greener. He watered the grass and trimmed its edges.
But then something bad happened. No matter how hard he tried, the grass wouldn't get any greener. The worried man tried many different things, but all his hard work seemed to be in vain.
The man was very sad because he was not able to make the grass green. So he stopped trying and left his regular shoes outside to remember the bad ending.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mummy and Daddy discuss fuel with their two children, explaining its importance and the need to use it wisely.
With: happy ending
response:
Mummy and Daddy sat together in the living room of their house with two small children. Mummy looked at Daddy and said, "Let's discuss fuel." Daddy smiled and said, "Yes. That sounds great!'
The little girl and boy looked up. The little girl asked, "What is fuel?"
Mummy smiled and said, "Fuel is an incredible thing. Without it, we wouldn't be able to drive our car, or fly a plane."
The little boy opened his eyes wide and said, "Wow! That's amazing!"
Mummy said, "Yes, it is amazing. That's why we need to talk about it, so that we can use fuel wisely".
The little girl and boy nodded and said, "We'll be careful with fuel."
Daddy smiled and said, "That's my smart kids!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her mommy went to the store to buy food, but a mouse ate it all up. They went back to the store to buy more food, but had to be careful of mice.
With: sad ending
response:
Suddenly, they heard a noise coming from the kitchen. It was a furry little mouse! Lily's mommy tried to catch the mouse, but it ran away. Lily said, "I want to catch the mouse too!" 
But then, the mouse got into the food and ate it all up. Lily's mommy was very upset. They had no more food to eat. Lily said, "I'm sorry mommy. I want to help you buy more food." 
And so, they went back to the store to buy more food. But, they had to be more careful with the furry little mice.
Summary: Lily and her mommy went to the store to buy food, but a mouse ate it all up. They went back to the store to buy more food, but had to be careful of mice.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds a bug in the garden, puts it in a jar, but learns from his mom that bugs are important for the garden and decides to let it go. The bug turns into a beautiful butterfly, teaching Timmy a valuable lesson.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy showed his mom the bug and she told him that bugs are important for the garden. She said that the bug would help the plants grow. Timmy felt bad for putting the bug in the jar and decided to let it go.
As he opened the jar, something unexpected happened. The bug flew away and suddenly turned into a beautiful butterfly! Timmy was amazed and learned that sometimes things can seem scary, but they can turn into something beautiful. From that day on, Timmy made sure to never put any bugs in jars again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A young girl discovers a hidden doorway in a park wall and enters a colorful world, but is blown away by a bad cloud and never returns.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, a young girl went to the park. As she played, she watched the wall. It looked a bit old and she started to think about what was behind it. She pushed against it and a doorway appeared!
The girl peered in and saw a world full of colour and fun. She felt excited to explore it, so she stepped inside. Suddenly, a big dark cloud appeared and the girl knew it was very bad.
The cloud created a powerful wind and the girl was lifted up and blown away. She watched sadly as the park and the wall disappeared from view.
She did not return from her adventure that day and was never seen again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A poor little bird befriends a big bird with lots of food, but the big bird betrays the little bird and eats all the food alone, leaving the little bird sad and alone again.
With: sad ending
response:
The big bird agreed, but only if the little bird did something for it. The little bird agreed and did what the big bird asked. But when it was time to share the food, the big bird changed its mind and ate everything alone. 
The poor little bird was sad and alone again. It learned that not everyone is kind and trustworthy. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy's favorite gray shirt got dirty while playing at the park, but his mom promised to wash it for him.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy went to the park to play with his friends. He enjoyed playing on the swings and going down the slide. But then, he got a little dirty and spilled some juice on his gray shirt. 
Timmy was sad because he loved his gray shirt so much. But his mom told him not to worry and that she would wash it for him. Timmy was happy again because he knew he would be able to wear his favorite shirt again soon.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two sheep, one strong and one weak, quarrel but make up and continue to play together, making the other animals in the field happy.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the strong sheep wanted to play a game, but the weak sheep did not want to play. They started to quarrel and make loud noises. The other animals in the field heard them and came to see what was happening.
The strong sheep realized that it was not nice to argue with his friend. He apologized and they made up. From that day on, they played together and never quarreled again. The other animals were happy to see the two sheep getting along. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A deaf bee searches for friends and discovers that the flowers are having a conversation about the coming of spring, which leads to the bee making new friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was a bee who wanted to make friends. But it was deaf, so it couldn't speak to anyone. Every day, the bee buzzed around looking for someone to talk to.
Then one day, it noticed something special. Everywhere it looked, it saw flowers blooming and buzzing with life.
The bee decided to find out what all the buzzing was about. When it got closer, it could see that the flowers were having a conversation.
The bee flew around and asked, "What are you talking about?"
The flowers looked up and replied, "We're talking about the coming of spring. Soon, the whole forest will bloom!"
The bee was so excited! With the coming of spring, it finally had someone to talk to. As the forest bloomed, the conversations kept coming, and the bee made lots of new friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sam wanted to decorate their room with colors but made a mess, causing Tim's mom to get angry and make them clean it up. They learned to ask for permission before decorating next time.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim said to Sam, "Let's put up many colors on the wall!" Sam was an obedient friend and listened to Tim. They took paint and started to put it on the wall. They made a big mess, but they had fun.
Then, Tim's mom came into the room. She saw the mess and was very mad. She told Tim and Sam, "You made a big mess and now you have to clean it up." Tim and Sam were sad because they had to clean the mess instead of playing. They learned that they should ask before they decorate next time.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily spills juice on her pink, fluffy carpet and her mom yells at her, so she draws a picture to apologize and her mom forgives her.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily felt sad and didn't know what to do. She decided to draw a picture for her mom to say sorry. She put the picture in an envelope and asked her dad to mail it for her. 
A few days later, Lily's mom received the picture in the mail. She felt happy and hugged Lily. From then on, Lily made sure to be careful with her juice and keep her carpet clean.
Summary: Lily spills juice on her pink, fluffy carpet and her mom yells at her, so she draws a picture to apologize and her mom forgives her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily explores the forest, finds an oak tree with acorns, measures a stream with a stick, tries sour fruit, and collects treasures in her pocket.
With: happy ending
response:
As she walked further into the forest, she came across a small stream. She wanted to see how deep it was, so she took a stick and put it in the water. "I can measure how deep it is with this stick!" she said.
As she continued walking, she saw a tree with some fruit hanging from it. She picked one and took a bite, but it was too sour for her. "This fruit is too sour," she said. "I think I'll stick to the acorns from the oak tree." 
Lily continued to explore the forest and have adventures, always using her stick to measure and her pocket to collect treasures. And whenever she saw an oak tree, she made sure to stop and gather some acorns to take home with her.

instruction:
Write a story about: A rare and pretty fish had to complete a race around a pond, but stopped to help a small, slow fish and they finished the race together, becoming best friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The race was around the pond. All the fish in the pond wanted to win. The rare fish was very fast. It swam and swam. The other fish tried to keep up. But the rare fish was too fast.
Then, something unexpected happened. A small, slow fish asked the rare fish for help. The rare fish stopped and helped the small fish. They swam together. They finished the race together. The rare fish and the small fish both won. They were happy and became best friends.
Summary: A rare and pretty fish had to complete a race around a pond, but stopped to help a small, slow fish and they finished the race together, becoming best friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy falls during a race with his friends, but his friend Johnny helps him up and ties his shoelace so he can continue the race. Timmy feels grateful and happy to have such a good friend.
With: happy ending
response:
As they were running, Timmy's shoelace came undone and he tripped and fell into a hole. His friends all ran past him and he felt very sad. But then, his friend Johnny came back to help him up.
"Let me tie your shoelace so you can catch up!" Johnny said.
Timmy was very grateful and they continued the race. Even though he didn't win, Timmy felt happy because he had such a good friend like Johnny.
Summary: Timmy falls during a race with his friends, but his friend Johnny helps him up and ties his shoelace so he can continue the race. Timmy feels grateful and happy to have such a good friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily has a garden with pretty flowers and herbs. Her friend Timmy wants to pick flowers, but Lily says no. They discuss the herbs, but a storm destroys the garden and they go inside to play.
With: sad ending
response:
"Wow, Lily! Your garden is so pretty! Can we pick some flowers?" asked Timmy.
"No, Timmy. We can't pick the flowers. They are not available for picking," replied Lily.
Timmy looked sad, but then he saw the herbs. "What are these?" he asked.
"They are herbs. We can discuss what they are used for," said Lily.
As they were discussing, a big storm came and destroyed all of Lily's flowers and herbs. Lily and Timmy were very sad. "Now we can't play in the garden anymore," said Timmy.
"I know. It's very sad," said Lily. They hugged each other and went inside to play indoors.

instruction:
Write a story about: Bella's pretty garden is destroyed by a lightning bolt, leaving a big hole that she can't fill.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was very pretty, with a big smile that lit up her face. Her name was Bella.
One day, she was out playing in her garden. Suddenly, there was a loud noise! It was a surprise. Bella jumped with shock as a big lightning bolt struck the ground!
The lightning made a big hole in the garden. Bella was scared. She had never seen anything like this before.
Bella tried to fill the hole with dirt, but it was too big. There was nothing she could do. Suddenly, the rain started and it washed away all the dirt. The hole stayed. It was a bad surprise that destroyed her pretty garden.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves to play with his toys but has to clean them up when his mommy tells him to. While cleaning, he learns about the importance of oxygen for breathing.
With: happy ending
response:
"Timmy, you need to clean up your toys now," said mommy. 
"But mommy, I don't want to quit playing with my toys," said Timmy. 
"You can play with them again later, but right now it's time to clean up," said mommy. 
Timmy sighed and started to clean up his toys. As he was cleaning, he noticed that the room was getting very noisy. He couldn't hear himself think! 
"Mommy, why is it so noisy in here?" asked Timmy. 
"It's because we need oxygen to breathe, and the noisy machine over there is helping us get more oxygen," explained mommy. 
Timmy finished cleaning up his toys and was happy to have a clean room. He also learned that sometimes it's important to quit playing and do other things, like cleaning up, and that oxygen is important for us to breathe.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily receives a shiny necklace from her mommy and writes a letter to invite her friends over for a party, but the letter doesn't get delivered due to a broken mailbox. She loses her necklace to a bird and is left feeling sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily wanted to show her friends her new necklace, so she decided to write a letter to invite them over for a tea party. She wrote the letter with her favorite purple pen and put it in the mailbox. But, the mailbox was broken and the letter didn't go anywhere.
Lily was sad that her friends didn't come to her party. She went for a walk in the park and saw a big bird. She wanted to give the bird her necklace, but the bird flew away with it and Lily never saw it again. She was very upset and cried all the way home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Emma helps a deer in the forest feel more comfortable by offering her hat.
With: happy ending
response: It was a lovely day and Emma wanted to go and explore the forest. She took off her shoes and ran through the grass. As she was running, she saw a deer standing in the woods. She got closer to the deer and noticed how uncomfortable it looked. She wanted to help, so she slowly removed her hat and held it out to the deer. The deer sniffed the hat and felt more comfortable. Emma smiled, happy she had helped the deer!

instruction:
Write a story about: A sad blue car is repaired by a kind man and turns into a blue plane, which flies away happily.
With: happy ending
response:
"Hello, little blue car," said the man. "I will make you feel new again." The man worked hard to repair the blue car. After some time, the blue car was happy and could go fast again.
But then, something unexpected happened! The blue car turned into a big blue plane! The kind man was very surprised. The blue plane said, "Thank you for fixing me! Now I can fly high in the sky!" And the blue plane flew away, happy and new.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy gets sick after eating at a dirty restaurant and learns the importance of listening to warnings.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy's mom mentioned that the restaurant didn't look very clean. But Timmy didn't care, he just wanted his chicken nuggets. So they ordered their food and started eating. But after a few bites, Timmy started feeling sick. He had eaten some bad food and got very sick.
Timmy had to go to the hospital and he was very sad. He learned that sometimes it's important to listen when someone mentions that something is not good. From that day on, Timmy never wanted to go to that ugly restaurant again. The end.
Summary: Timmy gets sick after eating at a dirty restaurant and learns the importance of listening to warnings.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the store with her mommy, buys cookies and a toy, but gets caught in the rain and her new toy gets ruined.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, it started to rain outside. Lily's mommy said they had to wait until the rain stopped before they could go home. Lily was sad because she didn't want to wait. She wanted to go home and play with her new toy.
Lily asked her mommy, "Can we spend the night at the store?" Her mommy said no, they couldn't do that. Lily was getting very wet in the rain and started to cry. Suddenly, a car drove by and splashed water all over them. Lily's cookies and toy got wet and ruined. Lily was very sad and wished they had stayed at the store.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a pretty daisy and squeezes it, causing the petals to fall off. She learns to appreciate the flower even though it looks different.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily picked up the daisy and held it in her hand. She loved how it smelled so good. She decided to squeeze it gently and see what would happen. When she did, the petals fell off and the daisy looked different.
Lily was sad at first, but then she realized that she could still enjoy the daisy even though it looked different. She put it in a vase and looked at it every day. She was still proud of herself for finding such a pretty flower. The end.
Summary: Lily finds a pretty daisy and squeezes it, causing the petals to fall off. She learns to appreciate the flower even though it looks different.

instruction:
Write a story about: A smart squirrel goes looking for food in the forest but is caught by a hawk and never seen again.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a small squirrel who lived in the forest. The Squirrel was smart and had a plan to get some food. He would crawl through the forest, looking for nuts and seeds.
One day, the Squirrel was crawling along and he saw a big nut. He was so happy and he thought to himself, "This is a big nut, I'm sure I can get something to eat." 
So the smart Squirrel crawled closer to the nut to take a look. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and something grabbed him. It was a big hawk that had seen the Squirrel and wanted to eat him for lunch!
The Squirrel was so scared, he tried to get away, but it was too late. Before long, the Hawk had taken the Squirrel away to be eaten. 
The Squirrel never got his big nut or any of the food he had been looking for. He was never seen again in the forest, and the other animals only whispered about the smart Squirrel who didn't make it.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Amy buys a shiny bracelet with stars on it and discovers that it is a magic bracelet that can make her wishes come true.
With: happy ending
response:
Amy walked to the store and looked at all the pretty bracelets. She saw a shiny one with stars on it that she liked very much. She took her money out and gave it to the man at the store. The man said, "Thank you!" and gave her the bracelet.
Amy was so happy with her new bracelet that she wore it all the time. But one day, something unexpected happened. The bracelet started to glow and make a funny noise. Amy was surprised and scared. Then, the bracelet began to talk! It said, "I am a magic bracelet! I can make your wishes come true!" Amy couldn't believe it! She now had a magic bracelet that could help her do even more things by herself.

instruction:
Write a story about: A big, tall blue bird tries to eat a small worm, but the worm tricks him into getting stuck in a tree and the bird stays stuck there forever.
With: sad ending
response:
The bird did not care and demanded that the worm become his dinner. The worm was very scared, but he had an idea. He said, "If you let me go, I will show you where there is a big, juicy apple tree." The bird agreed and let the worm go.
The worm led the bird to the apple tree, but when the bird went to grab an apple, he got his beak stuck in a branch. He tried and tried to get free, but he couldn't. The bird was stuck and could not fly anymore. The worm felt sorry for the bird, but he knew it was the bird's own fault for being so mean. And so, the bird stayed stuck in the tree forever.
Summary: A big, tall blue bird tries to eat a small worm, but the worm tricks him into getting stuck in a tree and the bird stays stuck there forever.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two friends, Timmy and Tommy, quarrel over a toy, but Timmy apologizes after realizing the importance of saying sorry, even though he was envious of Tommy's Halloween decoration.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy got angry and took the toy away from Tommy. Tommy felt sad and went home. Later, Timmy felt sorry and went to Tommy's house to apologize.
When he got there, he saw a big skeleton decoration in Tommy's yard. Timmy was envious and wanted one too. But then he remembered that saying sorry was more important than having a skeleton decoration. So, he said sorry to Tommy and they became friends again.
Summary: Two friends, Timmy and Tommy, quarrel over a toy, but Timmy apologizes after realizing the importance of saying sorry, even though he was envious of Tommy's Halloween decoration.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little shell in the ocean celebrates being alive, but when it is left alone, it realizes it has nothing to celebrate and learns not to take blessings for granted.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little shell in the ocean. The shell was dull and unflattering. One day, a group of fish swam over and asked the little shell why it was so quiet. The little shell was so excited that somebody was talking to it, it began to celebrate!
The fish asked the little shell what it was doing celebrating without any noise and the little shell replied that just being blessed to be alive was enough to celebrate. The fish were very impressed at how the little shell could find joy in such simple things.
But, the little shell's joy was not meant to last. The fish swam away, leaving the little shell alone in the ocean. The little shell soon realized that it had nothing to celebrate. In its loneliness and isolation it was nothing but dull and lifeless.
Moral: Celebrate when you have something to be joyous of, but be careful not to take your blessings for granted.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves cocoa with marshmallows, but one day he chooses a black cocoa from the store and loves it so much that he asks his mom to make it every night.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy went to the store with his mom. He saw a big box of cocoa on the shelf. It was black and shiny. Timmy asked his mom if they could buy it. His mom said he could choose one thing to buy, and Timmy chose the black cocoa.
That night, Timmy's mom made him the black cocoa. It was different than the regular cocoa he was used to. It tasted more rich and chocolatey. Timmy loved it so much that he asked his mom to make it every night. From then on, Timmy always chose the black cocoa at the store.
Summary: Timmy loves cocoa with marshmallows, but one day he chooses a black cocoa from the store and loves it so much that he asks his mom to make it every night.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim makes a new friend, a funny little dog with a big nose, while playing with a big red ball in the park.
With: happy ending
response:
As Tim got near the ball, he saw a funny little dog with a big nose. The dog was playing with the ball. Tim was surprised! He did not know the ball had a friend. Tim said "hi" to the dog and asked if he could play too.
The dog and Tim played with the ball all day. They had lots of fun together. When it was time to go home, Tim thanked the dog for playing with him. The dog was happy and thanked Tim too. Now, Tim and the dog with the big nose were friends. They played together every day, and they were both very glad.

instruction:
Write a story about: Billy and Zack went for a swim but got separated by a big wave and couldn't find each other again.
With: sad ending
response:
Billy and Zack were good friends. They had lots of fun together and played together every day. One day, they decided to do something different and go for a swim. Billy and Zack were happy and the water felt really good.
But they didn't know that the water was too cold. Suddenly, Billy started to shiver and he couldn't fit. He was so cold that he started to cry. Zack wanted to help his friend, so he split the water with his hands to make it warmer. 
Steam filled the air, and soon the water felt warm. Billy stopped crying, but then a big wave came. It split Billy and Zack apart, and they were too scared to move. The wave took them far away from each other and no matter how hard they looked, they couldn't find each other again. 
Sadly, Billy and Zack could never be together again.
Summary: Billy and Zack went for a swim but got separated by a big wave and couldn't find each other again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bear tries to build a tall stack of soft things to be comfortable, but it keeps falling over, leaving him sad and unable to get comfortable.
With: sad ending
response:
The bear wanted to be comfortable so he kept making a stack of very soft things. He wanted a really tall stack so he kept adding things on top until he had a very nice stack. He was very excited to be so comfortable.
But then the stack fell over! The bear tried and tried to keep it standing but it just wouldn't stay up. He was so upset that he couldn't stay comfortable. He kept trying to build another stack but he kept knocking it over and he felt so sad.
The bear tried and tried but nothing worked. He just couldn't seem to keep his stack standing. No matter what he did, he just couldn't get comfortable. He was very sad, but he kept trying. He knew he would never get comfortable.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loved playing sports with his friends, but they didn't want to play anymore. He decided to practice alone and got hit by a car, teaching his friends a lesson about not giving up on what you love.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy didn't know what to do. He loved sports and he loved playing with his friends. He asked them why they didn't want to play anymore. They said they wanted to do something else.
Timmy felt sad, but he didn't want to give up on sports. He decided to practice by himself. He would gather his ball and shoot hoops all day long. He practiced every day, but he didn't realize he was getting too close to the street.
One day, while Timmy was practicing, a car came by and hit him. Timmy was hurt badly and had to go to the hospital. His friends came to visit him and they felt sorry for not playing with him anymore. They realized that they shouldn't have said sports were boring.
The moral of the story is that we should always be careful and not give up on the things we love, even if our friends don't want to do them with us.

instruction:
Write a story about: Paul finds a mysterious orange jewel, loses it, and later discovers it on the back of a butterfly who becomes his companion.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a man named Paul. Paul was always curious and one day, he found a mysterious box. He opened it and inside was a beautiful orange jewel. Paul was so excited and he demanded that he keep it forever.
Paul kept the orange jewel safe and soon it was time for nap. He put the jewel in his pocket and went to sleep.
When Paul woke up, he couldn't find his orange jewel anywhere. He ran around the house and called out, "Where's my jewel?!". Paul looked everywhere but he still couldn't find it. 
He decided to look outside, and to his surprise, there it was! A beautiful orange butterfly was resting on a leaf and it was wearing the orange jewel on its back. Paul smiled and demanded that the butterfly stay and keep him company. The butterfly stayed with Paul for the rest of the day, and they never parted ways.

instruction:
Write a story about: Amy gives her comb to a loud man who demands it, and she never sees it again.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a girl called Amy. She loved her new comb, which her mommy had given her. She used it all the time and kept it safe in her pocket.
One day, she went outside to play with her friend. But when they arrived at the park, they saw a loud man. He was asking the children around if they had a comb. When Amy saw this, she quickly put her comb away.
