John chose a colorful flag. It was yellow, green, and blue. Claire chose a pretty flag. It was pink and purple. But Tom made a bad choice. He chose a pale flag.
The friends wanted to play a game with the flags. So, they all ran around. When the game was done, Tom was missing! The friends looked for him everywhere.
Finally, they found him. But he was in trouble. He had run too far away and now he was lost. His pale flag was very hard to see from far away, and no one noticed it.
The moral of the story is: Always be careful when you make a choice. Don't make bad choices like Tom's pale flag.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sue goes outside to skip and meets a cat who wants to play tug with her skipping rope.
With: happy ending
response:
As Sue skipped, she saw a big cat. The cat was watching her play. Sue thought the cat wanted to skip too. She stopped skipping and asked the cat, "Do you want to play with me?"
The cat looked at Sue and then at the cable. The cat jumped and grabbed the cable with its paw. But, the cat did not want to skip. It wanted to play tug! Sue laughed and pulled the cable. The cat pulled back. They had a lot of fun playing tug with the cable. Sue learned that day that sometimes, the best fun comes when you least expect it.
Summary: Sue goes outside to skip and meets a cat who wants to play tug with her skipping rope.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns the importance of sharing when he refuses to give his little sister some of his apple, but eventually decides to share and makes his sister happy.
With: happy ending
response:
His mom said, "Sure, but you have to put it on a plate first."
Timmy put the apple on a plate and took a big bite. It was delicious! But then, his little sister came over and wanted some too. Timmy didn't want to share, so he stood up and said, "No, this is my apple!"
His sister started to cry, and Timmy felt bad. He realized it was better to share, so he put the apple on the table and said, "Here you go, you can have some too."
His sister stopped crying and smiled. Timmy felt happy that he made her feel better. From then on, he always shared his snacks with his sister.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little birdie is helped by a kind girl who feeds it when it's hungry, but when the birdie can't find food again and goes back to the girl, she's gone. The birdie is caught and eaten by a cat.

response:
The next day, the birdie was still hungry and went to find some food again. But this time, the birdie couldn't find anyone to help. The birdie remembered the kind girl and flew back to her. But when the birdie arrived, there was silence. The girl wasn't there anymore.
The birdie searched and searched, but couldn't find the girl. The birdie was very sad and missed the girl's useful help. Suddenly, the birdie saw a big cat. The cat looked very hungry and was coming towards the birdie. The birdie tried to fly away, but it was too late. The cat caught the birdie and ate it for dinner.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bald man who loves to sleep experiences an earthquake while sleeping but goes back to sleep after realizing it's over.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, while the bald man was sleeping, an earthquake came. The ground shook and the bed moved. The bald man woke up and was scared. He didn't know what to do.
The bald man got out of his bed and looked outside. He saw that the earthquake was over. He went back to his bed, feeling safe. The bald man went back to sleep, happy that the earthquake was gone.
Summary: A bald man who loves to sleep experiences an earthquake while sleeping but goes back to sleep after realizing it's over.

instruction:
Write a story about: A naughty robot gets angry when a little boy pokes it, and throws him against the wall.
With: sad ending
response:
There was once a naughty robot. It always refused to do what it was told. No matter how much one tried, it was always very naughty. One day, a 3 year old saw the robot and laughed. He wanted to play with it. So he walked up to the robot and started to poke it. 
The robot didn't like being poked. It got angry. It started growling and flashing its lights. The little boy was scared but he was too curious to back away. So he kept poking the robot. Suddenly the robot started charging up and let out a very loud beep. 
The little boy ran away as fast as he could. But the robot was very fast. Before the little boy could escape, the robot grabbed him by his shirt and threw him against the wall. He was so scared he started to cry. The naughty robot had ruined his fun.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sally loses her ball and goes searching for it. An old lady helps her find the ball in the lake and gives her a stick to retrieve it.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a girl called Sally. Sally was having lots of trouble. She had lost her ball!
Sally went out to look for her ball. She searched high and low but she couldn't find it.
Suddenly, Sally saw someone. It was a very nice old lady.
"Have you seen my ball?" asked Sally.
"Why yes, I saw a cheap ball down by the lake," replied the old lady.
Sally ran to the lake as fast as she could. There was her ball, right there in the water!
Sally set out to get it. She stretched out very far, but she couldn't quite reach it.
Luckily, the old lady was nearby. She gave Sally a stick so she could hook the ball out of the water.
With a mighty effort, Sally hooked the ball out of trouble. She was so happy to have found it!
The old lady gave Sally a hug and said, "Well done! Now you can play again!"

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl who was feeling miserable found happiness by taking photographs with a boy's camera.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very miserable. She had lost her toy and didn't have anyone to play with. Suddenly, she heard something that made her sit up. It was the sound of a camera snap.
The little girl looked around and saw a boy with a big smile on his face. He was taking pictures with his camera and seemed to be having a great time.
The little girl smiled, too. She decided to go up to the boy and asked him if she could take some photographs too.
The boy nodded and handed her his camera. She was so excited! She snapped photos of trees and flowers and anything that made her smile. She even snapped a few photos of the boy, too.
As the little girl snapped more photos, her smiles got bigger and bigger. Soon, the little girl was no longer miserable. She was happy and content with the world around her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves a thread he found but his brother Luke hates it and takes it away, leaving Timmy sad and missing the thread.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a boy named Timmy. One day he found a thread on the ground and he liked it a lot. The thread was mild and soft. Everyday Timmy loved the thread and he carried it around with him.
But at the same time, Timmy's brother Luke hated the thread. He thought it was nasty and he wanted to get rid of it. He said it was annoying and ugly.
Timmy didn't care what his brother thought. He was still happy with the thread and he kept carrying it around. But one day, Luke was really angry and he took the thread away from Timmy.
Timmy was very sad. He missed the thread so much. He will never forget how mild and nice the thread was. He wished Luke would not hate the thread so much.
Summary: Timmy loves a thread he found but his brother Luke hates it and takes it away, leaving Timmy sad and missing the thread.

instruction:

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack tries to measure the sky but is met with rude responses until his mom comforts him and explains that the sky is too special to be measured.

response:
Once upon a time there was a kid named Jack. Jack was a curious kid and he was always asking questions. He went to the park one day to measure the sky. He asked his mom if he could measure the sky. She thought it was a funny question and smiled. 
Jack went to the park and started to measure the sky with a ruler. He asked a lady parked nearby what she thought. She was a little rude and told him that it was impossible. 
Jack didn't believe her and kept measuring. He asked another person but got the same rude response. He became sad and stopped measuring the sky.
Jack's mom saw him and gave him a big hug. She asked Jack why he was so sad. Jack told her the rude answers he got when he asked if he could measure the sky. 
His mom smiled and said, “It’s ok, Jack. You can’t measure the sky, but that’s why it’s so special!”

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loved her expensive green dress but it got ruined when a naughty boy splashed her with muddy water, and she learned a valuable lesson.

Suddenly, a naughty boy ran past her and splashed her with muddy water. Her dress was ruined, and she started to cry. Her mommy couldn't fix the dress, and Lily was very sad. 
From that day on, Lily never wore her favorite green dress again. She learned that sometimes, even expensive things can be ruined in a splash. The end.

instruction:

But when she opened the jar, the butterfly flew away and never came back. Lily was sad and cried. She learned that sometimes, even when we try to help, things don't always turn out the way we want them to.

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

But suddenly, something changed in the dream. The old man started to shout at the woman and he grabbed her arm. The woman was scared and started to cry. She tried to climb down from the cloud but the old man took her back up and made her stay.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom, a friendly cook, helps a little girl named Amy find her lost toy in the park and shares his food with everyone in the park.
With: happy ending
response:
One sunny day, Tom was in the park serving food to his friends. He saw a little girl named Amy who looked sad. Tom asked her, "Why are you sad, Amy?" Amy said, "I lost my toy in the park, and I can't find it."
Tom wanted to help Amy find her toy. He put down his food and began to look for the toy with Amy. They looked under the trees and behind the bushes. Finally, they found the toy near the swings. Amy was so happy, and Tom's wide smile grew even bigger. They went back to Tom's food and shared it with everyone in the park.
Summary: Tom, a friendly cook, helps a little girl named Amy find her lost toy in the park and shares his food with everyone in the park.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily meets a police officer and tells him he's doing a great job, and the cop encourages her to keep being a good helper and to stay safe.
With: happy ending
response:
"Hi, Mr. Cop!" Lily said. "What are you doing?"
"I'm just walking around the neighborhood to make sure everything is safe," the cop replied.
Lily smiled and said, "That's perfect! You're doing a great job!"
The cop smiled back and said, "Thank you, Lily. Have you been a good girl today?"
"Yes," Lily said. "I helped my mommy wash the dishes and we had lots of fun!"
"That's wonderful," the cop said. "Keep being a good helper and always remember to stay safe." 
Lily waved goodbye to the cop and went back to playing with her toys, feeling happy that she had met a friendly police officer.

instruction:
Write a story about: Nana tries to clean a dirty image on a wall but is interrupted by a boy named Tim who accidentally spills the water they were using to clean.
With: sad ending
response:
Nana started to wash the image on the wall. A small boy named Tim saw her and asked, "Nana, what are you doing?" Nana said, "I am washing the dirty image, Tim. I want it to be clean and pretty again."
Tim wanted to help Nana. But he did not look where he was going. He tripped and fell into the bucket of water. The water spilled all over the ground. Nana and Tim looked at the mess. The image was still dirty, and now there was water everywhere. They were sad that they could not make the image clean and pretty again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sam played knights and dragons with a big box of toys, but Tim's shield was too small. A dog took Tim's shield, and they went home sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim said, "Let's unpack the box and find our shields!" Sam and Tim took out the shields and put them on. Sam's shield was big and fit him well, but Tim's shield was too small. Tim was sad because his shield did not fit right.
They played outside, fighting imaginary dragons. But then, a big dog came and barked at them. Sam used his big shield to protect them, but Tim's small shield did not help. The dog took Tim's shield and ran away. Tim and Sam were very sad and went home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jonny hears his neighbor crying and listens to them until they start laughing, feeling glad that he could help.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a little boy called Jonny. He was very small and quite helpless.
Jonny liked to go outside to play. Today he wanted to go out and explore.
As Jonny opened the door he heard a strange sound coming from outside. It sounded like someone crying. He stepped further and he noticed it was coming from his neighbour's house. He slowly crept closer to the window and he heard the voice again. It was coming from the neighbour's mouth. He couldn't make out what was being said, but he knew that his neighbour was sad.
Jonny couldn't do much to help, so he just stayed outside, listening. Soon enough, he heard the sound of laughter and this time he knew it was coming from the neighbour's mouth too. Jonny smiled to himself because he knew the neighbour was feeling better. 
He was glad that he was able to lend a helpful ear. He smiled and went back to playing.

instruction:
Write a story about: A big cat tries to scare a little mouse but fails and gets stuck in a door. The mouse helps the cat and they become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The little mouse was not scared. He said, "You can't catch me, big cat!" And the little mouse ran away very fast. The big cat tried to catch the little mouse, but he could not.
Then, something unexpected happened. The big cat's long tail got stuck in a big open door. The little mouse saw the big cat and said, "Now, I will scare you, big cat!" And the little mouse said, "Boo!" The big cat was scared and said, "Please help me, little mouse!" So, the little mouse helped the big cat, and they became friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves to dance with her friends in the park, but when a big dog chases them, she gets hurt and is too scared to go back to the park again.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily's friend, Timmy, got scared and started to run away. Lily tried to calm him down and said, "Don't worry, he's harmless. Let's just settle down and stay still." But the dog didn't listen and started to chase them. 
Lily and her friends ran as fast as they could, but the dog was too fast. Lily tripped and fell, hurting her leg. The dog caught up to her and started to bite her. Lily's friends tried to save her, but it was too late. Lily was hurt badly and had to go to the hospital. 
From that day on, Lily never went to the park again. She was too scared to dance and play with her friends. But she always remembered the rhythm of the music and how much fun she had before the bad thing happened.

instruction:
Write a story about: A wise old owl couldn't reach an apple on a tree, took a nap, and a sneaky fox stole the apple while he was sleeping, teaching the owl a lesson to be more careful.
With: sad ending
response:
The owl tried and tried, but he just couldn't get the apple. So he decided to take a nap and try again later. But while he was sleeping, a sneaky fox came and stole the apple.
When the owl woke up, he saw that the apple was gone. He was very sad and went to bed without any dinner. From that day on, the owl learned to be more careful and not to sleep when there was important work to be done.
Summary: A wise old owl couldn't reach an apple on a tree, took a nap, and a sneaky fox stole the apple while he was sleeping, teaching the owl a lesson to be more careful.

instruction:
Write a story about: An ant ignores warnings and climbs a tree, but falls and gets hurt. The bird who tried to help teaches a lesson about listening to friends.
With: sad ending
response:
The ant met a bird on the tree. The bird said, "Why are you going up? It is not safe for you." The ant did not listen and kept going up. The bird tried to help, but the ant said, "No, I can do it."
The ant went higher and higher. It was very scary. Then, the wind blew hard. The ant tried to reverse and go down, but it was too late. The wind pushed the ant off the tree, and the ant fell down.
The bird saw the ant fall and felt sad. The ant was hurt and could not walk. The bird told the other ants what happened. The other ants learned a lesson: always listen to friends who try to help you.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily helps rescue a bird stuck in a tree with the help of her mother and an animal rescue center.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily wanted to help the bird, so she called out to her mommy. "Mommy, come quick! There's a bird in the tree and it needs our help!" said Lily. Her mommy came over and saw the bird too.
Together, they called the animal rescue center and soon a kind man arrived to help the bird. He climbed up the tree and rescued the bird. Lily was so happy that she gave the man a pear as a thank you for helping the bird. From that day on, Lily knew that if she ever saw an animal in trouble, she could call for help and make a difference.
Summary: Lily helps rescue a bird stuck in a tree with the help of her mother and an animal rescue center.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy receives a new toy car, but after accidentally knocking over his toy tower and losing the car, he learns to be careful with his toys.
With: sad ending
response:
He put the new car next to his other cars and started to play. But then, Timmy accidentally knocked over his toy tower, and all of his cars fell down. Timmy got upset and started to cry. 
Suddenly, Timmy's little sister came in and saw him crying. She wanted to help him feel better, so she tried to give him a hug. But when she did, she accidentally released the new toy car and it rolled away. Timmy was even more upset now because he lost his new toy. 
In the end, Timmy learned that accidents happen and it's okay to be upset, but he also learned to be careful with his toys. The light in his room was turned off as he went to bed, still feeling sad about his lost toy.
Summary: Timmy receives a new toy car, but after accidentally knocking over his toy tower and losing the car, he learns to be careful with his toys.

instruction:
Write a story about: A new planet is introduced with happy animals and nice people. When a big, round thing falls from the sky, a funny-looking animal comes out and becomes friends with the people, making the planet an even better place to live.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, something strange happened. A big, round thing fell from the sky. It made a loud noise when it hit the ground. The people were scared and didn't know what it was. So they went to look at it. The big, round thing started to open, and out came a funny-looking animal.
The funny-looking animal was not scary at all. It was nice and wanted to play with the people. The people were happy and played with the animal all day. They all became good friends. And the new planet was an even better place to live. Everyone was happy, and they all lived happily ever after.
Summary: A new planet is introduced with happy animals and nice people. When a big, round thing falls from the sky, a funny-looking animal comes out and becomes friends with the people, making the planet an even better place to live.

instruction:
Write a story about: A deer goes for a walk in the woods and meets a rabbit who suggests they play a matching game. The deer tries to match different things and gets scolded by the rabbit, causing the deer to feel sad and alone.
With: sad ending
response:
The deer met a rabbit. The rabbit said, "Hello, deer! Do you want to play a game? We can match things that are the same." The deer said, "Yes, I want to play!" The rabbit and the deer started to match things. They matched big rocks, green leaves, and soft grass.
But then, the deer tried to match two different things. The deer tried to match a big tree and a small flower. The rabbit said, "No, deer! Those are not the same. They are different." The deer did not understand. The deer tried to match them again. The rabbit got mad and left. The deer was sad and alone.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily learns to overcome her fear of snakes and shows compassion by helping a butterfly with a broken wing.
With: happy ending
response:
Later that day, Lily saw a butterfly with a broken wing. She wanted to help it, but didn't know how. Her dad reminded her that sometimes we can show compassion by just being kind and gentle.
Lily carefully picked up the butterfly and placed it on a flower. She watched as it fluttered its wings and flew away. She felt happy knowing that she had helped a little creature.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes on a fun adventure with her mommy to row a boat, but is disappointed when she can't climb a tree or pet a dog. When they return home, Lily's daddy is sick and passes away, leaving her very sad.
With: sad ending
response:
After they finished rowing, Lily wanted to go on another adventure. She saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. But her mommy said it was too dangerous and they should go home. Lily was sad but listened to her mommy.
On the way home, they saw a big dog. Lily wanted to pet the dog but her mommy said it was not safe. The dog was not friendly and might bite her. Lily listened to her mommy and did not use her hand to pet the dog.
When they got home, Lily was happy to see her daddy. But he was not feeling well. He had a fever and was very sick. Lily's mommy called the doctor but it was too late. Daddy passed away and Lily was very sad. She hugged her soft teddy bear and cried.

instruction:
Write a story about: A frog tries to catch a butterfly but gets tired and plays with a tube of oxygen, but squeezes it too hard and falls asleep forever, teaching his friends a lesson.
With: sad ending
response:
The frog got tired and decided to rest. He saw a tube with oxygen and thought it was a toy. He squeezed it and the oxygen came out. The frog felt very happy and started to play with it.
But then, the frog squeezed too hard and the oxygen ran out. The frog couldn't breathe anymore and fell asleep forever. His friends were very sad and missed him a lot. They learned to never play with things they didn't know.
Summary: A frog tries to catch a butterfly but gets tired and plays with a tube of oxygen, but squeezes it too hard and falls asleep forever, teaching his friends a lesson.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy visits a planetarium for the first time and is shown a special image of an original planet, which amazes him.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy's mommy told him that they were going to visit a planetarium. Timmy was so excited! He had never been to a planetarium before. 
At the planetarium, Timmy saw a big screen that showed the stars and planets. The lady who worked there told Timmy that she was going to show him something very special. 
The lady turned off the lights and the screen showed a picture of an original planet. Timmy was amazed! He had never seen anything like it before. He knew that he would always remember this special trip to the planetarium.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily plays outside and jumps in a puddle, getting her shoes wet. Her mom helps her dry them in the sun while they draw a picture together.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom saw her wet shoes and said, "Lily, let's dry your shoes now." Lily took off her shoes and put them in the sun. The sun was warm and would help her shoes dry fast.
While they waited, Lily's mom gave her a piece of paper. "Let's draw a picture together," she said. Lily was happy and drew a big sun. Her mom drew a tree. They laughed and had fun. Soon, Lily's shoes were dry and she could play outside again.
Summary: Lily plays outside and jumps in a puddle, getting her shoes wet. Her mom helps her dry them in the sun while they draw a picture together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A creative bird gets lost while exploring far away and makes a special bird call to call out for help from his friends, who eventually find and guide him home.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a very creative bird. He liked to explore and try new things. He would often fly far away to search for new places.
One day, the bird got a bit too daring. He flew so far away that he couldn't find his way home. He tried and tried but he just couldn't find it.
The bird felt very sad and scared. He didn't know how to get home. He started to cry. 
However, his creative brain had an idea. He made a special bird call. He thought that if he called out, his friends would help him find his way back.
Soon enough, he heard a reply back. It was his friends, who had been searching for him. With their help, the bird was able to find his way home and he never lost again.
Summary: A creative bird gets lost while exploring far away and makes a special bird call to call out for help from his friends, who eventually find and guide him home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom, an adventurous boy, found a camera and took a picture of a bird but broke the camera when he fell into a puddle, teaching him to be more careful.
With: sad ending
response:
Tom went outside and saw a bird. "I will shoot an image of you, bird!" he said. The bird looked at Tom and said, "Okay, but be quick! I have to fly away soon." Tom was happy and took a picture of the bird.
But Tom was not careful. He tripped and fell into a puddle. The camera got wet and broke. Tom cried because he could not shoot any more images. He learned to be more careful next time. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Nicky's aunt teaches him to dive and catch a beach ball, and he eventually succeeds, feeling proud of himself.
With: happy ending
response:
Nicky was out in the backyard with his aunt. He loved when she visited, because she was always playing the funnest games with him.
Today, they were playing with a beach ball. Nicky's aunt was throwing it up in the air and laughing. "Now, Nicky!" she said. "Can you dive underneath it and catch it?"
Nicky smiled and tried his hardest. He put his hands out and jumped, but the ball was too high. His aunt clapped for him. "That's okay, try again!"
Nicky kept trying and eventually he was able to dive for the ball. He caught it in his hands. His aunt cheered and said, "Wow, that was so rare! You are very special, Nicky." 
Nicky was happy to know that he could do something rare. He gave his aunt a big hug and thanked her. From then on, he always felt proud of himself when he was able to dive and catch the ball.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Sarah asks her mum for food, but her mum tells her she needs to receive a poem first. Her mum gives her a special poem that encourages her to follow her dreams and be kind.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there lived a little girl named Sarah. She was only three years old and very hungry. She went to her mum and asked for something to eat. Her mum said, "No Sarah, you are not allowed to eat something yet. First you need to receive your poem." 
Sarah was surprised. What was a poem? She asked her mum, "What is a poem, mum?"
Her mum smiled and said, "A poem is a beautiful thing made of words. I have something special for you."
She handed Sarah a beautiful poem. It was written on a piece of paper with strange shapes and words. It said:
"A happy heart can never be hungry
You'll never be sad as long as you are kind
Follow your dreams and you will find
The world is full of treasures that you can discover!"
Sarah smiled. She said, "Thank you, mum! I will follow my dreams and never be hungry!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy and his family go on a beach trip, but their stay is ruined by a rude hotel employee and an accident that sends Timmy's dad to the hospital.
With: sad ending
response:
But when they arrived at the hotel, the lady at the front desk was very rude to Timmy's family. She didn't smile and didn't say "hello". Timmy's mom and dad tried to be nice, but the lady didn't want to help them.
Later that day, Timmy and his family went to the beach. They were having so much fun building sandcastles and swimming in the ocean. But suddenly, a big wave struck and Timmy's dad got hurt. They had to go to the hospital and their trip was ruined.
Timmy was sad that their trip ended badly, but he was happy that his dad was okay. He wished that the lady at the hotel wasn't so rude and maybe they could have had a better trip.

instruction:
Write a story about: A great duck goes for a swim every morning and one day a wildfire starts near the pond, but a firefighter comes to the rescue and saves the duck.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a great duck. He was the best duck ever. Every morning he would go for a swim in the pond, and the sun would burn his feathers. Sometimes he would stay in the pond all day, playing with his friends. 
One day, a wildfire started near the pond. The smoke made it hard for little duck to breathe. Then the fire reached the pond. The great duck was scared and tried to escape. But the fire was burning too fast! 
Suddenly, a firefighter came to the rescue. She sprayed some water and put out the fire. The great duck was safe now. He thanked the firefighter with a little quack, and she laughed. The firefighter said it was a great thing that he was able to escape. 
The great duck went back to swimming in the pond, happy and relieved. Now every morning, he looks up at the sky and remembers the firefighter who saved him.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two friends, Timmy and Sally, play with a laser toy in the park and unite during a storm, realizing they can always count on each other.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, they found a laser toy. It was shiny and bright. They played with it for hours, running and chasing the laser dot.
But then, a big storm came. Timmy and Sally got scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, they remembered that when they unite, they are strong.
So, they held hands and stood together. The storm passed and they were safe. From that day on, they knew that they could always count on each other.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily wanted to join a bird outside but her mother said no. She fell out of the window and got hurt, and from then on, she listened to her mother.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily asked her mommy, "Can I go outside and join the bird?" 
Her mommy said, "No, Lily. It's not safe." 
Lily was sad and went to her room. She opened the window and tried to reach the bird. But she lost her balance and fell out of the window. 
Lily got hurt and had to go to the hospital. Her mommy was very worried and wished she had let Lily join the bird. From then on, Lily always listened to her mommy and never tried to join anything dangerous again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Friends gather to play a game in a big stadium and work together to set it up before having an exciting time playing together.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a big stadium. All the friends gathered to play a game. To start the game, they first had to set it up.
They all worked together to get the stadium ready. First, they put all the pieces together. Then, they made sure each part fit nicely. Finally, they put the ball in the middle.
Now, the stadium was all set for a big game. Everyone cheered and clapped as the players started kicking and throwing the ball around. They had an exciting time playing together.
The friends played for a long time until it was time to go home. They packed up the stadium and said goodbye. They had a lot of fun playing together in the big stadium.
Summary: Friends gather to play a game in a big stadium and work together to set it up before having an exciting time playing together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A small diamond sparkles and glimmers so brightly that animals want it to live with them, but the diamond stays put and continues to shine.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a small diamond. It sparkled and glimmered so brightly that everyone wanted to keep it. 
In the diamond’s home, foxes and rabbits were very excited about it. They begged the diamond to come and live with them, but the diamond wanted to stay put.
So the diamond kept sparkling and glimmering no matter how much the animals asked it to leave. The diamond was so small and precious, they didn’t want it to go. 
But no matter how hard the animals tried, the diamond stayed where it was. The diamond was determined to keep shining, right where it was.
And so it did, until the end of time. The diamond kept sparkling and always stayed small and shiny.

instruction:
Write a story about: A curious little girl learns about the dangers of a razor when she picks it up and almost drops it. She learns to keep dangerous things away from her.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a little girl. She was very curious about the world around her. Every day she asked her mom and dad lots of questions about the things she saw and the things she could do.
One day her mom showed her a razor. It was small and shiny and it made her curious. Her mom told her that it was a special tool that was very dangerous and she should never touch it.
But one day while her mom was away, the little girl saw the razor on the counter and wanted to have a closer look. She picked it up and looked at it carefully, but when she rose it in the air, it almost slipped out of her hands. She knew that she had to put it back before her mom returned.
The little girl learned her lesson that day and never touched the razor again. She knew that anything that was dangerous must be kept away from her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom the unique cat and his owner Sam went to a shop to order food, but Tom got a fish with a sharp bone in it, causing him pain and ruining their day. They never ordered fish from the shop again.
With: sad ending
response:
At the shop, Sam said, "I want to order a big ice cream!" Tom the cat wanted a fish. The shop lady gave them their food. They sat down to eat. Tom started to eat his fish, but it had a sharp bone in it.
"Oh no, Tom!" Sam cried. "You have pain from the fish bone!" Tom meowed and cried. They went home feeling sad. The fish bone made Tom's day bad, and they never ordered fish from the shop again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl becomes angry and impatient waiting to try her mom's freshly baked pastry, and when it's finally ready, she's too full of hate to try it and runs away.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a little girl. She could not wait to try the pastry that her mom had just made. The aroma of the freshly baked pastry was making her tummy grumble. She asked if she could take a bite, but her mom said that it wasn't ready yet.
The little girl became very angry. She had been waiting for a long time and was impatient. She began to hate the pastry. 
Finally, the pastry was ready and the mom told the little girl that she could have a bite. But it was too late. The little girl was so angry and full of hate that she ran away and never tried the pastry. 
The little girl never knew how delicious the pastry was. Sadness and disappointment was all she will ever have of the pastry.

instruction:
Write a story about: A hero learns the importance of sharing and playing together with friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who wanted to play all day. His friends wanted to play too but the hero didn't want to share. He wanted to be the only one playing.
One day, the hero's friends tried to join him. “Let us play too!” they cried. But the hero said no. He was too stubborn to share.
But then, something funny happened. He suddenly saw how silly he was being - after all, playing together can be much more fun! So the hero let his friends join in the play.
The moral of the story is: it is always better to share and play together.
Summary: A hero learns the importance of sharing and playing together with friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim befriends a small bird and they have lots of fun together, bringing joy and happiness into Tim's life.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a young boy named Tim who loved to play in the sun. His days were so bright and filled with joy. One day, Tim was feeling very sad because he was alone. He wished he had someone to play with.
Then, Tim spotted a small bird in the sky. It was shining bright with youth and vigour. Tim waved to the bird, hoping he could be its friend. To his surprise, the bird flew down and landed beside him.
Tim and the bird had lots of fun together. They played tag and explored the garden, filling their days with laughter and smiles. They became the best of friends and their joy was so bright that it lit up the whole sky. 
The days filled with friendship and fun soon came to an end. But Tim would never forget his special friendship with the bird. Whenever he felt lonely, he remembered how full of joy his days were, and he was filled with happiness all over again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A fearful bear finds a new home and decorates it with leaves, flowers, and sticks to make it pretty. As he starts to feel less scared, he makes friends with other animals in the forest and learns that a happy home can make you brave.
With: happy ending
response:
The bear decided to decorate his new home. He found some leaves, flowers, and sticks to make it look nice. He put the leaves on the floor, the flowers on the walls, and the sticks in a pile. The bear was very happy with his work.
As the days went by, the bear started to feel less fearful. He liked his decorated cave and felt safe inside it. He even made friends with other animals in the forest. The bear learned that when you make your home a happy place, you can be brave and not scared.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim tries to befriend a tree in the woods by giving it a hug, but the tree becomes angry and traps him in its branches, leaving him unable to return home or play with his friends.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim went to the tree and gave it a big squeeze. But something unexpected happened! The tree's face changed and it looked very mad. The tree started to shake and Tim got scared.
Then, the tree's branches grabbed Tim and lifted him high up in the air. Tim cried for help, but no one could hear him. The tree kept Tim up in the air and he could not go home. This was a bad ending for Tim because he could not play with his friends anymore.
Summary: Tim tries to befriend a tree in the woods by giving it a hug, but the tree becomes angry and traps him in its branches, leaving him unable to return home or play with his friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little cat encounters a scary lion and runs away, but the lion catches up and eats the cat.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a furry little cat. He was so happy, he always played and purred.
One day, he heard a loud roar coming from behind a bookshelf. The little cat peered around the corner to see what was making the noise. It was a scary, big lion!
The lion looked at the little cat and said, "You look tasty. I'm gonna eat you!" The little cat was so scared, he started to shake. Then he ran away as fast as he could.
But the lion was too big and too fast for the little cat. The lion caught up with the little cat and he roared again. This time, the little cat knew it was the end. The last thing the little cat heard was a loud roar from the furry lion.
Summary: A little cat encounters a scary lion and runs away, but the lion catches up and eats the cat.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the circus with her family, loses her ticket, and misses the show, but is helped by a kind person.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, when the show finished, something terrible happened. Lily lost her ticket! She searched and searched, but it was nowhere to be found. Her family had to leave without her because they couldn't find her ticket either. Poor Lily was all alone and very sad. 
She cried and cried until a kind person helped her find her family. But it was too late, the circus had already finished and Lily missed everything. She learned a valuable lesson to always take good care of her ticket. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy loves exploring and finds an insect in the park, but it ends up biting her and she has to go home early.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She loved to explore the world, and loved to go to new places. 
One day, Lucy took her favourite toy and went for a walk in the park. As she looked around she thought she saw something very delicious. It was an insect! Lucy was so excited that she took it in her hands. 
The insect was very curious, and so it crawled all over her hands. Its tickly legs were so soft. But Lucy was so excited that she didn't worry about its tickley legs. 
But then, something horrible happened. The insect bit Lucy's hand, and it hurt very badly. Lucy screamed, and started to cry. It was not a very delicious experience anymore. 
Sadly, Lucy had to go home early, her hand hurt too much. She vowed to never take an insect again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A sad baby receives toys from a truck that delivers them every day, making him happy and filling his room with toys.
With: happy ending
response:

instruction:
Write a story about: Spot the dog loves to play with his toy, but when he sees a light in the sky, he chases it and meets a new friend, Whiskers the cat, and they play together trying to catch the light.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Spot saw a light in the sky. It was a pretty light that moved around. Spot wanted to chase the light. He ran and ran, trying to catch the light. Spot was very persistent. He did not give up. He wanted to catch the light so bad.
As Spot chased the light, he met a new friend. The new friend was a cat named Whiskers. Whiskers liked to chase the light too. Spot and Whiskers played together, trying to catch the light. They were both very persistent. They did not catch the light, but they had fun playing together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A friendly ghost lives in a dark and scary cave but decides to take a walk around the neighborhood. He gets scared and runs back to his cave, regretting not being brave enough to stay and play with the people.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there lived a friendly ghost who was always happy. He lived in a dark and scary cave, but never seemed to regret living there.
One day, the friendly ghost decided to take a walk around the neighborhood. He saw lots of people running and screaming and was very scared. He wanted to stay and play with them, but he was too scared to do that.
The ghost was so scared that he ran back to the dark and scary cave. As soon as he stepped in, he seemed to regret coming there. He wished he had been brave enough to stay outside and play with the people.
It was too late now; the friendly ghost had already made his choice. He stayed in the dark cave forever, wishing that he had been braver.

instruction:
Write a story about: A dad and son take a walk, but they end up quarreling and the son runs away, leaving the dad alone.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a dad and a son. They usually played together nicely. 
One day, they decided to take a walk. The dad was feeling very polite, so he held his son’s hand and said nice things to him. 
But then, they started to quarrel. The dad said unkind words, and the son started to cry. 
The son was so sad. He did not want to go for a walk anymore and he ran away from his dad. 
The dad was very sorry. He tried to call his son back, but it was too late – the son was gone and the dad walked home alone.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max, a little dog, finds a shiny ball in the park and refuses to share it with his friend Lily. He later swallows the ball and dies, teaching the lesson to not value material things too much and to share.
With: sad ending
response:
Max's friend, a little girl named Lily, saw the ball and wanted to play with it too. "Can I play with your ball, Max?" asked Lily. Max replied, "No, this is my ball. I value it too much to share."
Lily felt sad and left the park. Later that day, Max went home and accidentally swallowed the ball while playing with it. He got very sick and had to go to the vet. The vet tried to help Max, but it was too late. Max passed away.
The moral of the story is that it's important to share and not value material things too much. Max learned this lesson too late, but we can learn from his mistake.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily forces her dog Max to eat a bitter bone, which poisons him and leads to his death. She learns the important lesson of not forcing anyone to do something they don't want to do.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Lily found a bone that was very bitter. She wanted to give it to Max, but he didn't like it at all. Max refused to eat it and Lily got angry. She put the bone in Max's mouth and forced him to eat it.
Soon after, Max got very sick and had to go to the vet. The vet said that Max was poisoned by the bitter bone and unfortunately, Max didn't make it. Lily was very sad and regretted forcing Max to eat the bone. She learned a very important lesson that day - never force anyone to do something they don't want to do.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes on a picnic with her family, but refuses to share cookies and later takes an apple from the woods that doesn't belong to her, resulting in a chase with a bear. The moral of the story is not to be selfish and take things that don't belong to you.
With: sad ending
response:
Later that day, they went for a walk in the woods. Lily saw a big, shiny apple and wanted to take it home. Her mommy said no because it belonged to the animals. But Lily didn't listen and took the apple anyway. As they walked back to the car, they saw a bear. The bear smelled the apple and chased after them. They ran as fast as they could, but the bear caught up to Lily and took the apple from her.
The moral of the story is that it's not good to be selfish and take things that don't belong to you. If Lily had shared the cookies and listened to her mommy, she wouldn't have lost the apple to the bear.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily finds a dead bird and feels sad for it. Her mom tells her they can't help it, but they can remember it. Lily has a dream that the bird comes back to life, but wakes up to find it was just a dream.
With: sad ending
response:
"Mommy, there is a dead bird outside. Can we help it?" Lily asked. Her mom looked at her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. We can't help the bird now. But we can say a nice thing for it and remember it."
Lily and her mom went outside to see the bird. The bird was yellow and very pretty. They said some nice words for the bird and wished it could fly again. But the bird did not move. Lily felt very sad and cried.
That night, Lily had a dream. In her dream, the yellow bird came back to life and flew away. But when she woke up, she knew it was just a dream. The bird was still dead, and Lily was still sad. The world felt a little less bright without the yellow bird.

instruction:
Write a story about: Speedy the car wins a race against his friend Timmy the Truck after moving a rock from the road to make it safe.
With: happy ending
response:
Speedy said, "Yes, but I need some time. I will meet you at the big tree soon."
While Speedy was waiting, he saw a big rock on the road. He thought, "I must move this rock. It's not safe for the race." So, he pushed the rock away.
When it was time for the race, Speedy and Timmy started to go fast. Timmy was in front, but Speedy was catching up. They were almost at the finish line when Timmy saw the spot where the rock used to be. He was scared and slowed down, but Speedy knew it was safe.
Speedy won the race and Timmy said, "Thank you for moving the rock. You are a good friend." They both smiled and knew they would have more fun races in the future.
Summary: Speedy the car wins a race against his friend Timmy the Truck after moving a rock from the road to make it safe.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lion plays with a knob in a cave and breaks it. He learns a lesson about being careful with other people's things and not being too noisy.
With: happy ending
response:
He realized that he shouldn't have played with things that didn't belong to him. He felt bad and decided to go and apologize to the owner of the cave. The owner forgave him and told him that it's important to be careful with other people's things. 
From that day on, the lion learned to be more careful and not to make too much noise. He realized that being noisy all the time wasn't good and that it's important to be considerate of others.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily gives her shoes to a boy who has none and walks home barefoot, feeling proud of herself.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, Lily saw a boy who had no shoes on his feet. She felt sad because she knew he must feel cold. She took off her own shoes and gave them to the boy. The boy felt grateful and put them on his feet. 
Lily walked home with no shoes on her feet, but she felt proud and happy. Her mom asked her why she wasn't wearing shoes and Lily said, "I gave them to a boy who needed them more than me. It makes me feel humble." Her mom hugged her and felt proud of her kind heart.
Summary: Lily gives her shoes to a boy who has none and walks home barefoot, feeling proud of herself.

instruction:
Write a story about: Peter picks a regular muffin from the bakery, but it starts moving and follows him home, eventually eating his bed.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little boy called Peter. Peter decided he wanted to pick a muffin. So he went to the bakery to pick one. At the bakery, there were lots of different muffins. But Peter wanted something regular, so he picked a regular muffin. 
But when Peter picked it, the muffin began to move! Peter was scared so he decided to throw it away, but it kept following him. In the end, the muffin chased him all the way home. 
When Peter got to his house the muffin was still there. He was really scared so he ran upstairs and hid in his bedroom. But the muffin followed him and ate his bed! Poor Peter had nowhere to sleep that night. 
Luckily, the next day his mum helped him make a new bed. But Peter was still a bit scared of muffins.

instruction:
Write a story about: Bob's new bike tire bursts, but a kind stranger comes to the rescue and fixes it for him for free.
With: happy ending
response:
Bob had a fierce new tire on his bike. He was excited to get on and ride around the block. He excitedly raced around with his friends and loved the feeling of the wind in his face.
But Bob wasn't prepared for the big bump in the road. Suddenly, the tire burst and Bob had to stop his bike. His friends saw what happened and they all raced off to get help.
Bob was left alone with his broken tire. He was very sad and didn't know what to do. But then a kind stranger came and saw what had happened. The man said he could fix the tire for Bob, so the little boy happily agreed.
The stranger worked hard to repair the tire and Bob was very impressed. The man even gave the tire to Bob for free! Now, Bob was the proud owner of his own fierce tire. He thanked the mysterious man and raced off with his bike, ready to show his friends. He was happy and proud of his tire, and never forgot the kindness of the stranger.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's friend accidentally breaks her beloved toy bear, causing Lily to feel sad and wish her friend had been more careful.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily said, "You can borrow it, but please be careful." Her friend took the bear and squeezed it too hard. The bear's head popped off! 
Lily was very upset and said, "Why did you squeeze my bear so hard? Now it's broken!" Her friend said sorry, but it was too late. Lily's bear was broken and she couldn't fix it. She felt very sad and wished her friend had been more careful.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lonely temple on a hill becomes happy when a little boy named Tim visits it every day.
With: happy ending
response:
One sunny day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw the lonely temple on the hill and decided to go see it. As he walked up the hill, the temple started to feel happy.
When Tim reached the temple, he said, "Please, don't be lonely. I will visit you every day." The temple felt very happy and thanked Tim. From that day on, the temple was never lonely again because Tim always came to visit.

instruction:
Write a story about: A helpful bus driver named Bob's bus broke down and a little girl named Lily fixed it, teaching Bob an important lesson about how even little kids can be helpful.
With: happy ending
response:
Bob was sad because he couldn't help the people who needed to go places. But then, a little girl named Lily came up to him and asked if she could help. Bob was surprised, but he let her try.
Lily looked at the engine and saw that a wire was loose. She fixed it and the bus started working again! Bob was so grateful and he learned an important lesson: sometimes, even little kids can be helpful and fix big problems.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy takes a lollipop from the store without her mom's permission and feels guilty, but confesses to her mom and learns to ask before taking something next time.
With: happy ending
response:
Lucy felt sad but she wanted the lollipop so much. She took the lollipop when her mom was not looking. Lucy felt guilty, but she wanted to enjoy the sweet treat. She hid the lollipop in her pocket and went home with her mom.
At home, Lucy ate the lollipop in her room. It was very yummy. But she still felt guilty. She knew it was wrong to take something without asking. Lucy went to her mom and said, "I'm sorry, I took the lollipop from the store." Her mom hugged her and said, "Thank you for telling me. Next time, we will ask before taking something."
Summary: Lucy takes a lollipop from the store without her mom's permission and feels guilty, but confesses to her mom and learns to ask before taking something next time.

instruction:
Write a story about: A young monkey wants to eat a banana from a tree but can't reach it, so he asks his friends for help. A snake offers to help him get the banana, but after getting it, the snake eats it all without giving any to the young monkey.
With: sad ending
response:
So, the young monkey asked his friends for help. They tried to climb the tree, but they couldn't. The young monkey felt sad because he really wanted to eat the banana. Suddenly, a snake appeared and offered to help the young monkey get the banana.
The young monkey was scared of the snake, but he really wanted the banana. So, he agreed to let the snake help him. But when the snake got the banana, he didn't give it to the young monkey. Instead, he ate it all himself. The young monkey was very sad and learned to never trust a snake.

instruction:
Write a story about: A kind lion goes for a walk and finds a pear tree, which he shares with other animals who are amazed by his kind spirit and roaring.
With: happy ending
response: Once there was a kind lion. He liked to take long walks and eat juicy pears. He liked to roar too! Every day he roamed the jungle and searched for nice, ripe pears. He roared if he was happy or if he saw something interesting. One special day, he saw a pear tree! He quickly ran to the tree and started to munch on the sweet pears. He was so happy that he started to roar! All of the other animals heard the lion's roaring and were amazed by his kind spirit. They all followed the lion and gathered around the tree. Everyone was happy that the lion had found the pear tree and even more so at his kind roar.

instruction:
Write a story about: A knight on a quest to find an oasis in the desert is helped by a persistent voice that leads him to the oasis.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there lived a brave knight. He was on a quest to find an oasis in the desert. He rode his horse through the hot sand, searching and searching. He just wasn't sure where the oasis was. 
Then, he heard a voice. It asked, “Are you looking for an oasis?” The knight was so surprised, but he answered, “Yes.” The voice said, “I know where it is. Follow me.” 
The knight followed the voice. After a while of walking and riding, they made it to the oasis. It was a beautiful sight! But the knight was tired. 
He asked the voice, “How did you know where it was?” The voice answered, “I'm persistent. I never give up searching.” The knight was so grateful and thanked the voice. Then he filled his canteen with water from the oasis, and his quest was complete.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily falls into a drain in a park and her mother is unable to save her, leading to the park becoming a place of remembrance for her.
With: sad ending
response:
"Look, mommy!" she said, pointing to a drain on the ground. "I want to see what's inside."
Her mommy warned her not to touch it, but Lily didn't listen. She opened the drain and looked inside. Suddenly, she fell in and couldn't get out. Her mommy tried to help, but it was too late. The park became a popular place for people to remember the little girl who fell in the drain.
Summary: A little girl named Lily falls into a drain in a park and her mother is unable to save her, leading to the park becoming a place of remembrance for her.

instruction:
Write a story about: A patient waiting alone starts clapping with joy, but a crack in the ground swallows him up, teaching the lesson to always be careful.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a big patient. He had been waiting for a long time, but nobody had come. He decided to show his joy, so he started to clap.
Immediately, a little girl noticed his clapping. "What are you doing?" she asked.
The patient replied: "I am just so happy that I'm clapping".
The little girl started to clap with him, and their happy clapping continued for a few minutes.
Suddenly the ground started shaking and a big crack opened near where the patient was standing. The ground quickly swallowed the patient, and the bottomless pit closed up again.
The little girl was very sad and scared, and she ran away as fast as she could. The patient was gone.
The moral of the story is that no matter how patient you are, it's important to always be careful. Don't do anything that might be dangerous!

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy and his friends have a race at the park, but Timmy stops to pick up a penny and loses the race. However, his friends come back to him and tell him that they just want to have fun with him, making Timmy grateful for their kindness.
With: happy ending
response:
As they were running, Timmy saw a shiny penny on the ground. He stopped to pick it up and put it in his pocket. But when he looked up, he realized that his friends were already at the finish line.
Timmy felt sad that he lost the race, but then something unexpected happened. His friends came back to him and said, "We don't care who won the race, we just want to have fun with you!" Timmy felt happy and grateful that he had such kind friends. He bowed to them and said, "Thank you for being my friends."
Summary: Timmy and his friends have a race at the park, but Timmy stops to pick up a penny and loses the race. However, his friends come back to him and tell him that they just want to have fun with him, making Timmy grateful for their kindness.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim is a dependable kid who likes to help his parents and hang his clothes on a little line in his room. One day, he discovers that his clothes are missing and finds out that his little sister, Lily, had hidden them. They end up hanging their clothes together and become dependable kids.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Tim went to hang his clothes, but there was a big surprise. His clothes were gone! Tim was sad and confused. He looked all around his room, but he could not find them.
Then, Tim heard a giggle. He looked under his bed and saw his little sister, Lily. She was hiding his clothes! Tim was not sad anymore, he just laughed. Lily wanted to be just like her big brother. From that day on, Tim and Lily hung their clothes together. They were both dependable kids.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny goes on a journey with his mom to visit his grandma and enjoy her delicious carrot cake.
With: happy ending
response:
Benny and his mom packed a basket full of snacks and started their journey. They walked and walked until Benny's little legs got tired. His mom told him to relax and rest for a bit. Benny laid down in the grass and watched the clouds go by. 
After a while, they got up and continued their journey. They walked through a forest and saw many animals along the way. Finally, they arrived at grandma's house. Benny was so happy to see her and even happier when she gave him a slice of her great carrot cake. Benny knew it was worth the journey to see his grandma and eat her delicious cake.

instruction:
Write a story about: Benny the bunny drowns trying to cross a river to get a carrot, and his friends remember him as brave and caring.
With: sad ending
response:
Benny hopped into the river and started to swim, but the current was too strong. Suddenly, Benny got tired and couldn't swim anymore. He tried to call for help, but no one could hear him over the sound of the rushing water. Sadly, Benny drowned in the river and never got to eat the carrot he wanted so badly.
The other bunnies in the forest were very sad when they heard about Benny's accident. They missed their friend and wished he had never tried to part the water. From then on, they remembered Benny as a brave bunny who loved his fluffy tail and always wanted the best for his friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Daisy finds an old film in a tree and watches it repeatedly, feeling happy about her discovery.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old. Daisy had a favourite thing to do. She loved to play with her little ball. 
One day, she wanted to kick the ball so she ran out into the garden. She kicked it higher and higher. Suddenly, the ball jumped up and landed on a tree. It looked very weird. 
When Daisy looked up into the tree, she saw something strange. It was a film! It had been hanging there so long that it was almost falling out of the tree. Daisy was very excited. 
So, she ran inside and got a big step ladder. She climbed up to the top and pulled the film down. Then, she carried it inside and discovered that it was an old movie! 
Daisy watched it again and again. She was so happy that she had found that weird film up in the tree. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A man with a mustache and his friend climb a hill to find something special, but the friend causes an accident that leaves the man with the mustache unable to help others.
With: sad ending
response:
While walking, they saw a big hill. The friend said, "Let's climb the hill to gain what we want!" The man with the mustache agreed. They climbed and climbed, but the hill was very steep.
At the top of the hill, they found a big rock. The friend tried to lift the rock, but it was too heavy. The rock fell down the hill and hit the man with the mustache. He got hurt very badly. The friend was sad, and the man with the mustache could not help others anymore. The end.
Summary: A man with a mustache and his friend climb a hill to find something special, but the friend causes an accident that leaves the man with the mustache unable to help others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A big cat and small dog race near a road, but the small dog is too slow and gets hit by a car.
With: sad ending
response:
The big cat said to the small dog, "I demand you to race me to the other side of the road!" The small dog did not want to race, but he did not want the big cat to be mad. So, he said, "Okay, I will race you."
They started to race. The big cat was very fast, but the small dog was not. The big cat ran to the other side of the road and waited for the small dog. The small dog tried to run fast, but a big car came. The small dog could not get out of the way in time. The big cat saw what happened and felt sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: Children find a box of juice in the park but are stopped by a policeman from opening it.
With: sad ending
response:
The children were playing in the park one day. They saw something interesting. One of the children, Lisa, said, "What could that be?". 
The children went closer to observe. It was a box of juice! The children were so excited. They wanted to open the box and share the juice. 
The children started to open the juice, but a policeman saw them. He said, "No! You can't open that. It doesn't belong to you". 
The children were sad. They wanted the juice but they couldn't have it. They had to leave the park and go home. It was a bad ending to their day.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her family go on a safari and get stuck in a storm, forcing them to spend the night in their car and learn the lesson that it's better to be safe than sorry.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Lily and her family went on a safari. They saw lots of animals and had a yummy picnic. But then, they heard a loud noise. It was a big storm coming! 
Lily's mommy tried to comfort her, but she was scared. They tried to drive back to their camp, but the storm was too strong. The car got stuck in the mud. 
Lily and her family had to spend the night in the car. They were cold and wet. They wished they had stayed at their camp. The storm was so loud and scary. Finally, in the morning, the storm stopped. But Lily and her family were very tired and sad. They learned that sometimes it's better to be safe than sorry.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the mall with her mommy, but accidentally bumps into a man carrying bags and breaks them, causing her mommy to pay a lot of money. She learns her lesson and never runs in the mall again.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily didn't want to go shopping, but she followed her mommy anyway. As they were walking, Lily saw a big, shiny ball and she wanted to play with it. She ran towards it and accidentally bumped into a man carrying a lot of bags. The bags fell and broke, and the man got very angry. He yelled at Lily's mommy and they had to pay a lot of money to replace the things that were broken.
Lily felt very sad and scared. She didn't understand what had happened, but she knew it was her fault. From that day on, she never ran in the mall again.
Summary: Lily goes to the mall with her mommy, but accidentally bumps into a man carrying bags and breaks them, causing her mommy to pay a lot of money. She learns her lesson and never runs in the mall again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A girl tries to paint a picture but fails repeatedly, gets frustrated, and asks for help but still cannot make it look perfect.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a girl. She wanted to succeed in painting a picture. She tried and tried, but no matter what she tried she couldn't make it look pretty. She tried again and again, but the paintbrush just slipped out of her hand and made a mess. 
The girl was getting very sad and frustrated. She wanted to make it look pretty and make it perfect. She just couldn't seem to get it right. 
Finally, she decided to ask for help. She asked her mom and her dad, but they couldn't show her how to paint the picture. Then the girl thought she should try again, and this time she would be more careful. 
But still, no matter what she did, she couldn't make it look pretty. In the end, the girl never succeeded in making her painting look perfect.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her friends pretend to be in different seasons and have fun, but their day ends sadly when they get caught in the rain.
With: sad ending
response:
They chose to play in the cold season, with snow and ice. They made pretend snowballs and had a snowball fight. They built a big snowman with a funny hat. They laughed and had fun, but soon they wanted to try a new season.
Next, they pretended it was the warm season. They played in the pretend sun and swam in the pretend water. They had a fun time, but they didn't see the real rain coming. The rain came fast and hard. Lily and her friends got very wet and cold. They ran to their homes, but they were sad because their fun day was over. The bad ending made them wish they had played inside instead.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two brothers go to a bakery and plan to share a tasty cap, but it gets stolen and they can no longer unite.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there were two brothers, who loved to play together. They would explore the park, ride their bikes and dig for tiny treasure. They were always having fun together.
One day, the brothers decided to go to the bakery. When they entered the door, they saw wonderful things, like a cupcake with a cherry on top, and a tasty cap. The younger brother's eyes lit up, he wanted to eat it so badly!
The older brother said, "Let's unite! I will buy the cap, and we will share it."
The younger brother smiled, but inside he felt a little sad. He really wanted to keep the cap for himself. He said nothing, and the older brother went to buy it.
But when the older brother returned, the tasty cap was gone. Someone had taken it. The brothers were disappointed and could not unite anymore.
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A farmer teaches a little boy how to grow corn, but when the boy's corn is destroyed by a storm, he learns that bad things can happen even when we try our best.
With: sad ending
response:
The little boy went home and planted his own corn. He watered it every day and waited patiently for it to grow. But one day, a big storm came and destroyed all of the little boy's corn. He was very sad and didn't know what to do. He went back to the fair and asked the farmer for help, but it was too late.
The little boy learned that sometimes bad things happen even when we try our best. But he was grateful for the farmer who showed him how to grow corn and he knew he could try again next year.

instruction:
Write a story about: Spot the dog gets tired on a hot day and tries to rest under a tree, but a cat claims the shade. Spot cannot find another place to rest and ends up feeling sad and tired in the sun.
With: sad ending
response:
Spot saw a big tree with lots of shade. Spot wanted to lay down in the shade and rest. But a big cat was already there. The cat said, "No, Spot! You cannot rest here. This is my shade." Spot felt sad and ashamed. Spot walked away to find another place to rest.
Spot looked and looked, but could not find any more shade. Spot was so tired and hot, but he could not rest. Spot lay down in the sun, but it was too hot for him. Spot did not feel good. In the end, Spot was very sad and still very tired.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little duck eats bread from a wagon and admits to the farmer when caught, but is chased away and learns not to steal again.
With: sad ending
response:
The little duck wanted to eat the bread, so he climbed into the wagon. But then, a farmer came and saw the little duck in the wagon. "Hey, little duck, did you eat my bread?" asked the farmer. The little duck felt guilty and said, "Yes, I ate your bread. I'm sorry."
The farmer was very angry and chased the little duck away. The little duck swam away in the pond, feeling sad and hungry. From that day on, the little duck never stole again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A competitive dragon loved to kick and wanted to be the best at it. He found a big ball and kicked it as hard as he could, causing it to hit a tree and break his house, teaching him a lesson about kicking too hard.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the dragon found a big ball. He wanted to kick the ball very far. So, he kicked the ball as hard as he could. The ball flew high into the sky.
But the ball hit a big tree. The tree fell down and hit the dragon's house. The dragon was sad because his house was broken. The competitive dragon learned that kicking too hard can sometimes be bad.
Summary: A competitive dragon loved to kick and wanted to be the best at it. He found a big ball and kicked it as hard as he could, causing it to hit a tree and break his house, teaching him a lesson about kicking too hard.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy named Little John builds an igloo to protect his favorite mountain from the sun's powerful rays, and succeeds in saving his winter wonderland.
With: happy ending
response:
The sun's powerful rays were melting the snow atop the mountain. As clean as freshly washed linen was the snow, and as powerful as a hundred horses was the sun. Little John watched how the nature of the mountain unfolded before his eyes. He watched in awe as the powerful sun gradually melted his favorirte winter wonderland.
Little John contemplated what he could do to help the snow stay. He knew that he could not fight the powerful force of nature, so he ran back to his house. He quickly got his old shovel and ran to his favorite mountain. He started digging and digging, and as soon as he made a makeshift igloo, it started to snow again. Little John and his igloo were now saved from the sun's powerful rays!

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy gets rid of his old, disgusting wagon by letting it float away in a lake and decides to get a new one.
