Finally, Mia found her key under her bed. She felt very happy and opened her special box. She played with her toys and shared them with her friends. They all felt happy too.
Summary: Mia loses the key to her special box of toys, but eventually finds it and shares her toys with her friends, making everyone happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Alice and Bob's friendship is broken after an argument about buying picnic supplies leads to Bob crying and them both going home without having a picnic.
With: sad ending
response:
Alice and Bob were best friends. Every Tuesday, they went for a picnic together. Today, they were going to the park. 
Alice wanted to buy something for their picnic, so she asked Bob to come along with her. But Bob leaned against the expensive store and wouldn't move. 
Alice was so cross that she banged her foot against the ground and shouted angrily at Bob. Bob was so shocked that he began to cry.
Alice felt so guilty that they decided to forget the picnic. They both went home and did not meet up again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lila and Tom disobey their moms and run away to see a big mountain, but they get lost and encounter a hungry bear that eats them.
With: sad ending
response:
Lila and Tom were friends. They liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big mountain. They wanted to go there.
They asked their moms. Their moms said no. The mountain was too far and too high. It was not safe. Lila and Tom were sad.
But they did not listen. They waited until their moms were busy. Then they ran away. They followed the road to the mountain. They were glad. They wanted to see what was on the mountain.
They walked and walked. The mountain was very big. They got tired and thirsty. They did not have any water or food. They did not know the way back. They were scared.
They saw a big bear. The bear was hungry. It saw Lila and Tom. It ran after them. They screamed and ran. But they were too slow. The bear caught them. It ate them. They were gone.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy named Timmy loves playing with his cards but gets them stolen by a big bully at the park. Timmy's mom tells him it's okay to say no and stand up for himself.
With: sad ending
response:
The big boy came up to Timmy and asked him if he could play with his cards. Timmy was scared but he didn't want to be rude, so he said yes. The big boy took Timmy's cards and ran away. Timmy was so sad that he started to yell.
Timmy's mom came to the park and saw how sad he was. She asked him what happened and Timmy told her everything. His mom hugged him and told him that it's okay to say no if he doesn't want to share his things. The moral of the story is that it's important to stand up for yourself and not let others take advantage of you.

instruction:
Write a story about: A three year old girl sets out on a journey to find a harsh secret, but is attacked by monsters and never finds out what the secret was.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a three year old girl who loved secrets. She was always looking for a special secret nobody else knew.
One day, she heard about a harsh secret that was hidden away. She didn’t care how harsh the secret was, she wanted to find it.
So the girl set out on a journey to find the harsh secret. Everywhere she went, people would tell her the same thing: “Go to the old oak tree.” She didn’t understand why, but she repeated it to herself and kept looking.
Finally, she reached the old oak tree and saw a dark, scary cave. She was afraid but she knew she had come too far to turn back. She went inside the cave and found the harsh secret.
But it was too late - the secret was guarded by a group of mean monsters. They attacked the little girl and she ran away as fast as she could. She never found out what the secret was, and she was never able to share it with anyone.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy finds a smooth steel ball that makes a fun sound when shaken. He shares it with his friends, and they all have a great time playing with it.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, a little boy found the steel ball while playing outside. He picked it up and saw how smooth it was. He decided to shake it, and to his surprise, it made a happy sound. The boy laughed and danced with the ball, shaking it to make more fun sounds.
The boy showed the smooth steel ball to his friends, and they all wanted to shake it too. They took turns shaking the ball, and they all laughed and danced together. The smooth steel ball brought happiness to everyone who shook it. And from that day on, the little boy and his friends played with the ball every day, making fun sounds and having a great time.
Summary: A little boy finds a smooth steel ball that makes a fun sound when shaken. He shares it with his friends, and they all have a great time playing with it.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two kids, Jami and Ali, disobey their parents and open a box they find in the forest, only to find it dirty and disappointing. They learn the lesson to obey their parents and not open closed boxes.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there were two young kids, Jami and Ali. They had found a box in the forest and were so excited to open it. They couldn't wait to see what was inside.
They opened the box and it was so wide! Unfortunately, it was also very filthy. Filthy from all of the mud and leaves and bugs in it.
Jami and Ali were very disappointed and wished they had left the box closed. They had not obeyed their parents when they said not to open the box.
Jami and Ali felt so sad and learned an important lesson. From then on, they always obeyed their parents and kept their hands off closed boxes.

instruction:
Write a story about: A fireman fights a big fire but is unable to put it out, resulting in the destruction of the house. He learns a valuable lesson to always be prepared and alert in order to save lives.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a fireman. He was strong and brave. One day, he had to go fight a big fire. He was worried, but he knew he had to go. He dressed in his fireman's outfit and ran out the door.
When he arrived, the fire was huge! He worked very hard, but the fire was too big. He couldn't put it out. The fire burnt and burnt until it was too late. The house was destroyed and the fireman was sad.
Since that day, the fireman has always been worried. He remembered how he wasn't strong enough to put out the fire. That's why he always stays prepared and alert. He has learnt a valuable lesson - that if he wants to save lives, he must be ready for anything.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily catches a butterfly, but her mother teaches her a lesson about being kind to animals and letting them be free.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily asked, "Mommy, can I catch the butterfly?"
Her mother replied, "Yes, but be gentle and don't hurt it. It's very delicate."
Lily caught the butterfly and put it in a jar. She was so excited to show her mother. But when her mother saw the butterfly, she was sad. "Lily, you shouldn't have caught it. The butterfly needs to fly free. You need to let it go."
Lily felt bad and knew she had done something wrong. She said sorry and let the butterfly go. Her mother didn't punish her, but she taught her a lesson about being kind to animals and not hurting them. From that day on, Lily promised to always be gentle and kind to all creatures, and to spell her words correctly so she could learn more about them.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves to sing and dance. She hears a bird singing in the park and asks it to teach her how to sing. The bird tells her to practice every day, and she becomes a better singer.
With: happy ending
response:
When she got there, she saw a bird singing on a tree. The bird had a beautiful voice. Lily said, "Birdie, you sing so well! Can you teach me how to sing like you?"
The bird replied, "Of course, but you have to start by singing every day. Practice makes perfect!" From that day on, Lily practiced singing every day. She started to sing better and better, just like the bird. The moral of the story is that if you want to be good at something, you have to start practicing.
Summary: Lily loves to sing and dance. She hears a bird singing in the park and asks it to teach her how to sing. The bird tells her to practice every day, and she becomes a better singer.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's robot toy stopped working because its battery was not charged. Her mommy took her to the toy store to fix it, but it was accidentally broken, making Lily very sad.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily was sad and asked her mommy to help her fix it. Her mommy tried to replace the battery, but it was too rough to open the toy. They decided to take it to the toy store to fix it. 
At the toy store, the worker tried to fix the toy, but he accidentally broke it. Lily was very upset and cried. Her mommy tried to make her feel better, but Lily was still sad. 
The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily receives a shiny ornament from her mom but her little brother starts playing with it. Their mom helps them hang it up high to keep it safe and they learn to keep their special things protected.
With: happy ending
response:
But then, Lily's little brother came into her room and started playing with the ornament. Lily demanded, "No, no! That's mine! Please give it back!" Her brother didn't listen and kept playing with it, making the ornament sway back and forth.
Lily's mom heard the commotion and came into the room. She saw what was happening and said, "Oh no, we can't have that! That ornament is too special to be played with like a toy. Let's put it up high where it can be safe and still make our room lively."
Lily and her brother agreed and together they hung the ornament up high on the wall. From then on, they admired it from afar and made sure to keep their special things safe.
Summary: Lily receives a shiny ornament from her mom but her little brother starts playing with it. Their mom helps them hang it up high to keep it safe and they learn to keep their special things protected.

instruction:
Write a story about: A prince who loves to bounce discovers a ball that bounces higher than anything he has ever seen before, but he cannot find it until he follows the sound of children playing with it in the forest. The children initially reject him, but he impresses them with his bouncing skills and they become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The prince asked his servants to bring him the ball, but they couldn't find it. The prince was very sad because he wanted to bounce on the ball. He searched the whole castle, but the ball was nowhere to be found.
Then, the prince heard a sound coming from the forest. He followed the sound and saw a group of children playing with the ball. The prince asked if he could play too, but the children said no because he was different from them.
The prince was very sad, but he didn't give up. He showed the children how high he could bounce, and they were amazed. They let him play with them, and they all had a lot of fun bouncing together. From that day on, the prince learned that being different is not a bad thing, and he made many new friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A big crocodile who hates playing with others helps a small bird find its family and learns the value of helping others and making new friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, a small bird came to the river. The bird was very sad. The crocodile saw the bird and asked, "Why are you sad?" The bird said, "I lost my family. I am all alone." The crocodile felt bad for the bird.
The crocodile decided to help the bird find its family. They looked all around the river. At last, they found the bird's family. The bird was very happy. The crocodile was happy too. He learned that helping others can make you happy, even if you think you hate playing with them. And from that day on, the crocodile was not so independent anymore. He liked to help and play with his new friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bossy comet convinces the stars to help create a big, bright light in the sky, which leads to them becoming good friends and making the sky beautiful every night.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the comet had an idea. It wanted to bring a big, bright light to the sky. The comet told the stars to help. The stars did not want to help, but the bossy comet made them.
The stars worked together and made a big, bright light. The sky was very pretty. The comet saw how the stars worked together and stopped being bossy. They all became good friends and made the sky beautiful every night.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim sees a dog in the park that looks uncomfortable and asks his mom for help. They give the dog water and food, making it feel better, and Tim learns the importance of helping others.
With: happy ending
response:
Tim went to his mom and tried to explain. "Mom, dog not happy. Help dog?" His mom looked at the dog and saw that it was uncomfortable too. She said, "Okay, Tim. Let's help the dog."
Tim and his mom went to the dog with water and food. The dog drank the water and ate the food. Soon, the dog felt better and was not uncomfortable anymore. Tim was happy that he could help the dog. He learned that it is good to help others when they are not feeling well.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy named Jack prays for help and protection from a dangerous mosquito and believes that God will always listen to his prayers.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a little boy named Jack who loved playing outside. On a warm sunny day, he ran and played in the garden. Suddenly, a dangerous mosquito flew by. Jack's mommy came over and said, "Jack, it's time to pray." Jack knelt down and closed his eyes.
He prayed for help and protection from the dangerous mosquito. After he finished praying, the dangerous mosquito flew away. Jack was so happy and ran back to his mommy. She hugged him and said, "See, God will always listen to you when you pray." 
Jack smiled and went back to playing outside. He knew that whenever he was in danger, God was always there to help.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the dog runs in a stadium and races with Tom the cat. Max falls but Tom encourages him to try again, and they both finish the race and have fun.
With: happy ending
response:
When Max got to the stadium, he saw a big cat named Tom. Tom said, "Hi Max! Do you want to race with me?" Max nodded his head and said, "Yes, let's race!"
They started to run very fast. Max was ahead, but then he tripped and fell. He felt ashamed. Tom stopped and said, "Don't be sad, Max. Let's try again!" Max smiled and they ran again. This time, they both finished the race and had lots of fun.
Summary: Max the dog runs in a stadium and races with Tom the cat. Max falls but Tom encourages him to try again, and they both finish the race and have fun.

instruction:
Write a story about: A tired frog finds a big flower and decides to sleep next to it because it makes him feel happy and peaceful.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, he saw an impressive flower nearby. It was the biggest flower he had ever seen! The frog was so amazed that he forgot about sleeping. He hopped towards the flower and examined it closely. 
After a while, the frog realized how tired he was. He decided to sleep next to the impressive flower. The flower was so pretty that it made the frog feel happy and peaceful. He closed his eyes and fell asleep. The end.
Summary: A tired frog finds a big flower and decides to sleep next to it because it makes him feel happy and peaceful.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns to respect other people's spaces and things after trying to enter a covered-up church and encountering an angry man.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy was walking around his town when he noticed a church. He had never seen it up close before and so he made his way closer and closer. When he got to the doors, he noticed they were covered with a piece of wood. 
He pasted his ear to the door and said, "Hello? Is anyone in there?". 
Suddenly he heard a voice coming from behind him. He turned around and saw a man, who looked quite angry.
The man said, "This church has been covered up for a purpose, why are you trying to get in?". 
Timmy didn't really know what to say - he was afraid the man might be mad at him. But the man said nothing more, he just gave Timmy a stern looking and walked away. 
That was when Timmy realised that he should respect other people's spaces and things, even if he doesn't understand why it's happening. The moral of the story is that it's important to be considerate of others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A dog named Max and his bird friend push a button near the rail tracks, causing a big train to hit them and hurt them.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Max saw a big red button near the rail. He didn't know what it was for, but it looked fun to push. Max decided to order his friend, the little bird, to push the button. The little bird flew down and pushed the button with its beak.
Suddenly, the big train came down the rail. It was going very fast and couldn't stop. Max and the little bird tried to run away, but they were too close to the rail. The big train hit Max and the little bird, and they were very hurt. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Two best friends find an old shed with a mysterious lock, unite to open it, but find it haunted and run away scared.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there were two best friends: Sam and Dan. Sam and Dan were very excited to go on an adventure together.
One day, they found an old shed with a strange lock. The lock was mysterious and seemed like it would open something special.
Sam and Dan both tried their hardest, but they couldn't open the lock. They decided to unite and work together to open it.
Their efforts paid off, and the lock opened. But, when they looked inside, they saw nothing but darkness and spiders.
The shed was haunted, and the two best friends were very scared. They ran away in a hurry and they never returned. They never managed to reunite and go on another adventure.

instruction:
Write a story about: A grumpy bear hurts a little bird who tries to make him smile, and regrets his actions when the bird flies away and he never sees it again.
With: sad ending
response:
The little bird tried to make the grumpy bear smile by singing louder and louder, but it didn't work. The grumpy bear got so angry that he grabbed his pillow and threw it at the little bird. The pillow hit the bird and hurt it badly. The little bird stopped singing and flew away, never to be seen again.
The grumpy bear went back to sleep on his pillow, but he didn't feel happy anymore. He realized that he had made a big mistake by hurting the little bird. He wanted to say sorry and make things right, but it was too late. He never saw the little bird again and he never smiled again. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy buries his flashlight in a special place at the park, hoping it will bring joy to someone else.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a happy family. They had a nice home with lots of light. One day they went to the park to play.
The family got to the park and the little boy saw a big hole. He asked his dad why it was there and his dad told him that it was a special place to bury things that were very special. The little boy thought of something he could bury and he ran to find it.
He looked all over the house, but couldn't find it. Then he remembered his tiny flashlight and he asked his mom if he could take it to the park and bury it. His mom said yes and he was very excited. 
So they all went back to the park and the little boy put his flashlight into the special place. He said goodbye to it and carefully filled up the dirt to cover it up. He said he hoped his light would put a smile on someone's face.
The family smiled together and went home feeling happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Bob learns to be less selfish after finding a pen that writes a message telling him to share his things with others.
With: happy ending
response:
Bob was a very selfish person. He wanted to keep everything to himself. One day, he found a beautiful pen. He was so excited that he wanted to slide it so he could keep it.
But when Bob slid the pen, something amazing happened! The pen started writing on its own! Bob couldn't believe his eyes!
The pen wrote that Bob should share his things with others, and not be so selfish. Bob understood and began to share.
He shared the pen with his friends and they all enjoyed sliding it. Bob was so happy that he had learned to be less selfish. He smiled as he slid the pen one last time!

instruction:
Write a story about: An opera singer who loves to whistle performs in a park and receives applause from the audience.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was an opera singer who loved to whistle. Every single day he would go out in the park and whistle his favorite tunes. He was so proud of himself and the birds would join him in singing the beautiful songs. One day, the opera singer decided to do something special. He was going to give an opera performance in front of the entire park! He was very excited and whistled all day long to practice for the big day. Everyone gathered in the park to watch the performance. The opera singer proudly sang his heart out. Everyone was so amazed by his performance and afterwards, the park was filled with applause. He felt very proud and kept whistling his favorite tunes until the sun went down.
Summary: An opera singer who loves to whistle performs in a park and receives applause from the audience.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim loved playing with his luxury toy car, but it became very dirty when he took it to the park. His mom took it away when he couldn't clean it.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Tim took his dirty luxury car to the park. He played with his car in the sand and made it even dirtier. Tim's mom told him it was time to go home, but Tim didn't want to leave his car at the park. So, he put the dirty car in his pocket.
When they got home, Tim's mom saw the dirty luxury car and was not happy. Tim had made a big mess in his pocket and all over the floor. His mom said that he could not play with the car until it was clean. Tim tried to clean the car, but it was too dirty. In the end, Tim's mom took the car away and Tim was very sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: A prince and princess get married and have a big party, then go to bed and sleep soundly.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a prince and princess. They lived in a big castle near a lake. One day, the prince asked the princess to marry him and she said, "Yes!". 
So the prince and princess got married. All the people in the kingdom had a big party to celebrate. They ate a lot of cakes and made music.
After the wedding, the prince and princess stayed at the castle. The prince did lots of funny dances and the princess laughed and clapped her hands. They were very happy.
But the prince and princess were getting sleepy, so they went to bed. The princess dusted off the bed with a feather and they both snuggled up with a soft blanket. 
The prince and princess soon fell fast asleep, dreaming of their wonderful wedding day. They slept all night, until the sun woke them up in the morning.
Summary: A prince and princess get married and have a big party, then go to bed and sleep soundly.

instruction:
Write a story about: Luna, a black cat, wants to learn a new language and asks her friend Blue, a bird who can speak many languages, to teach her. Despite Blue's warning about a big dog who doesn't like cats who can speak his language, Luna forgets to be careful and gets caught by the dog.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Luna asked Blue to teach her a new language. Blue said, "Okay, but you must be careful. There is a big dog who does not like cats who can speak his language." Luna said she would be careful.
Luna learned the new language very fast. She was so happy, she went outside to talk with the big dog. But she forgot to be careful. The big dog was not happy. He chased Luna and caught her. Luna was very sad that she did not listen to Blue.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily disobeys her mother's warning not to touch her makeup, creates a mess, and learns the importance of listening and asking permission.
With: sad ending
response:
But one day, when her mommy was not looking, Lily decided to play with the makeup. She put on lots of lipstick and eye shadow. "Wow, I look so pretty!" she said to herself. But then she accidentally spilled some of the makeup on the floor. She tried to clean it up, but it was too hard.
When her mommy came back and saw the mess, she was very angry. "Lily, I told you not to touch my makeup! You didn't permit me to use it today!" she said. Lily felt very bad and started to cry. She knew she had done something wrong.
From that day on, Lily never touched her mommy's makeup again. She learned that it was important to listen to what her mommy said and to always ask for permission before using things that didn't belong to her.
Summary: Lily disobeys her mother's warning not to touch her makeup, creates a mess, and learns the importance of listening and asking permission.

instruction:
Write a story about: Polly's Mama calls her for a hug before bedtime and Polly feels much better after the hug.
With: happy ending
response:
Polly was playing with her stuffed animals in her room. Her pillow was big and soft and she was feeling very sleepy. Suddenly, her Mama called her.
"Polly," Mama said.
"What?" Polly asked.
"Come squeeze me!" Mama said with a smile.
Polly knew exactly what Mama meant. She ran over and hugged Mama tight. Mama squeezed back and Polly giggled.
Mama asked Polly, "Do you feel better now? Has all the sleepy stuff gone away?"
Polly smiled and nodded. She felt much better. Mama picked Polly up and hugged her one more time before she put her to bed. 
"Good night, Sweetheart," Mama said as she kissed Polly's forehead.
"Good night, Mama," said Polly, already half asleep.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves her toys but doesn't want to clean up, her favorite toy goes missing and she gets worried. Her mom finds the toy and Lily learns to always put her toys away.
With: happy ending
response:
As Lily was cleaning up, she noticed her favorite toy was missing. She looked everywhere, but she couldn't find it. Lily started to get worried and knew she was in trouble if she couldn't find it. 
Later that night, Lily's mom found the toy under the couch. Lily was so happy and relieved that she hugged her mom and held her tight. Her mom smiled and said, "I'm glad we found your toy. I was getting angry thinking we lost it forever." From then on, Lily made sure to always put her toys away so she wouldn't get in trouble again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves to play in his backyard, but has to stop to take a bath. After his bath, he sees a beautiful rainbow and tells his mom about it.
With: happy ending
response:
After his bath, Timmy went back outside to play. He looked up and saw an amazing sight! A big rainbow was in the sky, with all the colors he loved. Timmy ran to tell his mom about the amazing rainbow he saw in the backyard. His mom smiled and said, "That sounds wonderful, Timmy. I'm glad you had fun playing outside." 
Timmy continued to play in his backyard, feeling happy and grateful for the amazing things he got to see and do.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sue see a rocket in the sky and watch it fly away together at the park.
With: happy ending
response:
Tim and his mom went to the park to see the rocket better. Tim saw a girl named Sue. Sue was looking at the rocket too. Tim said, "Hi Sue, do you see the rocket?" Sue nodded and smiled. "Yes, Tim, I see it too!"
Together, Tim and Sue watched the rocket fly high. They waved at it and shouted, "Bye, rocket!" The rocket went far away, and they could not see it anymore. Tim and Sue played at the park and talked about the rocket all day.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lady gets lost and asks for directions from several children, but still gets lost. She realizes she should have asked for help from someone who knew the way. The moral of the story is to ask for help when you don't know something.
With: sad ending
response:
The lady followed the boy's directions, but she got lost again. She asked another little girl, "Do you know where the park is?" The girl said, "Yes, I know where it is. It's just around the corner." 
The lady followed the girl's directions, but she got even more lost. She asked a third little boy, "Do you know where the park is?" The boy said, "Yes, I know where it is. But you're going the wrong way!" 
The lady felt very confused and didn't know what to do. She wandered around for hours until it got dark. She realized that she should have asked for help from someone who knew the way. The moral of the story is that it's okay to ask for help when you don't know something.

instruction:
Write a story about: Michael is hungry and goes to the kitchen to get some milk. His mother tells him that there is enough milk for everyone in the family, so he puts the bottle back and goes back to bed.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Michael. Michael was very hungry, so he got out of bed and went downstairs to the kitchen.
When Michael opened the fridge, he saw a large number of bottles of milk. He was so excited! He grabbed one bottle and stood there to drink it.
Suddenly, a voice said, "You can't drink all of that milk, Michael!"
Michael looked up and saw his mother standing in the kitchen doorway. She said, "There are enough bottles of milk here for everyone! We can all have one."
Michael was happy to know that he and his family would all get to have their own bottle of milk, and he was even more relieved that they were now no longer hungry. He smiled, put the bottle back in the fridge, and went back upstairs to bed.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily forgives her little brother for marking on her pillow and learns the importance of forgiveness.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily asked her brother why he marked on her pillow. He looked guilty and said sorry. Lily forgave him and they hugged. She learned that it's important to forgive and not stay angry. 
From that day on, Lily kept her pillow safe and made sure her brother didn't mark on it again. They played together happily and had lots of fun. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: An ordinary mall becomes special when a small green plant grows in the middle of it due to a drop of special water left behind by a visitor. The plant grows bigger every day and makes everyone happy.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was an ordinary mall with no special things in it. It was a normal mall with those things that people needed.
But one day, something strange happened. A small green plant started to grow right in the middle of the mall. It grew until it was taller than anybody else.
Everyone in the mall was amazed. They had never seen anything like it before. The mall managers looked to see what had caused it to grow.
They discovered that the plant had grown because of a tiny drop of special water. One of the mall's visitors had left it behind!
Everyone was so excited and happy that the ordinary mall had something special. Every day, the plant grew bigger and bigger and the mall visitors came to see it. 
The mall became extra special because of the small and ordinary green plant. It made everyone smile.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily learns a lesson about sharing and making good choices after eating too much candy and getting sick, causing her to miss out on playing with her neighbor Timmy.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Lily saw a big bag of candy at the store. She wanted it very much. Her mom said she could only have a little bit, but Lily didn't listen. She took the whole bag and ate it all by herself. Her tummy hurt and she felt sick.
The next day, Timmy came over to play, but Lily was too sick to play. She learned that she should have listened to her mom and not taken too much candy. She also learned that being a good neighbor means sharing and being kind. Lily felt sad that she couldn't play with Timmy and wished she could go back in time to make things right. But it was too late. She learned that sometimes, bad choices can increase the chances of bad things happening.
Summary: Lily learns a lesson about sharing and making good choices after eating too much candy and getting sick, causing her to miss out on playing with her neighbor Timmy.

instruction:
Write a story about: An ant finds a big, round thing and takes it back to his home, but it turns out to be a bird that eats the ants, teaching them a lesson about leaving things alone.
With: sad ending
response:
The ant was very curious and thought, "What could this be?" He decided to roll the big, round thing back to his home. It was very heavy, but the tough ant did not give up. He pushed and pushed, and finally, it was home.
The other ants were very excited and thought it was food. They tried to eat it, but it was too hard. They tried to break it, but it was too strong. Suddenly, the big, round thing cracked open, and a big bird came out! The bird was hungry and started to eat the ants. The ants were scared and ran away. instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

Then, something unexpected happened. A little frog jumped out of the pond, and it was wearing Lily's glove on its head! The frog looked funny, and Lily and Tom laughed. instruction:

As Tweetie continued to zoom around the sky, he remembered the lessons he learned from Wisey. He realized that even though some things may be difficult to understand, it's important to keep learning and growing. From that day on, Tweetie continued to seek wisdom and zoom around the sky with joy.

instruction:

instruction:
Write a story about: A tired wolf goes to the river to drink water and meets a frog who invites him to play. They have fun playing together and become friends.

response:
The frog and the wolf played a fun game. They took turns to splash water on each other. They laughed and had a great time. The wolf didn't feel tired anymore. But then, something unexpected happened. The frog jumped very high and landed on the wolf's head!
The wolf was surprised, but he didn't get mad. He just laughed and said, "You are a funny frog! I am happy we are friends." The frog smiled and said, "I am happy too, Mr. Wolf. Friends are important." They both learned that even when you feel tired, playing with friends can make you happy. And being kind to others can make new friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily shows her special weapon to her nervous friends during a game of matching, but they become scared and tell her to leave. Lily realizes she was wrong and learns to be aware of how others will react to her behavior.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a lady named Lily who was very nervous. Lily had a special weapon which she kept in a wooden box. She would only show the weapon to her closest friends, who were also very nervous. 
One day, her close friends invited her to a game of matching. When Lily arrived, she took out her weapon to play. But her friends became scared as they had never seen such a big weapon before. They started shouting at Lily and telling her to leave.
Lily was so disappointed and sad with the way her friends treated her. She put the weapon away and she left. 
When Lily arrived home, she sat on her bed and thought to herself. She realised that she was wrong to show her weapon in front of her friends. The moral of the story is that it is always important to be aware of how others will react to our behaviour and to be careful of how we act.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns the importance of sharing and kindness when he shares his favorite toy with his friend Billy.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy also had a favorite toy, a shiny red car. Timmy wanted to play with the car, but Billy didn't want to share. Timmy felt a little sad, but he didn't give up.
He urged Billy to share the car, but Billy still said no. Timmy thought for a moment and then remembered something his mom had told him. She said that sharing is caring and it's always better to be kind to others. So, Timmy decided to share Max with Billy.
Billy was very happy and they played together with Max and the red car. Timmy felt good inside because he knew he had done the right thing. From that day on, Timmy and Billy shared their toys and had fun together. Timmy learned that being kind and sharing is always the best thing to do.
Summary: Timmy learns the importance of sharing and kindness when he shares his favorite toy with his friend Billy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily invites her friend Max to play with her dough and they have lots of fun together, but Lily's little brother interrupts them. Max enjoys it so much that he asks to come back and play again sometime.

When Max arrived, Lily showed him her dough and they started to make lots of fun things together. But then, Lily's little brother came into the room and started to make noise. Lily told him to be calm because they were playing. 
Max and Lily had so much fun playing with the dough that they didn't even notice the time passing. When Max's mom came to pick him up, he didn't want to leave. He asked Lily if he could come back and play with her dough again sometime. Lily smiled and said, "Of course, you are always invited!"

instruction:
Write a story about: A bear and a rabbit play soccer, but the bear becomes selfish and takes the ball away from the rabbit, leaving the rabbit sad. The moral of the story is to be generous and friendly.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a bear who wanted to play soccer. He rolled the ball along the ground with his feet. Soon he found a goal and began to play. 
He rolled the ball back and forth and felt so happy. But then a rabbit came by. The bear was excited and asked the rabbit if he wanted to play too.
The rabbit said, "Yes!" He rolled the ball into the goal and cheered. But the bear was upset. He felt the goal was his and he felt guilty.
He shouted at the rabbit, "No! That's my goal!" Then he rolled the ball away from the rabbit and left.
The rabbit was sad. He thought it was wrong for the bear to take the ball away from him.
Moral of the story: Everyone should be generous and friendly, not selfish and angry.

instruction:
Write a story about: A brave hare named Sam gets lost in a maze and encounters a scary monster, but ultimately fails to escape and the monster remains undefeated.

He entered the maze and soon found himself lost. All around him were tall walls. Everywhere he looked, he saw cold stone. He started to get scared.
Suddenly, he heard cheering. Sam followed the sound and came to a large room. There were lots of people clapping and cheering. Sam felt relieved and happy; it seemed like he was saved! But when he asked the people, they didn't answer him.
Instead, they kept applauding the scary monster in the corner. The monster was huge and mean looking. Its cold eyes stared at Sam. Sam felt very scared and ran away. The people kept applauding and Sam ran back to his home.
The bad ending was that Sam never got out of the maze and the monster was never defeated.

instruction:

response:

The lion laughed and said, "How can a tiny mouse help me?" But the mouse said, "I can help you move something heavy." 
The lion agreed and the mouse helped him move a big rock. But after that, the lion still wanted to eat the mouse. So he did. The end.
Summary: A big lion meets a little mouse who offers to help him. The lion agrees but still eats the mouse in the end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy goes swimming with a fish but gets carried away by a big wave and never comes back.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little boy who loved to play in the ocean. Every day he would put his toes in the cool water and feel the wave wash over him.
One day he saw a beautiful fish swimming close to shore. He put out his hand and said, "Hi fish!"
The fish turned and said, "Hi! Do you want to come swimming with me?"
The boy was so excited he waved and said, "Yes, let's go!"
So they swam together and the boy was so happy. But when the boy looked up he saw that the sun was almost setting. He wanted to stay and play but the fish said, "It's time to go."
The boy was disappointed but he put his toes in the sand and watched the fish swim away. As he said goodbye he saw something big coming towards him – a big wave!
The wave crashed over him and carried him away. He cried for help but no one heard him. The wave took him far away and he never came back.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her friend Timmy climbed a tree to pick apples, but Timmy fell and died from his injuries, teaching Lily the importance of being careful and kind to others.
With: sad ending
response:
While she was picking apples, she heard a voice. It was her friend, Timmy. He said, "Hi Lily, can I come up too?" Lily said, "Sure, but be careful!" Timmy climbed up and started picking apples too. Suddenly, he lost his balance and fell from the tree. Lily screamed and ran to get her mom.
When they arrived, Timmy was hurt and couldn't move. The ambulance came, but it was too late. Timmy had died from his injuries. Lily was sad and wished she had been more careful. She learned that sometimes, even when we choose to do something fun, accidents can happen and we should always be kind and careful to others.
Summary: Lily and her friend Timmy climbed a tree to pick apples, but Timmy fell and died from his injuries, teaching Lily the importance of being careful and kind to others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl learns how to cast a light spell with her mother's help and becomes enamored with magic, practicing her spells all the time.

response:

The little girl was excited. She followed her mother’s instructions carefully and soon she was able to cast a light spell. She felt so happy and proud that she could make light come from her fingers.
Her mother said, “I love that you are exploring magic. You have so much potential and I can’t wait to see what you create.”
The little girl laughed and said, “I love magic too!”
From then on, the little girl practiced her spells all the time. She was amazed by the things she could do. She learned to love her magical powers, and never wanted to be without them.

instruction:

The pool looked real, so she decided to step into the water. Suddenly, she realized it was not made of water, it was made of fake material. She was so disappointed!
Throughout the day, however, she found herself returning to the pool. She didn't understand why, but something deep inside her kept telling her to go there. 
Again, she stepped into the fake pool and felt a big shock. She had become a part of the pool, trapped forever in its fake walls. 
The little girl never came back. All that was left of her was the memory of a fake pool, which no one could ever fill.

instruction:

His body started to feel stronger. His skin got thicker and he was not so tired any more. The patient was feeling much better after his resting.
The patient was so thankful that he found a way to rest. He taught other people to rest too, so they could be just like him and feel strong and healthy.

The End.

instruction:

instruction:

When they got home, Mommy and Timmy set up the pretty couch in the living room. Mommy said it was perfect! Timmy loved it. He bounced on it and he felt so happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: A curious little girl goes on a search for secrets and finds one in a box. She hides it in a cave and keeps it a secret.

response:

One day she saw something shiny in the bushes. She went closer to explore and found a box. She opened it and found a secret inside! She was so excited. She tried to keep the secret but some of her friends saw it and wanted to know what it was. So the little girl had to hide the secret.
She thought of lots of places to hide it. The first was under her bed, but she thought that was too easy. Then she remembered the cave. It was dark and scary, but she was brave. She took the secret and hid it deep inside the cave.
The little girl felt very proud of her secret. She was serious about keeping it and never told anyone. And that's how she found and kept her secret!

instruction:

response:

Spot was persistent. He did not want to bathe, so he ran away from home. He thought he could stay dirty forever. He played all day and all night. But soon, Spot got very tired and hungry.
Spot missed his mom and his warm home. He wanted to go back, but he was lost. He tried to find his way, but it was very hard. Spot was sad and scared.
In the end, Spot never found his way home. He learned that being persistent about not bathing was not a good idea. Spot wished he had listened to his mom and bathed when she told him to.

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

The intelligent flower asked the little girl if it could ride the bike. The girl said yes. The flower started to bloom bigger and bigger, so it could reach the pedal. It pushed the pedal with all its strength. But, the flower did not know how to ride the bike well.
The flower fell off the bike and broke its stem. The other flowers were sad. The intelligent flower could not play with them anymore. The moral of the story is that we should not try to do things that we are not meant to do.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim goes to play in a field with his red ball and kicks it at what he thinks is a fake bird, but it turns out to be a real bird pretending. The bird flies away, and Tim learns not to kick things at animals.

In the field, Tim saw a fake bird. It was big and colorful. He thought it was a real bird at first, but then he saw it was not moving. Tim kicked the ball at the fake bird, and it fell down. He felt happy and laughed.
But then, something unexpected happened. The fake bird stood up! It was not fake after all. It was a real bird, just pretending. The bird was not happy that Tim kicked the ball at it. The bird flew away, and Tim felt sorry. He learned not to kick things at animals, even if they look fake.
Summary: Tim goes to play in a field with his red ball and kicks it at what he thinks is a fake bird, but it turns out to be a real bird pretending. The bird flies away, and Tim learns not to kick things at animals.

instruction:
Write a story about: A happy family enjoys a delicious dinner made by the mum, and everyone is happy.

Her dad was so impressed by the dinner that he said to her mum, "This dinner looks yummy! I'm sure we will all enjoy it."
The little girl smiled because she was jealous that her dad was getting so much attention. 
Mum smiled back and said, "That's alright sweetheart. You can enjoy the dinner too!"

instruction:

Now, the cat and the dog are best friends. They work and play together every day. And they lived happily ever after.

instruction:
Write a story about: A man and a woman wanted to be together, but when the woman visited the man, he acted strange and then said they should stay apart, leaving the woman sad and alone.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a man and a woman. They both wanted to be united, so they called each other on the telephone. When they spoke, it was like a light shining through the darkness. 
One day, the woman wanted to visit the man. She asked him, “Will you let me come over?” The man hesitated, but eventually said yes. 
When she arrived, the man acted strange. He said they should keep things light, and not be too serious. The woman was sad, but she didn't protest.
The next day, she called him. But his voice was cold, and he said they needed to stay apart. He said he didn't want them to be united. The woman was very sad, and tears ran down her face. 
The man and woman were never united again. They lived separately, and the light between them had gone away.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sue finds a letter with a big word on it that she thinks is "stupid", but her mom corrects her and tells her it's "surprise". The next day, Sue's ball reveals a surprise toy and she learns to not judge things too quickly.

Sue showed the letter to her mom. Her mom told her that the word was not "stupid". The word was "surprise". Sue was very happy. She wanted to know what the surprise was. Her mom told her to wait and see.
The next day, Sue went to play with her ball. When she rolled it, a big toy came out! The ball was the surprise! Sue learned that sometimes things are not what they seem. She was happy she did not call the letter "stupid" and waited for the surprise.

instruction:

So, Lucy said please very politely. Suddenly the beautiful flower began to glow and opened up a secret door. Inside the door, there was a magical world filled with amazing toys and games. Everyone was so happy they could play together. 
The flower had led her to a wonderful surprise. Lucy and her friends had the most fun they had ever had playing together in their new magical world. 
The flower had been so polite and magical, that it led Lucy and her friends to a great adventure.

instruction:

response:

Soon, Sue came upon a big tree. She saw the bird again, but this time, it was a different color. "What happened to you?" Sue asked. The bird said, "I am a magic bird. When I touch ash, I change colors!" Sue was amazed and they became good friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A shy girl named Millie decides to explore outside her room, discovers that it's not as scary as she thought, and finds an exciting new world.

instruction:

Tim's mom saw him crying and asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim showed her the broken car and said, "My car is broken. Can you fix it, please?" Tim's mom was good at fixing things. She took the car and said, "I will fix it, but I will also teach you how to fix it, so you can do it yourself next time."
Tim was stubborn and didn't want to learn. He just wanted his car fixed. His mom said, "You need to learn, Tim. It's important to know how to fix things." So Tim listened to his mom and learned how to fix his car. They fixed the car together and Tim was happy again.
From that day on, Tim was not stubborn anymore. He learned that it was good to learn new things. Tim's mom was proud of him. The moral of the story is: always be open to learn, because it can help you in the future.

After the earthquake, everything was messy. Max and Mimi decided to help clean up. They picked up sticks and leaves. Then, they found a big puddle to wash their dirty paws. Sam helped by washing his wings in the water too. They all felt good about helping to make their yard clean again.

As Lily rubbed the soap on her arms and legs, she felt the bubbles pop and tickle her skin. Her mother told her to rub a little deeper to make sure she was clean. Write a story about: Amy plays her flute at a big show and becomes friends with a bird who joins in and sings with her, resulting in a successful performance. The moral of the story is to share your gifts with others.
With: happy ending
response:
On the day of the show, Amy got her flute ready. She played a pretty song. But then, something unexpected happened. A little bird flew into the room. The bird liked the pretty song too. The bird started to sing with Amy. Everyone loved the bird's song.
Amy and the bird became good friends. They played and sang together all the time. The people loved their songs. The moral of the story is that good things can happen when we share our gifts with others.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to a party and waits patiently to eat the cake, but later finds out it was fake and laughs about it.
With: happy ending
response:
At the party, Lily saw a big cake with lots of frosting. She wanted to eat it, but her mom told her to wait until after dinner. Lily was sad, but she waited patiently.
After dinner, Lily went to get some cake, but she noticed something strange. The cake was fake! Emily had made a fake cake as a joke. Lily laughed and thought it was funny. She was happy that she didn't release her anger before she found out it was fake.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy eats a magic bean against his mother's warning and shrinks, unable to reach the doorknob or call for help.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy's mom warned him that the bean might be dangerous, but he didn't listen. He ate the bean and waited for something to happen. Nothing happened at first, but then he started to feel funny. Suddenly, he felt like he was shrinking. 
Timmy was scared and didn't know what to do. He wanted his mom to help him, but he was too small to reach the doorknob. He tried to call for help, but his voice was too tiny. Timmy realized too late that he shouldn't have eaten the dangerous bean. He wished he had listened to his mom's warning and not joined the magic bean club.
Summary: Timmy eats a magic bean against his mother's warning and shrinks, unable to reach the doorknob or call for help.

instruction:
Write a story about: A group of friends go to the park, eat yummy desserts, and have a wonderful time playing together.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her friends came to visit on a wonderful, bright day. They decided to go to the park. As they ran and played, the sun shone and the flowers began to spring up. When it was time for a snack, the friends brought some yummy desserts. They found a perfect spot on the grass and ate their treats. The desserts were so sweet and icy that the children laughed and smiled. After they finished their desserts, they played some more and soon it was time to go home. The little girl and her friends had a wonderful time. They smiled the whole way home.
Summary: A group of friends go to the park, eat yummy desserts, and have a wonderful time playing together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A cat and a dog went to a food place to eat something yummy, but a big bird took the menu away. They all became good friends and had a fun time eating together.
With: happy ending
response:
The dog said, "Yes, let's tell the man we want to see the menu." So they asked the man for the menu. The man was very nice and gave them the menu. The cat and dog looked at the menu and saw many good things to eat.
Then, something unexpected happened. A big bird came in and took the menu away. The cat and dog were very sad. The bird said, "I am sorry, I just wanted to see the menu too." The cat and dog felt better and they all looked at the menu together. They had a fun time eating and became good friends.
Summary: A cat and a dog went to a food place to eat something yummy, but a big bird took the menu away. They all became good friends and had a fun time eating together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A girl who loves to count picks out a green dress with white polka dots as her favorite costume.
With: happy ending
response: Once upon a time, there was a very special girl. She loved to count and was always counting things - like stars in the sky, leaves on a tree, her dolls and more. One day, her family took her to a store and they asked her to pick a costume. She was so excited and started counting all the different costumes. She picked out a brand new green dress with white polka dots and she said that it was the most beautiful one! Her family beamed with happiness watching her count and pick her brand new costume. She twirled around in her new dress, counting every polka dot until she was too tired and had to go home with her family. She couldn't wait for the next time when her counting and costume would take her on a new adventure.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mandy found a magical candle and wished to connect with people. She met a kind girl and they became friends, but when the girl had to leave, Mandy felt alone again.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mandy. She wanted to solve a big problem. Every day, Mandy felt like there was a veil separating her from everyone else. She felt so alone!
One day, Mandy found a magical candle. She was so excited! She wished upon the candle that she could connect with people.
The next day, Mandy met another girl. She was so kind and compassionate. She wanted to be friends with Mandy.
The two of them had so much fun together! They played games, painted pictures and sang songs. Mandy felt like the veil was finally lifting.
But one day, the compassionate girl said that she had to go away. Mandy felt so sad! She was never able to solve her problem and she felt just as alone as before.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tweety the bird learns to leave his cozy cage and explore the world outside with the help of his friend Jerry the mouse.
With: happy ending
response:
Jerry said, "Tweety, why do you stay in your cage all day? Don't you want to fly outside and see the world?"
Tweety thought about it and said, "I don't know. My cage is so cozy and safe. I don't want to leave it."
Jerry suggested, "But Tweety, if you never leave your cage, you'll never know what it's like to be free. Maybe you'll like it outside."
Tweety thought some more and decided to try it. He flew out of his cage and saw the beautiful sky and the trees. He was so happy he listened to Jerry's suggestion. From that day on, Tweety flew outside every day and had many adventures with Jerry.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max, a playful dog, finds a license and excitedly runs to show his best friend Tim, but gets hit by a car and dies, leaving Tim devastated.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Max saw a shiny thing on the ground. It was a license. Max picked it up in his mouth and ran to show Tim. Max was so happy, he started to yell. He wanted Tim to see what he found.
But Max did not see the big car coming. Max was still yelling and running when the car hit him. Tim was very sad. Max went to sleep and did not wake up. Tim cried and wished Max was still here to play.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a locked door in her house and discovers a surprise art room behind it, made by her mom.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom saw her trying to unlock the door. "Lily, you cannot go in there. It is filthy!" her mom said. Lily was sad, but she listened to her mom.
The next day, Lily found a key on the floor. She took the key and unlocked the door. When she opened the door, she saw a room full of pastel colors and paper. It was not filthy at all! Lily's mom had made a surprise art room for her. They both laughed and drew pretty pictures together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim drinks bitter water, but his mom adds sweet juice to make it taste better.
With: happy ending
response:
One hot day, Tim was very thirsty. He went to the kitchen to get a drink. He found a cup and filled it with water. But when he took a sip, the water tasted bitter. Tim made a funny face and didn't like the taste.
Tim's mom saw him and knew what to do. She took the bitter water and added some sweet juice to it. Tim tried the drink again and it tasted much better! He was happy and went back to playing with his arrow, no longer thirsty.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mary needs a tutor for her schoolwork, but the tutor she hires starts to act differently and takes her money without giving lessons. Mary has to find a new tutor and be careful from now on.
With: sad ending
response:
"I need a tutor," Mary said. She was only 3 years old but already needed help with her schoolwork.
Her parents were sad but they wanted her to get all the help she could to do well in school so they agreed to hire a tutor. 
Mary met the tutor and she liked him. He was fair and explained things in a way that she understood. But it all changed one day when he started to act differently. 
The tutor started to take her money and not give her the lessons she'd paid for. Mary felt angry and scared. She tried to tell her parents but they wouldn't believe her. 
Mary now had to find a new tutor, but she was worried she wouldn't find someone who was fair. She would need to be careful from now on.

instruction:
Write a story about: A giraffe finds a key and keeps it safe, but a fox steals it and the giraffe becomes sad and lonely.
With: sad ending
response:
The giraffe asked his animal friends if they knew what the key was for, but no one knew. So, he decided to keep it safe in his pocket. One day, a sneaky fox saw the key and wanted it for himself.
The fox tricked the giraffe and stole the key. The giraffe was very sad and couldn't sit under the big tree anymore. He missed his key and felt very lonely. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim loves to sing and dance and finds a microphone in his toy box. He plays with it all day until he accidentally breaks it while running and singing with it in his hand.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim played with the microphone all day. He sang and danced around his room. He was very careful not to drop the microphone. But one day, he was careless. He was running and singing with the microphone in his hand. He tripped and the microphone broke.
Tim was very sad. He told his mom, "Mom, I broke my microphone." His mom said, "I told you not to speed with it in your hand." Tim cried and knew he should have listened to his mom.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Tim fly a pretty kite together in the park and have fun watching it dance in the air.
With: happy ending
response:
At the park, Lily met her friend, Tim. Tim saw the kite and said, "Wow, that's a nice kite! Can I help you fly it?" Lily smiled and said, "Yes, let's fly it together!" They both held the kite and waited for the wind.
The wind blew, and the kite went up in the sky. Lily and Tim laughed and clapped. They watched the kite dance in the air. They hoped the kite would stay up all day. They had so much fun flying the attractive kite together.
Summary: Lily and Tim fly a pretty kite together in the park and have fun watching it dance in the air.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jimmy learns about picnics and has a great time with his friend Sue.
With: happy ending
response:
Jimmy felt frustrated. His friend Sue had a fun idea, but he didn't understand it. Sue suggested that they have a picnic. Jimmy had no idea what that meant. 
"What do we need for a picnic?" he asked.
"Food!" Sue said. "I brought some popcorn!"
Jimmy was happy. He loved popcorn. They both spread out a blanket and sat down. Sue opened the bag of popcorn and gave some to Jimmy. He smiled and began to eat. 
Sue had a lot of fun ideas. Jimmy and Sue laughed and played games until it was dark. Jimmy was so happy. He couldn't wait to go on another picnic!

instruction:
Write a story about: An elephant who loved to tell jokes felt embarrassed and sad when nobody laughed at his joke. He practiced and told a better joke, which made his friends laugh and made him happy again.
With: happy ending
response:
He went to his mom and asked her why nobody laughed at his joke. His mom said, "Maybe your friends didn't understand the joke, or maybe it wasn't very funny." 
The elephant realized that he needed to tell better jokes that everyone could understand. So, he practiced and practiced until he had a really funny joke. When he told it to his friends, they all laughed and the elephant felt happy again.
Summary: An elephant who loved to tell jokes felt embarrassed and sad when nobody laughed at his joke. He practiced and told a better joke, which made his friends laugh and made him happy again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves trains and asks her parents to see a big, shiny train up close. She obediently holds her mother's hand and examines the train with her family, discovering a new favorite word - "examine".
With: happy ending
response:
Lily asked her mommy, "Can we go see the train up close?" Her mommy said, "Sure, but you have to be obedient and hold my hand."
Lily was very obedient and held her mommy's hand tightly as they walked towards the train. When they got there, Lily asked her daddy if they could examine the train and he said yes. They walked around the train, looking at all the different parts and colors. Lily loved every minute of it and couldn't stop smiling. 
As they walked back to their car, Lily said, "That was so much fun! Can we do it again tomorrow?" Her mommy and daddy laughed and said maybe they could. From that day on, Lily had a new favorite word - examine - and couldn't wait to examine more trains in the future.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy named Timmy loves listening to birds and playing with a hammer given by his dad. One day, while taking a nap, he hears his dad hammering something and gets scared, accidentally knocking over a vase and breaking it.
With: sad ending
response:
One afternoon, Timmy's mom asked him to take a nap. Timmy didn't want to, because he wasn't comfortable. "I don't want to take a nap, Mommy. I'm not comfortable," he said. But his mom insisted, so Timmy went to take a nap.
While Timmy was sleeping, he heard a loud noise. It was his dad hammering something in the other room. Timmy got scared and ran to see what was happening. He accidentally knocked over a vase and it shattered into a million pieces. Timmy started crying, but his dad didn't hear him because he was wearing headphones. Timmy was sad because he knew he was going to get in trouble for breaking the vase.

instruction:
Write a story about: A wild fox and a rabbit stumble upon a mysterious pile and find out it's a delicious cake, which they devour and have the best lunch ever.

response:
Once upon a time, a wild fox and a rabbit were on an adventure. The rabbit was full of energy and loved to explore. He stumbled across a huge mystery. 
The fox asked, "What is it?" 
The rabbit replies, "It looks like it could be a delicious surprise!" 
The fox grinned, "Let's find out."    
The two animals raced to the mystery. When they arrived, they saw a big pile of cake! 
The rabbit was so excited and took a bite. The fox couldn't resist and bit into the cake too. It was the most delicious cake they'd ever tasted! The two animals continued to bite and bite until the cake was gone. 
The mystery of the cake was solved and they had the best lunch ever!

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the library with her mommy to find a new book to read, and after finding the perfect novel, she reads it in peace after her brother agrees to play quietly.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mommy helped her check out the book and they went back home. Lily sat down on the couch and began to read. She was so excited to find out what happened to the princess. Suddenly, she heard a noise. "Zip, zip, zip!" It was her little brother playing with his toy car.
Lily said, "Please stop making noise, I'm reading my novel." Her brother replied, "Sorry, Lily. I'll play quietly." And from then on, Lily was able to read her novel in peace. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max doesn't listen to his mommy's advice, gets hurt on a slide, and learns to listen to her from then on.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Max's mommy took him to the park. Max saw a big slide and wanted to go down it. He climbed up the ladder and sat down on the top. His mommy told him to be careful and zip his jacket up. Max didn't listen and started to slide down.
Suddenly, Max's jacket got caught on the slide and he couldn't move. His mommy tried to help him, but it was too late. Max fell off the slide and hurt himself. He had to go to the hospital and get a big bandage on his head. From then on, Max always listened to his mommy and zipped up his jacket.
Summary: Max doesn't listen to his mommy's advice, gets hurt on a slide, and learns to listen to her from then on.

instruction:
Write a story about: A man named Tom tries to stop an earthquake by throwing a rope into the sky, but fails. The moral of the story is to not believe everything people say.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, a strong man named Tom came to the village. He told the people that he could stop the earthquake. Tom had a thick rope. He said he would throw the rope into the sky and pull the sky down. Then the earthquake would stop.
The people believed Tom. They helped him throw the thick rope into the sky. But the rope did not catch the sky. It fell back down on the village. The people were sad and scared. The earthquake did not stop. The village was not safe anymore.
The moral of the story is, don't believe everything people tell you. Sometimes, they can't really help.
Summary: A man named Tom tries to stop an earthquake by throwing a rope into the sky, but fails. The moral of the story is to not believe everything people say.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily falls from a tree while playing with her friend Tim and hurts herself badly, ending her day of playing.

response:
At the park, Lily saw her friend Tim. They wanted to play together. Tim said, "Let's climb the big tree!" Lily was scared, but she wanted to show Tim she could do it too. So, they started to climb the tree.
Lily did not care about being careful. She climbed higher and higher. Suddenly, she felt a big fall. She fell down from the tree and started to cry. Tim ran to get help, but it was too late. Lily had hurt herself very badly, and she could not play anymore.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl finds a loop of delicious snacks at the park but ends up losing them after they spill out of her ripped pocket.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved playing at the park. One day she set off on an adventure and came across a loop of delicious snacks. She smiled, and couldn’t wait to try them.
"I am going to store them in my pocket to eat later," she said. 
So she took the loop and put them into her pocket. She kept walking, but all of a sudden, she felt something sharp poke her. It was the loop, it had ripped the pocket and spilled onto the ground. 
The little girl started to cry, she knew she had made a mistake and felt so sad. She tried to scoop the snacks up and put them back into her pocket, but it was too late. 
She ended up going home empty handed, without any delicious snacks. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Joe accidentally breaks his mom's plate, but apologizes and she forgives him, and they hug before having a new meal.
With: happy ending
response:
Joe was very excited. His mom was making a yummy meal and he was so looking forward to it! He jumped around, clapping his hands in excitement. He was so happy!
Suddenly, Joe accidentally knocked the plate out of his mom's hands. The plate broke into pieces. Joe's mom was so sad. She started to cry.
Joe felt really bad. He knew his mom was mad at him. He decided to give her a big hug and said, "I'm sorry. Please forgive me."
His mom saw how sorry he was and, with a big smile, she hugged him back and said, "It's okay. I forgive you." Joe was so glad that his mom forgave him.
The two hugged each other tightly, and then his mom cooked a new meal. This time, Joe was more careful and excited to finally eat the yummy meal!

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds a barrel and plays pirate, but his friend Billy wants it all to himself and gets hurt when the barrel rolls down a hill.

response:
As he was playing, his friend Billy came by. "Wow, I'm so envious of your cool barrel!" said Billy.
"I believe you can play with it too," said Timmy.
But Billy didn't listen. He wanted the barrel all to himself. So he pushed Timmy out and climbed inside. But the barrel was too heavy and it rolled down a hill with Billy trapped inside.
Timmy was scared and ran to get help, but it was too late. Billy was hurt and had to go to the hospital. Timmy felt sad and wished he had never found the barrel.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the dog found a tunnel in the park and went inside to find an old toy. He wanted to replace it with a new one, but the tunnel collapsed on him and the new toy, making him unable to play in it anymore.

response:
Inside the tunnel, Max saw a toy. The toy was old and broken. Max wanted to replace the toy with a new one. He thought it would make the tunnel more fun. So, Max went back to his home to get a new toy.
Max brought the new toy to the tunnel. But when he went inside, he found out that the tunnel was not safe. The tunnel fell down on Max and the new toy. Max was very sad because he could not play in the tunnel anymore. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns to be kind to all living things after accidentally hurting a crab while playing in the sand.
