One day, Sam's friend, a little bird, told him that they need to go to the other side of the yard. They had to find the big red ball. Sam and his friends started to go, but Sam was very slow. His friends went fast, but Sam could not keep up.
Sam's friends found the big red ball, but they did not wait for Sam. They played with the ball and had fun. When Sam finally got there, they were done playing. Sam was sad because he was too slow and missed the fun.
Summary: Sam the slow snail and his friends go on a mission to find a big red ball on the other side of the yard, but Sam is too slow and misses out on the fun.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jane loves playing guitar, but when she sees a shiny, expensive one at the store, her parents refuse to buy it for her. Jane learns to appreciate the guitar she already has.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a happy family. The parents had a little girl named Jane, who was three years old. Jane had lots of toys, but her favorite was a guitar. She loved to make music with it. 
One day, Jane's parents went to the store and saw a shiny, expensive guitar. It was bigger and prettier than Jane's. Jane saw it too and asked to have it. 
Her dad said, "No, Jane. That guitar is too expensive." Jane said, "I want it! I need it!" Her parents said, "No, sweetie. You already have a guitar." 
Jane sighed and said, "Okay." She still wanted the shiny guitar, but her parents said she had to be happy with the one she had. 
So she went back home, held her own guitar tightly, and sang a song. No matter how expensive the guitar at the store was, her own was special to her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack learns that he can't always have what he wants when he sees a label on the floor at the supermarket.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was a boy named Jack. One day, Jack went to the supermarket with his mom. His mom said, "Jack, let's hurry, I want to buy some food before it gets too late."
Jack said, "OK, Mom." Jack and his mom started to hurry through the store. Then, Jack saw a label on the floor. He looked at it. He said, "Mom, can I have this label?"
His mom said, "No, Jack. That is a bad label. It's not for you."
Jack said, "Oh... OK. Let's hurry."
Then, Jack and his mom bought the food and went home. Jack had learned his lesson: sometimes you can't have something just because you want it - even if it's something as small as a label.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves to eat pancakes for breakfast, but when his mom tries a new syrup, Timmy's stomach starts to hurt, so he learns to ask what's in his food before eating it.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy's mom made him pancakes with a new syrup that she had bought. It looked disgusting, but Timmy didn't say anything because he didn't want to be rude. He started eating his pancakes, but he didn't like the taste.
After he finished eating, Timmy's stomach started to hurt. He realized that the new syrup wasn't good for him. From that day on, Timmy always asked his mom what was in his food before he ate it. He didn't want to eat anything disgusting again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tiny the bird and his friends seek shelter under a big tree during a rainstorm and remember it as a safe place to go in the future.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, it started to rain. Tiny and his friends needed to find a place to stay dry. They saw a big tree and decided to go there. The big tree had many leaves that could cover them from the rain.
They all sat under the big tree, feeling happy and safe. The rain stopped and the sun came out. Tiny and his friends went back to play in the sky. They were very careful and always remembered the big tree that helped them.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves to draw and write but her drawings and writings get ruined by the rain. She learns to be careful and keep them safe.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, it started to rain outside. The rain was so strong that it made the drain overflow. The water came into their house and ruined all of Lily's drawings and writings. She was sad and cried a lot.
Lily's mom was patient and tried to comfort her, but Lily was still upset. She wished she could write and draw again, but all her papers were wet and ruined. Sadly, the rain kept pouring and they couldn't fix the drain. From that day on, Lily learned to be careful with her drawings and writings, and to always keep them safe from the rain.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Lily's garden gets destroyed by a big dog, but her mom helps her plant new flowers.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, a big dog came running into the garden and started to play. Lily said, "Please don't destroy my flower, it's very delicate." The dog didn't listen and ran right through the garden, destroying everything in its path.
Lily was very upset and cried, "Why did you destroy my garden?" The dog didn't understand and just wagged its tail. Lily's mom came outside and saw what happened. She said, "Don't worry, we can plant new flowers together." Lily smiled and said, "Okay, let's plant new flowers that won't get wet or be delicate."

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl studies and learns about clay, makes a beautiful pot, and promises to study it more.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to study and learn lots of things. One day she decided to study clay. She touched the clay and it was very cold and wet. She picked up a piece of the clay and it was dark. 
The little girl looked around her and saw a bowl. She put some of the clay in the bowl and started to study it. She tried to poke it, roll it and shape it. She was so excited to see the clay change. 
After a while, the little girl made a beautiful pot with the clay. It was so dark and shiny. It was the best thing she had ever made. She was very proud of her work. 
The little girl was so happy to learn more about clay and she promised herself that she would study it more. Then she smiled and went off to play.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her dog Spot get lost on a walk, but Spot helps them find their way back home to their pink house.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Lily and Spot went for a walk. They walked so far that they could not see the pink house anymore. Lily started to feel sad. She wanted to go back home, but she did not remember the way. Spot looked at Lily and wagged his tail. He wanted to help her.
Spot sniffed the ground and started to walk. Lily followed him. They walked and walked until they saw the pink house. Lily was so happy that she hugged Spot. They were back home, and they would always remember the way now. From that day on, Lily and Spot played outside, but they never went too far from their pink house.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sam find a weird sack, but when they open it, a mean monster comes out and chases them, leaving them sad and scared.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim asked his friend, Sam, to help him open the weird sack. Sam was strong. He pulled the sack and snap! The sack opened. Tim and Sam looked inside, but they were scared. There was something big and dark in the sack.
They tried to close the sack, but it was too late. The big, dark thing came out of the sack. It was a mean monster. The monster chased Tim and Sam. The boys ran away, but the monster was too fast. The monster caught them and they could not go home. The boys were very sad and scared.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy sees a big, colourful thing that starts to move and spin around the park, making her feel happy and curious.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a cheerful girl called Lucy. She was out playing in the sunshine when she saw a strange thing. It was a big, colourful thing like nothing else she had ever seen. 
Lucy stopped and stared at the thing. She didn't know what it was, but it made her feel curious and happy. She decided to take a closer look and reached out to touch it. 
The thing suddenly started to move! Lucy was so surprised that she took a few steps back and just stared at it. The thing was moving all around the park, spinning and twirling in the air. It was so magical that Lucy couldn't take her eyes off it. 
As the thing moved away, Lucy waved goodbye and watched it until it was out of sight. She felt so cheerful and happy that she started to skip and dance around the park.
Summary: Lucy sees a big, colourful thing that starts to move and spin around the park, making her feel happy and curious.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim receives a big box as a prize and finds a new friend inside, a soft and cuddly teddy bear. They play together all day and go to bed tired but happy, looking forward to more fun the next day.
With: happy ending
response:
Tim opened the box and found a new friend inside. It was a soft, cuddly teddy bear. Tim loved his new bear so much. He played with it all day long. They had lots of fun together. They played hide and seek, and they had a tea party with Tim's other toys.
At night, Tim and the teddy bear were very tired. They had played all day. It was time for them to settle down and go to bed. Tim gave the bear a big hug and they both fell asleep. They had sweet dreams of their fun day together. And they knew that tomorrow, they would play and have even more fun.
Summary: Tim receives a big box as a prize and finds a new friend inside, a soft and cuddly teddy bear. They play together all day and go to bed tired but happy, looking forward to more fun the next day.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily cleans up her toys before dinner and looks forward to going to the park with her mom, but they have to go to the grocery store first.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily was eager to finish playing with her toys, but she knew she needed to clean up. She put her toys away and went to the kitchen for dinner. 
During dinner, Lily's mom asked her what she wanted to do tomorrow. Lily said she was eager to go to the park and play on the swings. Her mom reminded her that they needed to go to the grocery store first. 
After dinner, Lily went to bed and dreamed about playing on the swings at the park. She was eager to wake up and go on her adventure with her mom.

instruction:
Write a story about: A hunter meets a bear in the woods who takes him to a cave with tasty food, but then traps him inside.
With: sad ending
response:
In the woods, the hunter met a big bear. The bear said, "What do you do here?" The hunter said, "I look for tasty food." The bear said, "I have tasty food. Come with me."
The hunter went with the bear to a big cave. Inside the cave, there was a lot of tasty food. The hunter was very happy. But then, the bear closed the cave. The hunter could not get out. The hunter was sad because he could not go home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sue helps her friends by fixing their toys and gets a surprise when she helps a bird with a hurt wing stuck in a tree.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Sue saw a high tree with a big red ball stuck in it. She wanted to get the ball for her friend Tim. Sue thought and thought about how to get the high ball. She had an idea! Sue would use her long toy ladder to reach the ball. She put the ladder against the tree and climbed up. 
As Sue grabbed the ball, she saw a little bird in the tree. The bird had a hurt wing and could not fly. Sue knew she had to help. She carefully carried the bird down the ladder. Sue fixed the bird's wing with a soft bandage. The bird was so happy! It gave Sue a special treat from its nest. The treat was a shiny gold coin. Sue learned that helping others can bring unexpected surprises and joy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Maggie struggles to eat a tub of solid yogurt until she has the idea to soften it in warm water, allowing her to enjoy it.
With: happy ending
response:
Maggie looked for something to eat. She opened the cupboard to see what was there. Inside, the cupboard was full of food. She saw a big tub of yogurt. It was yellow and smelled sweet. She closed the cupboard door and grabbed the yogurt.
Maggie wanted to eat the yogurt but it was too hard. She grabbed a spoon and tried hard to dig into the soft tub. But it was no use. The yogurt was too solid.
Maggie thought and thought until she had an idea. She filled the sink with warm water and plopped the yogurt into it. She waited until the yogurt began to melt. When the yogurt was soft, Maggie smiled and said, "Yay!"
She grabbed the yogurt out of the sink and put it into a bowl. Now she could eat it! Maggie enjoyed the delicious yogurt and was very happy.
Summary: Maggie struggles to eat a tub of solid yogurt until she has the idea to soften it in warm water, allowing her to enjoy it.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jimmy and his parents went to the beach and took a little boat out to sea, but they sank during a big storm and were never seen again.
With: sad ending
response:
Jimmy and his parents went to the beach one day. It was a gloomy day, but Jimmy was excited because he thought he would get to go boating. When they got there, he saw a big yacht and he said, "Mommy, can we bring it?" His mom said, "No Jimmy, we cannot bring it. It costs too much money." 
Jimmy was disappointed, but then he spotted a little boat. "Can we bring that one, Mommy?" he asked. His mom said that they could, so she and his dad got it ready and they went out to sea. Everything was going well until they reached a small island. Suddenly, dark clouds started forming in the sky and large, rolling waves tossed the boat around. 
Jimmy's dad said they should go back, but it was too late. A big storm had come and the boat started filling with water. In the end, the little boat sank, and Jimmy, his parents, and the yacht were never seen again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Amy finds a blueberry bush in the park, picks some and makes a pie with her mom.
With: happy ending
response:
While skipping in the park, Amy found a big blueberry bush. She picked some blueberries and put them in her basket. Amy was so happy, she skipped all the way home.
At home, Amy showed her mom the blueberries. But, her mom saw that some were spoiled. They threw away the spoiled blueberries and washed the good ones. Then, they made a yummy blueberry pie together. Amy enjoyed her pie and kept skipping happily.
Summary: Amy finds a blueberry bush in the park, picks some and makes a pie with her mom.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her friends find a surprise inside a rock while playing at the park and enjoy the rest of their day playing together.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, Lily's friend Sarah had a surprise for her. "Look what I found!" Sarah said, holding up a big rock. "Let's split it open and see what's inside!"
Lily and her friends were excited to see what was inside the rock. They hit it with a hammer and it split open. Inside, they found a shiny crystal. "Wow!" Lily said, "That's so pretty!" They all took turns holding the crystal and admiring it.
After their fun surprise, Lily and her friends ran around and played some more. They had a great time together and couldn't wait to come back to the park again.
Summary: Lily and her friends find a surprise inside a rock while playing at the park and enjoy the rest of their day playing together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little girl named Sue played with a big hairy dog in the park, not knowing that the dog could turn into a man. When she saw the man, she got scared and he left, leaving her alone in the park.
With: sad ending
response:
Sue threw a ball for the dog. The dog ran fast to get the ball. He brought it back to Sue. They played like this for a long time. Sue was having so much fun. She looked at her arm and saw that it was getting late. Sue said, "Oh no, I have to go home now."
As Sue was leaving the park, she saw a big hairy man. He looked at Sue and said, "Hi Sue, I am the dog you were playing with." Sue was very scared. She did not know that the dog could turn into a man. The big hairy man said, "I am sorry, but I have to go now." And he went away, leaving Sue all alone in the park.

instruction:
Write a story about: A jolly soldier and his dog Max play in the park, but when they return home, they find that their house has been blown away by the wind, leaving them homeless.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the jolly soldier and Max went to the park. They played with a ball. Max would run and catch the ball. The soldier would kneel down and pat Max. They played for a long time. The sun was shining, and the birds were singing.
Then, it started to rain. The jolly soldier and Max ran home. They were wet and cold. When they got home, they saw that their house was gone. The wind blew it away. The jolly soldier and Max were very sad. They had no place to live.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bald man who loved solving mysteries found a mysterious box in the forest, but it turned out to be a trap, and he was taken away by bad guys who he couldn't escape from.
With: sad ending
response:
As he opened the box, he realized it was a trap! Smoke came out of the box and he fell to the ground. When he woke up, he was surrounded by bad guys who took him away. He tried to solve the mystery of how to escape, but he couldn't. 
Days went by and he was still stuck. He realized he might never be able to leave. The bad guys were mean to him and he missed his home. He wished he had never found the mysterious box. Sadly, the man never escaped and was never seen again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy's toy aeroplane is saved from a dangerous bird by a kind man who becomes his new friend.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy was scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, a kind man came and said, "Don't worry, I'll help you." The man took Timmy's aeroplane and closed it in his bag so the bird couldn't get it.
Timmy was so happy and said, "Thank you, mister! You saved my aeroplane!" The man smiled and said, "No problem, I'm glad I could help." Timmy went home with his aeroplane safe and sound, and he knew he had made a new friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily meets a friendly dog named Max and they play together in her garden, but the next day Max is missing and Lily sees a poster for a lost dog.
With: sad ending
response:
"Max, do you want to play with me?" Lily asked.
Max barked happily and followed Lily to her garden. They played together for hours, digging and rolling in the soil.
As the sun began to set, Lily's mom called her inside for dinner. "Bye, Max! See you tomorrow!" Lily waved to Max as he ran off.
The next day, Lily went outside to play with Max again. But Max wasn't there. Lily searched for him everywhere, but he was nowhere to be found.
Lily's heart sank when she saw a poster on a nearby tree. It read, "Lost Dog: Max. Please call if found." Lily knew that Max had gone missing and she felt sad. She wished she could hug him again and tell him how much she missed him.
Summary: Lily meets a friendly dog named Max and they play together in her garden, but the next day Max is missing and Lily sees a poster for a lost dog.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim tries to restore his broken cabinet with the help of his mom but they are unsuccessful and decide to buy a new one.
With: sad ending
response:
"Mom, can you help me fix my cabinet?" Tim asked. His mom said, "Yes, Tim. Let's be brave and try."
They tried to restore the cabinet, but it was hard. Tim's sister came in the room. She wanted to play with Tim's toys. Tim said, "No, we need to fix the cabinet first." His sister got mad and they began to fight.
In the end, they could not restore the cabinet. The brave boy, Tim, was sad. His mom said they will buy a new cabinet soon.

instruction:
Write a story about: A competitive boat sinks during a race after hitting a rock and the other boats don't stop to help, teaching the moral that being kind and helping others is more important than being competitive.
With: sad ending
response:
The boat started the race. It went very fast. The other boats were left behind. But then, the boat hit a rock. It started to sink. The other boats sailed past it. They didn't stop to help. The boat sank to the bottom of the sea.
The moral of the story is that being competitive is good, but it's more important to be kind and help others when they need it.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the big black dog is hungry and wants to be fed. His owner initially doesn't understand but eventually gives him food. Later, Max helps a lost little girl find her mommy and becomes her hero.
With: happy ending
response:
Max barked and said, "I am hungry! I want to eat!" His owner finally understood and gave Max some food to eat. Max was very happy and wagged his tail.
After he finished eating, Max went for a walk in the park. He saw a little girl who was also confused. She didn't know where her mommy was. Max went up to her and said, "Don't worry, I will help you find your mommy." Max sniffed around and found the little girl's mommy. The little girl was very happy and said, "Thank you, Max. You are my hero!"
Summary: Max the big black dog is hungry and wants to be fed. His owner initially doesn't understand but eventually gives him food. Later, Max helps a lost little girl find her mommy and becomes her hero.

instruction:
Write a story about: A turkey named Tom is afraid of being caught and cooked by humans, but is tragically shot by a hunter and dies in front of a group of children, who learn to be kind to animals and stop hunters from hurting them.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Tom was walking in the forest when he saw a group of children. The children were playing and having fun. Tom wanted to join in, but he was afraid they would try to catch him and cook him for dinner. 
Suddenly, a hunter appeared and started shooting at Tom. Tom tried to run away, but he couldn't stop the hunter's bullets. Sadly, Tom was shot and he fell down. The children were very sad to see their new friend die. They wished they could have saved Tom from the hunter. 
From that day on, the children learned to always be kind to animals and to stop hunters from hurting them. They never forgot their friend Tom the turkey.
Summary: A turkey named Tom is afraid of being caught and cooked by humans, but is tragically shot by a hunter and dies in front of a group of children, who learn to be kind to animals and stop hunters from hurting them.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy and Sally were excited to go on vacation on a big jet, but it crashed and they were hurt and had to go to the hospital.
With: sad ending
response:
When Timmy got on the jet, he saw a girl named Sally. Sally had a pale face and looked very scared. Timmy tried to make her feel better by telling her about all the fun things they would do on vacation.
But then, something bad happened. The jet crashed and Timmy and Sally did not win. They were hurt and had to go to the hospital. Timmy was sad that their vacation was ruined and he hoped that they would be okay.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack forgets to take off his new uniform after school and loses it, causing disappointment and the need for a new one.
With: sad ending
response:
Jack had an important day today. He was about to wear his new uniform for the first time. He was a bit nervous but he was ready. His mom and dad watched him from the window as he went off to school. 
During school he did really well. All his friends watched him as he played and enjoyed the day. But there was one problem - he forgot to take off his uniform when it was time to go home.
When he got to the front door, all the other kids had taken off their uniforms and gone, but he was still wearing his. He was so nervous that he ran away and hid behind a bush.
Jack's mom and dad found him and were very disappointed. They had to buy a new uniform as Jack lost his that day. He felt terrible, but no matter what he did, his uniform was gone and he had to start again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A friendly squirrel plays with children in the park, but when a sudden snowstorm hits, the squirrel doesn't listen to warnings and gets stuck. The moral is to listen to warnings to avoid danger.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a friendly squirrel who liked to play in the park. Every day, the squirrel would run and jump from tree to tree, and every day the squirrel would see a group of children playing.
The squirrel soon became brave and friendly and would even greet the children each day. One day, the children asked the squirrel to join them in their game. The children were very happy when the squirrel accepted and started to hop around.
But suddenly the sky changed and it started to snow. The children started to run home, and the squirrel got scared. The children told the squirrel not to worry and shouted "hurry!" But it was too late. The world had frozen around the squirrel and he couldn't move.
The moral of this story is that it is important to listen to warnings when something unexpected happens. That way, we can avoid danger and difficult situations.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy and his mommy go to buy a regular pen, and the boy learns how to use it by writing and drawing with it.
With: happy ending
response:
A boy and his mommy went to buy a pen. His mommy asked, "Do you know what kind of pen you want?" 
The boy said, "A regular pen!" 
His mommy smiled and said, "Great idea! Let's go find one." 
So they went to the store and found a regular pen. It was blue with a yellow cap and felt very smooth in the boy's hand. He was very happy that he got to pick out the pen. 
His mommy asked him if he knew how to use the pen. He shook his head yes. Then his mommy showed him how to write. 
The boy was very excited. He was so proud that he knew how to use the pen! 
The boy wanted to write with his pen all the time. He drew pictures of his mommy and his friends, and wrote words he knew. 
Now the boy always knows that he can use a pen to write.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lonely square twists around and becomes so twisted it can no longer fit in the corner, but ends up meeting other shapes and no longer feels lonely.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a square. It was small and fit in the corner of the room. The square was lonely so one day it decided to twist around. It didn’t know why but it felt like it should. 
So the square twisted and twisted until it was so twisted it couldn’t fit in the corner anymore. It was spinning around the room, almost like it was dancing. 
The square was enjoying its time, spinning and spinning. Until it started to slow down and stopped. It was in the middle of the room and so happy to meet all the other shapes it had never seen before. 
The square was no longer lonely and fit in really well with the other shapes.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom, a lawyer, lends money to his friend Jim but they later have a fight and Jim refuses to return the money, causing the end of their friendship. Tom tries to get his money back through another lawyer but is unsuccessful.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Jim and Tom had a fight. They were not friends anymore. Tom wanted his money back, but Jim did not want to give it back. They were both very sad and angry.
In the end, Tom went to see another lawyer to get his money back. But Jim did not have the money to give back to Tom. So, Tom lost his money and his friend. They never talked again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and Sam try to dig a big hole in Tim's yard but become frustrated when they can't make it bigger, and their spades break.
With: sad ending
response:
Tim's friend, Sam, came to play. Sam saw the small hole and said, "Why don't we make it bigger?" Tim and Sam used their spades to dig more. They dug and dug, but the hole was still not big.
Tim and Sam felt very frustrated. They wanted to create a big hole, but they could not. They kept digging and digging. Suddenly, they heard a loud "Crack!" Their spades broke! Now, they could not dig anymore.
Tim and Sam looked at their broken spades and the small hole. They were sad and frustrated. They could not create a big hole, and their spades were broken. This day had a bad ending.
Summary: Tim and Sam try to dig a big hole in Tim's yard but become frustrated when they can't make it bigger, and their spades break.

instruction:
Write a story about: A wild cat mistakes a big red bug for a ball and tries to play with it, but finds it tastes bad. Later, the cat discovers that the "ball" was actually a bug and they become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The wild cat ran and jumped on the ball. But the ball did not taste good. The cat thought, "Why does the ball taste bad?" The cat was sad and walked away.
Then, the big red ball started to move! It was not a ball at all! It was a big red bug. The bug said, "Thank you for not eating me!" The wild cat and the big red bug became friends and played together every day.

instruction:
Write a story about: A friendly tiger goes on an adventure and gets lost in the forest. He overhears hunters talking about hunting tigers and becomes scared. The hunters eventually catch him and he is never seen again.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a great tiger. He was big and strong, but he was also very friendly. One day, he decided to go explore the world.
He walked and walked until he came across a small village. He saw some children playing and said, "Hello! Where do you go?"
The children were scared and ran away. But one brave boy stayed and said, "We go home now. It is too dangerous to stay here."
The tiger felt sad, but he said goodbye and walked home. But as he walked, he got lost in the forest. He couldn't find his way back home.
Suddenly, he heard a group of humans talking. They said they were hunting tigers to get their skins. The tiger realised he was in danger, so he quickly ran away.
But he was too late. The hunters followed him and caught him in the end. The great tiger was never seen again.

instruction:
Write a story about: John gets hungry, eats an apple and a peach, but his stomach shrinks when he eats too much of the peach, and his mom advises him to take smaller bites.
With: happy ending
response:
John was very hungry. He looked in the fridge for something to eat, but all he found was an apple. He bit the apple and it was so juicy, he finished it in one bite.
John licked his lips and smiled. He was full, but not for long!
John looked down at his stomach, then back at the fridge. He was brave and decided to try again. He grabbed a big, juicy peach and bit into it. It was so sweet! 
But as John ate the peach, something strange started to happen. His stomach started to shrink!
John was surprised and asked why it was shrinking so fast.
His mom smiled and said, "That's because you ate the whole peach! Make sure to only eat a little bit or else your stomach will get too small!"
John nodded and ran off to find something else to eat, making sure to take smaller bites this time!

instruction:
Write a story about: Sam wants to play outside but it starts raining heavily and floods his home, forcing him and his family to move away.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. He was very eager to go outside and play with his friends. He put on his shoes, ran outside, and skipped along. 
Suddenly it started raining very hard. Sam watched as the puddles quickly grew. He had never seen so much water!
"Oh no!" Sam said. "A flood is coming!"
Sam was sad, but he hoped that the water would stop soon. He quickly ran inside to find his parents.
But it was too late. Sam watched with fear as the water flooded his home. He and his family were forced to move away.
Sam was very disappointed. He had hoped to stay in his home, but the water had other plans. He never got the chance to go outside and play again.
Summary: Sam wants to play outside but it starts raining heavily and floods his home, forcing him and his family to move away.

instruction:
Write a story about: A hero follows a colorful bird into the woods and tries to cross a river, but gets swept away and never seen again, teaching the moral of not following things blindly.
With: sad ending
response:

instruction:
Write a story about: Mum and Dad's ashtray falls into a hole in the ground due to the tough paper that Dad was folding.
With: sad ending
response:
Mum and Dad were together in the living room. Dad was folding some paper. Mum said, "That looks tough!" Dad replied, "Yes, it is."
Mum was holding an ashtray. It was made of metal and felt tough to touch. Dad said, "What are you going to do with that ashtray?" She said, "I'm going to keep it for me."
Dad kept folding the paper. He was almost finished when he heard a loud noise coming from outside. Mum said, "That's strange." 
They both went outside to investigate. It had started to rain, and there was a big hole in the ground beside their house. They saw that the ashtray had fallen into the hole. Dad tried to pull it out but it was too tough. 
Mum and Dad were sad because the ashtray was gone. All because of the tough paper that Dad had been folding.

instruction:
Write a story about: A colorful cat goes to the store to buy a big hug for her sad friend, the dog. Instead, the cat gets a box with a new toy ball for the dog, making both of them very happy.
With: happy ending
response:
At the store, the cat met a nice man. The cat said, "I want a big hug for my friend, the dog." The man smiled and said, "I have just the thing for you."
The man gave the cat a big box. The cat thought it was a hug inside. When the cat opened the box, she found a new toy ball for the dog. The cat was so happy and said, "Thank you!" The dog was very happy too. They both gave each other a big hug.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily asks her mom to buy her an expensive and special ice cream cone, and after getting it, she learns that it's okay to pick something expensive if it makes you happy.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily: "Mommy, can we buy that cone?"
Mommy: "That cone is very expensive, Lily. Maybe we can get a different one?"
Lily: "But I want that one. Can we pick it, please?"
Mommy: "Okay, we can pick it. But remember, it's very special and we need to take good care of it."
Lily was so happy that she got her special cone. She ate it slowly and enjoyed every bite. From that day on, she knew that sometimes it's okay to pick something expensive if it makes you happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily sees an angel in the sky and later finds a toy angel in a box during a rainy day. She keeps the toy angel with her always.
With: happy ending
response: Suddenly, the rain stopped and Lily saw a big box. She ran over to the box and tried to open it. It was wet and hard to open, but she kept trying. Finally, she was able to open it and inside was a toy angel with big wings just like the one she saw in the sky. She was so happy and hugged the toy angel tightly. From that day on, Lily kept the toy angel with her wherever she went.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy named Timmy is scared of a monster in a film, but decides to face his fear and watch it again. However, the monster comes out of the film and takes Timmy back into it forever.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy's mom told him that the monster wasn't real and that he didn't have to be afraid. But Timmy couldn't stop thinking about the monster. He started having bad dreams and couldn't sleep at night.
One day, Timmy decided to face his fear and watch the film again. But this time, something terrible happened. The monster came out of the film and into Timmy's room! The monster was so ugly that Timmy couldn't stand to look at it. Timmy tried to run away, but the monster caught him and took him back into the film forever. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim and his mom clean up the park using a bin and find a wild cat playing with a ball.
With: happy ending
response:
Tim and his mom found a lot of trash in the park. They put it all in the bin. As they were cleaning, they saw a wild cat. The cat was playing with a ball. Tim said, "Look, Mom! A wild cat!"
The wild cat saw Tim and his mom. It ran away fast. Tim and his mom laughed. They were happy they helped clean the park. They went home and told Dad about the wild cat and the bin.

instruction:
Write a story about: A chubby rhinoceros in a green jungle accidentally bumps into a tree while running and learns to be careful.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the chubby rhinoceros wanted to run very fast. He ran and ran, but he did not look where he was going. He bumped into a big tree. The tree shook and many leaves fell down.
The chubby rhinoceros felt sad because he hurt the tree. He tried to fix it, but he could not. The tree was not happy anymore. The chubby rhinoceros learned that he should be careful when he runs.

instruction:
Write a story about: A curious little boy finds a switch and presses it, causing the lights to go out. He continues to press switches and ends up trapped in a room, learning the lesson to resist his curiosity.
With: sad ending
response:
Once there was a little boy. He was so restless and was always seeking something new. One day he found a switch and he couldn’t resist pressing it. When he did, it made a loud sound and all the lights went out. He had been so curious about the switch, but he learned his lesson. He should have resisted the temptation of pushing it. 
He still wanted to explore, so once more he found himself pressing a switch, this time it was a bigger one. Again the lights went out, but it also made all the locks go up and he was trapped in the room. He was stuck and could not escape no matter how much he tried. 
He was so scared and will never forget the lesson of resisting his curiosity. He should have listened to his parents when they told him not to press the switch.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily found a red coin and showed it to her friends before putting it in her special box and dreaming of finding more shiny coins.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily went to the park to play on the swings. She showed her red coin to her friends and they admired it too. They played together until it was time to go home. 
That night, Lily put her red coin in a special box. She admired it one more time before going to sleep. She dreamed of finding more shiny coins and adding them to her collection.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves baking cookies and wants to make the most delicious ones in the world. Her friend Timmy visits and enjoys her cookies, but Lily tragically dies in a baking accident. Timmy is left saddened and will never taste her cookies again.
With: sad ending
response:
"Thank you, Timmy! I admire your kind words," Lily replied. They both ate some cookies and enjoyed them very much.
But then, Lily accidentally spilled some flour on the floor. She slipped and fell, and the hot oven fell on her. Timmy quickly called for help, but it was too late. Sadly, Lily did not survive.
Timmy was very sad and missed his friend. He remembered the delicious cookies she made and how he admired her baking skills. But now, he knew he would never taste her cookies again.
Summary: Lily loves baking cookies and wants to make the most delicious ones in the world. Her friend Timmy visits and enjoys her cookies, but Lily tragically dies in a baking accident. Timmy is left saddened and will never taste her cookies again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack and Jill were friends, but Jack teased Jill. After Jill made an order that Jack couldn't tease her anymore, they became good friends and played together every day.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there were two chubby kids named Jack and Jill. Jack loved to tease Jill, but Jill didn't like it. One day, Jack made an order: he said he would not tease Jill anymore. Jill was so happy! She smiled and hugged her friend.
But, the next day, Jack started teasing Jill again. Jill was sad, but didn't know what to do. Suddenly, an idea popped into her mind.
Jill made an order: if Jack wanted to keep playing with her, he must promise never to tease her again. Jack agreed, and they were both happy! Jack kept his promise and they became good friends, playing together every day.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily enjoys her Sunday at the park with her family and friend Max, but her attempt to catch a butterfly fails. They have a picnic and Lily dreams about the butterfly at night.
With: happy ending
response:
At the park, Lily saw her friend, a little boy named Max. They played on the swings and the slide. Suddenly, Lily saw a butterfly. It was so pretty and had brilliant colors. She tried to catch it, but it flew away. 
After playing, Lily and her family had a picnic. They ate sandwiches and fruit. Lily's mom brought cookies for dessert. They had a fun day, and Lily was happy. She went to bed that night, dreaming of the brilliant butterfly she saw at the park.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her dog Spot find a big puddle of oil in the woods and call the fire department to clean it up, feeling happy about helping the environment.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily and Spot ran back to their house to find her mom. She pointed to the phone and told Lily to call the fire department. The firemen came quickly and cleaned up the oil. Spot was very nosy and wanted to help, but Lily told him to stay back.
After the firemen left, Lily and Spot went back to playing in the sunshine. Lily was happy she had helped the environment and knew she had done the right thing by pointing out the oil.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom the cat and Sue the bird discovered a wire that turned out to be a friendly snake, and they all became friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Tom met a bird named Sue. Tom said, "Sue, I found an important wire. Let's play with it!" Sue was excited and flew down to see the wire. They started to play, but something unexpected happened.
As they played with the wire, it moved! It was not just a wire, but a long snake! Tom and Sue were scared, but the snake said, "Don't worry, I am a nice snake. I just want to play too!" So, Tom, Sue, and the snake played together and became good friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bus helps its friend Tom, a baker, find his lost recipe for soft bread by discovering it was in the bus all along.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the bus was driving around the town when it saw Tom. Tom was very sad. The bus wanted to help Tom, so it stopped and let Tom get in. Tom told the bus that he could not bake soft bread today because he lost his recipe. The bus wanted to help Tom find the recipe.
They drove around the town looking for the recipe. Then, something unexpected happened. The bus found the recipe in its own seat! The bus had it all along. Tom was very happy and thanked the bus. Now, Tom could bake soft bread again. The bus and Tom became even better friends, and they always helped each other.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her friend Timmy rake leaves together and learn that working together makes things easier and more fun.
With: happy ending
response:
"Hi Lily! What are you doing?" asked Timmy. 
"I'm playing with my rake! Do you want to help me rake the leaves?" replied Lily. 
"Sure!" said Timmy, and they began to rake the leaves together. 
After they finished, Lily said, "Now we can sit and rest. Raking is hard work!" 
The moral of the story is that working together makes things easier and more fun.

instruction:
Write a story about: Kitty the cat helps deliver things to hotel guests and is surprised with a party by her cat friends for being a good helper.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Kitty had to deliver a big box to a room. She pushed the box with her nose and paws. It was hard work, but Kitty was a strong cat. She finally got the box to the room and knocked on the door with her tail.
When the door opened, there was a big surprise! Inside the room, there were many cute cats just like Kitty. They were having a party for Kitty because she was such a good helper. Kitty was so happy! From that day on, she and her new cat friends would deliver things together and make the hotel guests smile.

instruction:
Write a story about: A village with a beautiful park and houses was destroyed by a storm, making the people sad and forcing them to find a new place to live.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, a big storm came and destroyed the village. The houses were knocked down and the park was ruined. The people were very sad and had to leave their village. They had to find a new place to live. 
The new village they found was very nice, but it was not their old village. They missed their old village and all the things that included their memories. They were sad, but they knew they had to move on.
Summary: A village with a beautiful park and houses was destroyed by a storm, making the people sad and forcing them to find a new place to live.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves playing with bubbles in the bathtub, but he doesn't realize the water is draining. He gets stuck and hurts himself, learning to be careful in the future.
With: sad ending
response:
While he was playing, Timmy realized that the water was getting lower and lower. He didn't know why, but he kept playing. Suddenly, the water was all gone and the bathtub was dry. Timmy was very sad because he couldn't play anymore.
Timmy tried to get out of the bathtub, but he was stuck. The tube of bubbles had fallen on the floor and the soap had made it slippery. Timmy couldn't get out and he started to cry. His mom came in and found him stuck in the bathtub. She helped him get out, but Timmy had hurt himself. He had to go to the hospital and get a cast on his leg. Timmy learned that he should always be careful when playing in the bathtub.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim loves his big, red car with thick wheels and drives it around the park until he gets stuck in a puddle and has to call his dad for help.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Tim went to the park with his car. He drove around and around, feeling happy. But then, he saw a big puddle in the road. Tim remembered his mom telling him not to drive through puddles because it could be dangerous. But Tim didn't listen. He drove his car straight into the puddle.
Suddenly, the car stopped moving. Tim tried to start it again, but it wouldn't work. He was stuck in the middle of the puddle. Tim felt sad and scared. He remembered what his mom said, but it was too late. Tim had to call his dad to come and help him get the car out of the puddle. From that day on, Tim always remembered to listen to his mom and be careful when driving his car.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes to the park with her parents, goes on a big slide, shares food with ducks, and wants to come back again.
With: happy ending
response:
When they got there, Lily saw a big slide and wanted to go on it. But it looked too high and scary. Her mommy said, "Don't worry, it's easy. I'll help you." So, her mommy held her hand and they went up the slide together. It was so much fun!
After playing for a while, they sat down to eat their food. Lily had a sandwich and some fruit. She shared some with the ducks in the pond. They quacked happily and ate the food.
As they were leaving the park, Lily said, "I want to come back again tomorrow." Her mommy and daddy smiled and said, "We will come back soon. We always have fun at the park." And Lily was happy.
Summary: Lily goes to the park with her parents, goes on a big slide, shares food with ducks, and wants to come back again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Dan's little brother Andy finds a box of toys and starts playing with them, but suddenly falls ill and passes away.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Dan was taking care of his little brother, Andy. Andy was 3 years old, and very alert. He loved to explore and play.
As Dan was cleaning the house, Andy found a big box. Inside it were lots of toys he had never seen before. He couldn't wait to play with them. 
He opened one and started having fun, when suddenly he sneezed. His stomach started to feel funny. Dan noticed and asked: "Andy, are you alright?"
Andy did not answer and kept playing. Suddenly his stomach got very bad and he started to feel sick. Dan asked him again: "Andy, tell me what's wrong!"
Andy wanted to answer, but he did not have enough time. Soon he was too weak and he passed away.
Dan was sad and heartbroken. He could not believe what happened. His little brother was no longer with him.
Summary: Dan's little brother Andy finds a box of toys and starts playing with them, but suddenly falls ill and passes away.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom the cat and Max the dog played with a ball in the park until a bird took it away. Tom came up with an idea for Max to ask the bird nicely for the ball back, and it worked. They played with the ball all day.
With: happy ending
response:
Tom and Max found a ball in the park. They took turns kicking it. They were having fun. Then, a big bird came and took the ball away. Tom and Max were sad. They wanted their ball back.
Tom had an idea. He told Max to use his big voice and ask the bird nicely for the ball. Max said, "Please, bird, give us our ball back." The bird heard Max's voice and was surprised. The bird signed that it was sorry and gave the ball back. Tom and Max were happy and played with the ball all day.

instruction:
Write a story about: A family decides to restore their home by buying lumber and working hard, and they wake up to a beautiful restored home.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a charming family of four. One day, the mommy and daddy decided to make their home more beautiful.
"Let's go and buy some lumber," said the mommy.
The family went to the store to buy some lumber and other materials. They loaded the lumber into the car and drove home.
The family began to work hard to restore their home. They worked hard all day, until the darkness descended.
The next morning, the family awoke to a charming sight. The home had been restored!
"It looks beautiful!" said the daddy.
"Yes, it does," replied the mommy.
The family was very happy with their beautiful, restored home. They vowed never to forget how hard they'd worked to make it charming.
Summary: A family decides to restore their home by buying lumber and working hard, and they wake up to a beautiful restored home.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boy plays with a ball in a stadium and accidentally bounces it so high that it goes up into the sky. A bird catches the ball and brings it back to the boy so they can continue playing together.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, a little boy came to the stadium. He saw the ball and wanted to play with it. He started to bounce the ball. It went up and down, up and down. The boy was very happy.
But then, something unexpected happened. The ball bounced so high that it went up into the sky! The boy was sad because he could not play with the ball anymore. But then, a big bird saw the ball and caught it. The bird brought the ball back to the boy. The boy was happy again, and they all played together in the peaceful stadium.
Summary: A little boy plays with a ball in a stadium and accidentally bounces it so high that it goes up into the sky. A bird catches the ball and brings it back to the boy so they can continue playing together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's pet bird Tweetie flies out of its cage and gets burned by a lightbulb, leading to its death. Lily learns to be more careful in the future.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily saw Tweetie flying around the room and she was happy. She said, "Look, Tweetie is flying! I'm so happy!" But then, Tweetie flew too close to the lightbulb and got burned. The lightbulb made Tweetie glow, but it was not a happy glow. 
Lily saw that Tweetie was hurt and started to cry. She said, "Oh no, Tweetie got hurt. I'm so sad." Lily's mom tried to help Tweetie, but it was too late. Tweetie was gone forever. Lily was very upset and missed her bird friend. She learned to always be careful and make sure the birdcage was closed, so no birds would get hurt again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves sweet melons and chases a nosy squirrel away from her backyard, but later decides to share her melons with the squirrel and they become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The next day, Lily woke up early to check on her melons. To her surprise, she saw the same nosy squirrel trying to steal another melon. But this time, she had a plan. She put a scarecrow next to her melons to scare the squirrel away. 
Days passed and Lily's melons grew bigger and bigger. She was so excited to eat them! But one day, she noticed that one of her melons had a small bite mark on it. She knew it was the nosy squirrel again. But instead of getting angry, she decided to share her melons with the squirrel. From that day on, the squirrel and Lily became friends and shared the melons together.
Summary: Lily loves sweet melons and chases a nosy squirrel away from her backyard, but later decides to share her melons with the squirrel and they become friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A crane accidentally destroys a little boy's toy car, but the boy forgives the crane after it apologizes and they become good friends.
With: happy ending
response:
The little boy went up to the crane and said, "Why did you destroy my toy car? Now I'm upset." The crane felt bad and said, "I'm sorry. I didn't mean to destroy your toy car. I was just doing my job."
The little boy forgave the crane and said, "It's okay. But please be more careful next time." From then on, the crane was more careful and made sure not to destroy anything else. The little boy and the crane became good friends and the little boy even got to ride in the crane's big bucket. They had a lot of fun together and the little boy was no longer upset.
Summary: A crane accidentally destroys a little boy's toy car, but the boy forgives the crane after it apologizes and they become good friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily asks her mom for help getting jam, but is told to clean up the kitchen first. While cleaning, she accidentally hurts herself and learns to be more careful.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily decided to ask her mom for help. "Mommy, can you please get me the jam?" she asked. Her mom replied, "Sure, but first you need to clean up the mess you made in the kitchen." Lily grabbed a sponge and started to clean up. She accidentally dropped the sponge in the sink and it started to soak up water.
While her mom was getting the jam, Lily tried to grab the sponge from the sink. She slipped and fell, hitting her head on the counter. Her mom rushed over to help, but it was too late. Lily had hurt herself badly and had to go to the hospital. From that day on, Lily never left a mess in the kitchen again.
Summary: Lily asks her mom for help getting jam, but is told to clean up the kitchen first. While cleaning, she accidentally hurts herself and learns to be more careful.

instruction:
Write a story about: Joe's friends try to help him replace his old toy car, but they end up finding a broken replacement and Joe decides to keep his old car.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Joe had an interesting look on his face. His friends asked him what was wrong.
Joe said, "I want to replace my old toy car with a newer one."
His friends thought this was a great idea and decided to help him. They searched everywhere to find the perfect car to replace the old one.
Finally, they found something that looked just like Joe's old car. They excitedly brought it to him and showed him.
Unfortunately, the car they found wasn't as good as they thought. It was broken! Joe was very sad and there was nothing they could do. They had to accept that Joe was going to keep his old car.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a hidden spot in the park and doesn't want to share it with her friends, but later realizes that sharing is important when her friends find a new spot to play without her.
With: sad ending
response:
When her friends arrived, Lily told them about her hidden spot. They all wanted to play hide-and-seek there. But Lily didn't want to share her spot. She said, "No, this is my spot. You can't play here." Her friends sighed and went to find another spot to play.
Lily felt happy that she had her own special spot. But as she was hiding, she realized that she was all alone. Her friends had found a new spot and were having fun without her. Lily felt sad and wished she had shared her spot with her friends.
The moral of the story is that it's important to share with others. If you don't share, you might end up alone and sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her mommy go on an adventure to the east, where they see a bird singing and climb a big mountain to see the view.
With: happy ending
response:
As they walked, they saw a bird in a tree. Lily urged her mommy to stop and look. "Look, mommy! The bird is singing a pretty song!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, Lily. It's a lovely sound."
After a while, they saw a big mountain. Lily asked, "Mommy, can we climb it?" Her mommy said, "Of course, Lily! Let's climb to the top and see the view." They climbed and climbed until they reached the top. Lily looked out and said, "Wow, mommy! The view is so pretty! I'm so glad we came to the east."
Summary: Lily and her mommy go on an adventure to the east, where they see a bird singing and climb a big mountain to see the view.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loved yogurt and wanted a balloon at the park, but it flew away and made her sad.
With: sad ending
response:
"Mommy, can I have that balloon?" Lily asked.
"Sure, let me attach it to your wrist so you don't lose it," Mommy replied.
Lily was so happy with her new balloon. She played with it and showed it to everyone at the park. But then, a gust of wind came and blew the balloon away. Lily cried and cried, but her balloon was gone forever.
The foreshadowing was when Mommy attached the balloon to Lily's wrist. The setup was when Lily saw the balloon and wanted it. The payoff was when the balloon flew away and Lily was sad.
Summary: Lily loved yogurt and wanted a balloon at the park, but it flew away and made her sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: A kind boy tries to forgive his mean friend, but when his friend throws away his iron and it gets broken, he decides to end their friendship.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a kind boy who had a friend. His friend was very mean and he often made him sad. But the kind boy was patient and he always tried to forgive his mean friend. 
One day, the mean friend went too far. He took the kind boy's iron and threw it away! The kind boy asked him to take it back, but the mean friend refused. The kind boy was so sad, but he tried to remain patient and forgive his mean friend.
But the next day, the kind boy found out that his iron was broken! He was so sad, he could not forgive his mean friend anymore and he decided not to be friends anymore. 
The end!

instruction:
Write a story about: A generous man brings gifts to everyone he sees, including the animals in the forest. He decides to bring a surprise gift but it scares the animals and they run away, teaching him a lesson about checking before giving surprises.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a generous man. He brought kind gifts to everyone he saw. Everyone was happy when he arrived and so were all the animals in the forest.
One day, the generous man wanted to bring something special for all the little animals. He thought and he thought and finally, he decided to bring a big shock. He was sure all the animals would be excited.
The generous man arrived in the forest with the surprise, but to his surprise, he saw none of the animals. They were scared when they saw the shock and had quickly run away. The generous man was so sad he started to cry.
The generous man learned an important lesson that day: Surprise gifts can be scary and it is always better to check first before bringing something special to someone.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lazy cat named Tom meets a friendly mouse named Jerry inside a big pipe in the park and they become good friends, playing together every day and making Tom less lazy.
With: happy ending
response:
Tom did not know what was inside the pipe, but he wanted to find out. He dared himself to go inside the pipe. Tom walked slowly into the pipe, looking around to see what he could find.
Inside the pipe, Tom met a friendly mouse named Jerry. Jerry was not lazy like Tom. Jerry liked to run and play all day. Tom and Jerry became good friends, and they played together in the pipe every day. Tom was not lazy anymore, and they had lots of fun.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy makes friends with a scared crab on the beach by showing kindness, feeding it, and visiting it every day.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a kind boy. He liked to go to the beach and have fun. One day, he was walking and saw a crab on the sand. He was very excited and wanted to touch it. But the crab was scared, so the boy wiped his hands to show he was friendly.
The crab saw this and started walking towards the boy. He was amazed and started to pat the crab lightly. The crab stayed still and let the boy touch him. 
The boy then looked around the beach and found some food for the crab. He brought it closer and the crab ate it all up! The boy was so happy and proud, that he had made a new friend. 
The boy and the crab were now friends. He would come to the beach every day and visit his new friend, the crab. They would have a lot of fun together, both in and out of the water. Even as the boy grew up, he still visited his kind crab friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: An old car runs out of gas, but the driver finds some and puts it in the car, making it happy again.
With: happy ending
response: Summary: An old car runs out of gas, but the driver finds some and puts it in the car, making it happy again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the grumpy dog loses his bone and with the help of his friend Chirpy the bird, they find it in the possession of a squirrel who returns it to Max, making him happy and grateful.
With: happy ending
response:
Chirpy said, "Let's look for your bone together." So, they both looked high and low for the bone. After a long time, they were very tired. Chirpy said, "Max, let's rest for a while under this big tree."
As they rested under the tree, they heard a strange sound. They looked up and saw a squirrel holding Max's bone! The squirrel said, "I found this bone and thought it was a nut. I'm sorry, Max. Here is your bone back."
Max was so happy to have his bone back. He thanked the squirrel and Chirpy for their help. From that day on, Max was not grumpy anymore, and they all became good friends.
Summary: Max the grumpy dog loses his bone and with the help of his friend Chirpy the bird, they find it in the possession of a squirrel who returns it to Max, making him happy and grateful.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little duck named Quackers meets a swan who is mean to him, so he tries to show the swan that he can whistle too. However, the swan chases Quackers out of the pond, making him sad.
With: sad ending
response:
"Who are you?" asked Quackers.
"I am a swan," said the bird. "I can swim and whistle better than you."
Quackers didn't like that the swan was being mean. So, he decided to show the swan that he could whistle too. Quackers took a deep breath and whistled as loud as he could.
But the swan didn't like that Quackers could whistle too. So, the swan chased Quackers out of the pond. Quackers was very sad and had to find a new place to swim.
Summary: A little duck named Quackers meets a swan who is mean to him, so he tries to show the swan that he can whistle too. However, the swan chases Quackers out of the pond, making him sad.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily forgets to brush her cat Mittens before going to bed and can't find the brush the next day, leaving Mittens with tangled fur and feeling miserable.
With: sad ending
response:

instruction:
