Her mom ran over and quickly covered her with a blanket. Lilah felt safe and warm.
The moral of the story is to always listen to your parents, no matter how brave and curious you are. They know best.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loves to climb trees and asks his mom to play with a big drum in their backyard, but the drum rolls over and Timmy gets hurt. He learns to be careful and plays with his toys inside from then on.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy started to climb on the drum and played a tune. Suddenly, the drum rolled over and Timmy fell down. He hurt his head and started crying. His mom rushed to him and took him to the hospital. The doctor said, "Timmy has a big bump on his head. He needs to rest for a few days."
Timmy was sad because he couldn't play outside for a while. He learned that it's important to be careful when climbing and playing with things. From then on, Timmy played with his toys inside where it was safe.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim's uniform was dirty and his friends noticed and commented on it, making him feel sad throughout the day at school.
With: sad ending
response:
At school, his friend Sam saw his dirty uniform. Sam mentioned, "Tim, your uniform is filthy!" Tim felt sad and wanted to go home. But he could not leave school.
The day went on, and more friends saw Tim's filthy uniform. They all mentioned how dirty it was. Tim felt sadder and sadder. At the end of the day, he went home with a heavy heart. He wished he had a clean uniform to wear. The day was bad for Tim, and he hoped for a better day tomorrow.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily wants to play in the snow but her mommy is busy, so she asks her daddy to play with her and they make a snowman together.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily decided to request her daddy to come and play with her in the snow. Her daddy was happy to hear her request and quickly put on his coat and boots. They went outside and made a snowman together. 
After playing for a while, they went back inside to warm up. Lily's mommy was happy to see them having fun in the snow. She said, "I'm glad you had a good time, Lily. It's nice to take a break when we are busy." Lily smiled and nodded her head in agreement.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves to eat waffles and shares them with her friend Timmy after her nosy neighbor Mr. Smith declines her offer.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily replied, "I'm eating a waffle. Do you want one?"
Mr. Smith shrugged his shoulders and said, "No, thank you. I'm not a big fan of waffles."
Lily finished her breakfast and went outside to play. She saw her friend, Timmy, and asked him if he wanted to play. Timmy said, "Sure, but first, can I have a waffle?"
Lily smiled and said, "Of course! I have plenty to share." And they happily ate waffles together.
Summary: Lily loves to eat waffles and shares them with her friend Timmy after her nosy neighbor Mr. Smith declines her offer.

instruction:
Write a story about: Coco the crocodile helps a group of lost birds find their parents.
With: happy ending
response:
Coco said to the birds, "Don't be scared. I will lead you to your mom and dad." The birds were happy and followed Coco. They walked together and talked together.
In the end, Coco led the birds to their mom and dad. The birds said, "Thank you, Coco!" Coco felt happy that he could help his new friends.
Summary: Coco the crocodile helps a group of lost birds find their parents.

instruction:
Write a story about: Max the dog loves beef but burns his tongue trying to eat some that is too hot, and learns to stick to his dog food from then on.
With: sad ending
response:
When Max got to the kitchen, he saw that his owner was cooking beef, but it was too big to fit in the pan. Max thought he could help by eating some of the beef, but his owner said no. Max was sad, but he waited patiently for the beef to finish cooking.
Finally, the beef was ready and Max's owner gave him a small piece to taste. But the beef was too hot and Max burned his tongue. He yelped and ran away, never wanting to eat beef again. From that day on, Max only ate his dog food and never bothered his owner while cooking again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a pretty poem in her garden and reads it over and over until she becomes sad and stops skipping.
With: sad ending
response:
"This poem is so pretty," Lily said.
"Yes, it is," said her mother. "But be careful, Lily. Some poems can be bitter."
"What does bitter mean?" asked Lily.
"It means it can make you feel sad," her mother explained.
Lily didn't understand, so she skipped away with the poem. She read it over and over again until she felt very sad. She didn't want to skip anymore. She showed the poem to her mother, but it was too late. The bitter poem had made Lily so sad that she never skipped again.
Summary: Lily finds a pretty poem in her garden and reads it over and over until she becomes sad and stops skipping.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily accidentally drops a bottle of water in her classroom and feels sad, but learns to be more careful in the future.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily was very excited to help her teacher, so she brought the bottle of water to class. But when she got to the classroom, she accidentally dropped the bottle and it broke. All the water spilled on the floor and everyone got wet.
Lily felt very sad because she lost the bottle of water and the classroom was now wet. Her teacher was very upset and Lily felt very bad. From that day on, Lily always made sure to be very careful with everything she did.

instruction:
Write a story about: A gray rabbit finds a big field with lots of green grass and likes to eat and watch it grow. After a big rain, the grass grows very tall and the rabbit is happy to play in it.
With: happy ending
response:
The rabbit liked to eat the grass. Every day, the rabbit would go to the field. The rabbit would eat and eat. The grass would grow back. The rabbit liked to watch the grass grow.
One day, a big rain came. The rain made the grass grow very tall. The rabbit was so happy. The rabbit hopped and played in the tall grass. The gray rabbit and the green grass were friends forever.
Summary: A gray rabbit finds a big field with lots of green grass and likes to eat and watch it grow. After a big rain, the grass grows very tall and the rabbit is happy to play in it.

instruction:
Write a story about: A restless little girl in a big city discovers a tree in the park that is giving the city fresh air.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a restless little girl. She lived in a big city that was full of people, noise, and buildings. Everywhere she went she saw lots of things that she didn't recognize. 
One day she went to the park with her mom. As they walked around, the little girl saw something that she did recognize! In the park was a big, green tree full of leaves. She quickly ran towards it, marveling at its beauty. 
Just then, the little girl noticed that all around the tree were little holes in the ground. She leaned in close, curious to see what they were. From the holes, oxygen was coming out! Suddenly the little girl realized that the tree was helping to give the city fresh air. 
The little girl smiled to herself. She was happy to recognize something so beautiful and helpful in the huge city around her.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim visits his grandma and looks for her cat, Mr. Whiskers, but finds a cute little dog instead. Later, he finds Mr. Whiskers hiding in the house and is happy to have two friends to play with.
With: happy ending
response:
When Tim got to his grandma's house, he felt a shiver. He looked around and saw that Mr. Whiskers was not there. Tim was sad and asked his grandma, "Where is Mr. Whiskers?"
Grandma smiled and said, "Let's go outside and look for him." They went outside and saw a big box. Tim opened the box and, surprise! Inside the box was not Mr. Whiskers, but a cute little dog! Tim was so happy and laughed. He played with the little dog all day and forgot about Mr. Whiskers.
At the end of the day, Tim went inside to say goodbye to his grandma. When he opened the door, there was Mr. Whiskers! He had been hiding in the house the whole time. Tim was so happy to see him, and now he had two friends to play with when he visited his grandma.

instruction:
Write a story about: An old man and his lab went for a walk, and the lab flew to get help when the old man fell and injured himself. The lab passed away from exhaustion after saving the old man.
With: sad ending
response: Suddenly, a big gust of wind blew and the old man fell down. He hurt his leg and couldn't walk anymore. The lab tried to help him, but he couldn't do much. Then, something unexpected happened. The lab started to fly! He flew up into the sky and brought back help for the old man. But when they returned home, they found out that the lab was too tired from flying and had passed away. The old man was sad, but he knew his lab had saved him.

instruction:
Write a story about: A sad cloud with a hole meets a bird who helps fix the hole with soft fluff, making the cloud happy and no longer envious of the sun, and they become best friends.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the cloud met a bird. The bird said, "I can help you fix your hole." The cloud was very happy. The bird found some soft fluff and put it in the hole. The cloud felt better and thanked the bird.
Now, the cloud could be like the other clouds. It was no longer envious of the sun. The cloud and the bird became best friends. They played in the sky together and watched the sun shine brightly. And they all lived happily ever after.
Summary: A sad cloud with a hole meets a bird who helps fix the hole with soft fluff, making the cloud happy and no longer envious of the sun, and they become best friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily gives Jack her extra pencil, but when she asks for it back, he refuses to return it, teaching the lesson that it's important to share and be kind to others.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily said, "I have an extra pencil, you can keep it." Jack was happy and said thank you. They played together for a while and then Jack had to go home.
The next day, Lily saw Jack with her pencil. She went up to him and said, "Can I have my pencil back now?" Jack said, "No, I want to keep it." Lily felt hurt and sad that Jack didn't want to give her pencil back.
The moral of the story is that it's important to share and be kind to others. Keeping things that don't belong to you can hurt other people's feelings.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her friend Timmy play with Lily's new doll until Lily's mom asks them to help water and spray the plants, which they happily do together.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy nodded and they started to play. Suddenly, Lily's mom came in with a bottle of water and a spray bottle. "I need to water the plants and spray them with this special water," said Lily's mom. "Can we help?" asked Lily. "Sure, you can help me spray the plants," said Lily's mom.
Lily and Timmy were very excited to help. They sprayed the plants with the special water and had so much fun. After they finished, Timmy said, "Thank you for letting me visit, Lily. I had so much fun." "You're welcome," said Lily. "I had fun too. Let's play again soon!"
Summary: Lily and her friend Timmy play with Lily's new doll until Lily's mom asks them to help water and spray the plants, which they happily do together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily gives her favorite dress to her friend Sarah for a school party, but Sarah ends up wearing a different dress her mother bought. Lily learns that being kind and thoughtful towards others is more important than material possessions.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily decided to give the dress to Sarah so she could wear it to the party. Sarah was so happy and hugged Lily tightly. Lily felt happy too because she knew she did the right thing. 
But then, something unexpected happened. When Lily arrived at the party, she saw Sarah wearing a different dress. Lily asked her why she wasn't wearing the pink dress she gave her. Sarah explained that her mother had bought her a new dress for the party and she didn't want to hurt Lily's feelings by not wearing it. 
Lily understood and was proud of Sarah for being so kind. She learned that it's not about what you wear, but how you treat others that matters most. And from that day on, Lily and Sarah became even better friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily goes on a journey to see her grandma despite the cold weather, has a nice visit, but gets lost and never makes it back home.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily walked and walked until she finally saw her grandma's house. She was so happy to see her and they had a nice visit. But then it was time for Lily to go back home. She didn't want to leave her grandma, but she knew she had to go.
As she walked back home, it started to get even colder. Lily was shivering and her teeth were chattering. But she kept going because she wanted to get back to her mommy. Suddenly, she fell down and hurt herself. She couldn't get up and nobody was there to help her. She was very scared and cold. Unfortunately, Lily never made it back home and nobody knew where she was.
Summary: Lily goes on a journey to see her grandma despite the cold weather, has a nice visit, but gets lost and never makes it back home.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Max had a fun time taking baths together after Max accidentally pushed Lily into the water.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Lily's little brother Max came into the bathroom. Max was not very graceful and he accidentally pushed Lily into the water. Lily was very upset and started crying.
"Max, why did you push me? That was not nice!" Lily said.
"I'm sorry, Lily. I didn't mean to push you. I just wanted to see your bathtub toys," Max replied.
Lily forgave Max and they both played in the bathtub together. They had so much fun, and Lily even taught Max how to be more graceful in the water. From then on, they always had a great time taking baths together.
Summary: Lily and Max had a fun time taking baths together after Max accidentally pushed Lily into the water.

instruction:
Write a story about: A rare lion befriends a little girl in the forest and they become inseparable.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a rare lion who lived in a deep, dark forest. He was always alone, as he could not find any other lions like him.
One day, he heard a strange noise coming from a nearby tree. He walked over to check it out, and he was surprised to see a little girl peeking out of the leaves. 
The lion was scared at first, but the little girl just smiled and bowed to him, before leaning against the tree. The lion was fascinated and felt drawn to the little girl. He stepped closer and leaned towards her, as if he wanted to give her a hug!
The little girl was so touched by the lion's friendly behavior that she hugged him back. From that day on, the rare lion and the little girl were inseparable. They spent every day together, exploring the forest and cuddling under the tree.
What a sweet, rare friendship between a lion and a little girl!

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily gets scared when she sees a hurricane coming while playing outside, but her mommy takes her inside where her deaf grandma is waiting and Lily feels safe and happy with her.
With: happy ending
response:
"Mommy, mommy! Look at the big wind!" Lily said.
"I see it, sweetie. Let's go inside where it's safe," her mommy replied.
As they went inside, Lily saw her deaf grandma sitting in her chair. "Grandma, did you see the big wind outside?" Lily asked.
"No, dear. I can't hear it, but I can see the trees moving. Are you okay?" her grandma signed back.
Lily smiled and hugged her grandma. "I'm okay now. I'm happy to be inside with you."

instruction:
Write a story about: Two bunnies find berries under a tree. One bunny gets angry when the other suggests they share, but they end up eating the berries together and going home happy.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there were two little bunnies. One was very angry. The other was not.
Every day, they would eat together in the sun. They ate carrots, lettuce and grass.
One day they went to explore under a big tree. There they found lots of yummy berries.
The angry bunny wanted to eat all the berries, but the other bunny said no. This made the angry bunny more angry.
But the other bunny took the angry bunny's hand and said, "Let's eat the berries together." 
The angry bunny calmed down and they happily ate all the berries together. Then they went home in the sun.
Summary: Two bunnies find berries under a tree. One bunny gets angry when the other suggests they share, but they end up eating the berries together and going home happy.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy loved playing in his backyard until his friend came over and kept slapping him until he fell and hit his head on a rock, resulting in his death.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Timmy's friend came over to play. His friend was not nice, and he liked to slap Timmy. Timmy did not like this, but he did not know what to do. His friend kept slapping him and Timmy did not know how to make him stop.
Timmy's friend kept slapping him until Timmy fell down and hit his head on a rock. Timmy's parents came outside and found him lying on the ground. They took him to the hospital, but it was too late. Timmy had died from his injuries. It was a very sad day for Timmy's family and friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy breaks his favorite toy car and feels ashamed, but his mommy comforts him and helps him fix it, making him feel loved and happy.
With: happy ending
response:
His mommy saw that Timmy was sad and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her about his broken toy car and how he felt ashamed. His mommy hugged him and told him it was okay to make mistakes and that she still loved him.
Timmy's frown turned into a smile and he felt better. His mommy helped him fix his toy car and they played together until it was time for bed. Timmy went to sleep feeling happy and loved.

instruction:
Write a story about: Nina sees a rainbow, gets caught in the rain, but remains happy because she saw something beautiful and wanted to share her experience with others.
With: happy ending
response:
Nina was feeling excited. She could see something shiny in the sky. It was a beautiful rainbow! She shouted "It's so pretty!"
Nina ran outside and started to jump and dance around in the grass. Then the wind blew and it started to rain. She went inside and shut the door.
Even though the rain was raining, Nina was still happy because she had seen the rainbow. She wanted to tell everyone about it. She wanted to be honest and tell them what she had seen. 
When the rain stopped, Nina ran outside again. She stretched her arms to the sky, and shouted "I saw a rainbow!", and the wind blew again, like it was saying "I believe you". She smiled, happy that even the wind was being honest.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bossy girl and a little boy learn to share their toys by taking turns.
With: happy ending
response:
There were two friends yesterday. One was a bossy girl and the other was a little boy. The bossy girl wanted to own all the toys in their room so she yelled at the little boy. "You can't play with my toys, they all belong to me!"
But the little boy was very clever and came up with an idea. "We can take turns," he said, "If you own them one day, then I can own them for the next."
The bossy girl thought about this for a moment and then slowly smiled. She agreed and from then on they shared the toys. They had lots of fun playing together yesterday.

instruction:
Write a story about: A crew sets out on a new ship to find treasure, but a storm causes the ship to crash into a rock and break into pieces. The crew builds a new ship and sails back home, determined to never give up.
With: sad ending
response:
As they sailed, something bad happened. A big storm came and the ship was tossed and turned. The captain tried to steer the ship, but it was too strong. The ship crashed into a big rock and broke into many pieces. 
The crew was sad. One sailor said, "What will we do now? We have no ship and we are far from home." The captain said, "We will build a new ship and sail back home. We will never give up!" 
And so, the crew worked hard and built a new ship. It was not as big or shiny as the first ship, but it was strong and sturdy. They sailed back home and told everyone about their adventure. Even though something bad happened, they never gave up and built a new ship.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily's favorite rag gets accidentally washed away, teaching her to accept change and let go of things.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Lily's mom asked her to help with the laundry. Lily was happy to help, but when she picked up the laundry basket, she realized it was very heavy. She struggled to carry it to the washing machine. 
As Lily was putting the laundry in the machine, she accidentally dropped her rag in with the clothes. She tried to take it out, but it was too late. The washing machine started to change the rag. It got smaller and smaller until it disappeared completely. 
Lily was very sad. She cried and cried. Her mom tried to comfort her and told her that sometimes things change and we have to learn to let go. Lily learned that it's okay to be sad when things change, but we can't hold onto them forever.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily plants a bulb with her mom and watches it grow into a beautiful flower.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom came outside and asked her what she was doing. "I want to peek inside the bulb," said Lily. "Can we plant it and watch it grow?"
Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, let's plant it together!" They planted the bulb and watered it every day. Soon, a beautiful flower grew and Lily was very happy. She thanked her mom for helping her and they hugged each other tightly.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily finds a special herb called lavender and puts it under her pillow every night to help her sleep, but accidentally eats it one night and gets very sick. The moral of the story is to listen to your parents and not eat things that are not food.

response:
Her mom said, "That herb is called lavender. It can make you feel comfortable and help you sleep."
Lily loved the smell of lavender so much that she put it under her pillow every night. But one night, she accidentally ate the lavender instead of smelling it. She got very sick and had to go to the hospital.
The moral of the story is that we should always listen to our parents and not eat things that are not food.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily sees a comet in the sky and learns from her mom that it's made of ice and dust, but they can't go see it up close.
With: happy ending
response:
Her mom came outside and asked, "What are you looking at, Lily?" 
"I see a fancy comet!" Lily told her mom. 
Her mom smiled and said, "That's amazing! Did you know that comets are made of ice and dust?" 
Lily was surprised and asked, "Really? Can we go see the comet up close?" 
Her mom laughed and said, "No, we can't go see it up close. But we can keep looking at it from here." 
Lily was happy and said, "Okay, I will tell all my friends about the fancy comet tomorrow!"

instruction:
Write a story about: A naughty bunny named Smudge jumps over a fence to eat a bowl of delicious dessert, but gets caught by the angry gardener.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a naughty bunny called Smudge. He was always getting into trouble and causing mischief.
One day, Smudge hopped around his garden, looking for something fun to do. Suddenly, he heard some noise coming from the other side of the fence. He hopped and peeped through a gap to see what it was.
He saw a big bowl of yummy dessert. This made Smudge so excited because he loved desserts! He looked around and jumped over the fence.
He started eating the delicious dessert, but he didn't notice that the gardener was watching him. The gardener was very angry and shouted at Smudge.
Smudge hopped away and back to his garden. He knew he had been naughty, but it was still very exciting to try the delicious dessert.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily helps her mom clean up a spilled drink and learns the importance of being helpful.
With: happy ending
response:
Suddenly, she heard a loud noise coming from the house. Her mom was in trouble! Lily quickly ran inside to see what was going on. Her mom had accidentally spilled some water on the ancient carpet and it was starting to stain. Lily knew just what to do. She grabbed a towel and helped her mom clean up the mess.
After they were finished, Lily's mom thanked her for being such a helpful little girl. Lily smiled with pride, knowing that she had saved the ancient carpet from being ruined. From that day on, she made sure to always pour her drinks carefully and be ready to help whenever someone was in trouble.

instruction:
Write a story about: Sally's noisy toy box was replaced by her daddy with a new, quiet one, making her happy to put her toys away neatly.
With: happy ending
response:
As Sally was putting away her toys, she noticed that her toy box was very noisy. It was making a loud creaking sound every time she opened and closed it. Sally told her daddy about the noisy toy box and he said, "Don't worry Sally, I will design a new toy box for you that won't make any noise."
Sally was very excited to hear this and couldn't wait to see what her daddy would design. A few days later, her daddy surprised her with a brand new toy box. It was big and shiny and most importantly, it didn't make any noise! Sally was so happy and gave her daddy a big hug to say thank you. From that day on, Sally's toys were always neatly put away in her new, quiet toy box.
Summary: Sally's noisy toy box was replaced by her daddy with a new, quiet one, making her happy to put her toys away neatly.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily learns the importance of cooking with her mom and that even ordinary things can be special.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mom came into the room and asked her if she wanted to help make dinner. Lily said no because cooking seemed boring and ordinary. Her mom explained that cooking is important and that everyone needs to eat to be healthy. She also told Lily that sometimes things that seem ordinary can be very special.
Lily thought about what her mom said and realized that making dinner was important. She helped her mom and they made a delicious meal together. Lily learned that even though things might seem ordinary, they can still be important and special.
Summary: Lily learns the importance of cooking with her mom and that even ordinary things can be special.

instruction:
Write a story about: A powerful prince gathers his loyal subjects and asks them to bring bright strips of cloth to tie around his arms, believing it will make him even more powerful.
With: happy ending
response:
Once, there was a powerful prince who gathered all of his loyal subjects in the castle courtyard. He said, “I am lucky to have such loyal people by my side. Let us celebrate by gathering together bright strips of cloth!”
The subjects were very excited. They quickly ran and fetched the brightest strips of cloth they could find. After everyone had gathered enough strips, they started to tie the strips around the prince’s arms.
The prince smiled. “These strips will make me even more powerful,” he said.
All the subjects cheered and applauded. They were so proud of the powerful prince.
From that moment on, whenever the prince was to do something great and powerful, he wore his bright strips of cloth on his arms.
Summary: A powerful prince gathers his loyal subjects and asks them to bring bright strips of cloth to tie around his arms, believing it will make him even more powerful.

instruction:
Write a story about: A cat who likes to cook finds a hammer in the kitchen and tries to use it to cook, but ends up making a mess and getting hurt.
With: sad ending
response:
The cat wanted to use the hammer to cook. The cat hit the food with the hammer. The food went everywhere. The cat was sad.
The cat tried to clean up the mess. But the cat slipped on the food. The cat fell down and got a big boo-boo. The cat was very sad and cried. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: A sad giant in a dark forest is briefly comforted by a little girl's hug, but remains sad and alone when she leaves.

But then, the giant got sad again. He didn't want to be alone in the dark forest. The little girl had to go home. She said goodbye to the giant. The giant was sad and alone again. The end.
Summary: A sad giant in a dark forest is briefly comforted by a little girl's hug, but remains sad and alone when she leaves.

instruction:
Write a story about: Mary borrows soup from her friend Jack but forgets to return it, causing Jack to get angry and end their friendship.

response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mary. She had a friend called Jack. Jack was always so kind to Mary, so she asked if he would lend her his soup.
Jack said, "Yes, of course I will lend you my soup."  
So Mary was very happy and took Jack's soup. She went off and had a nice, quiet lunch.
But the next day, Mary forgot to take the soup back to Jack. She was feeling very quiet and sad. Mary didn't know what to do.
Then, Jack came over and asked Mary, "Where is my soup?" 
Mary felt so embarrassed, she didn't know how to answer.
Jack was very angry, and he said, "If you don't bring me back my soup right now, we won't be friends anymore!"
So that's what happened. Mary never got her soup back. She was very quiet and sad. She had lost her best friend.

instruction:
Write a story about: Anna and Tom try to move a heavy rock blocking their path to the park, but are unsuccessful. Anna's mom tells them they have to take an exam instead of playing in the park, leaving them sad and frustrated.
With: sad ending
response:
Anna's friend, Tom, came by and saw her trying to move the rock. He said, "I will help you, Anna!" Together, they tried to push the rock, but it still would not move. They felt sad and tired.
Anna's mom came outside and saw them. She said, "You can't play in the park today. It's time for your exam." Anna and Tom were sad because they did not want to take the exam. They wanted to play in the park. But the rock and the exam did not permit them to play. And so, they went inside, leaving the heavy rock behind, and had a bad day.
Summary: Anna and Tom try to move a heavy rock blocking their path to the park, but are unsuccessful. Anna's mom tells them they have to take an exam instead of playing in the park, leaving them sad and frustrated.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her mom saw a bunny in the park, and Lily learned about springtime. She then played with a boy and had a fun day.
With: happy ending
response:
Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, bunnies like to play in the springtime when the flowers bloom." 
Lily looked confused and asked, "What's a springtime?" 
"It's when the weather gets warmer and the flowers start to grow," her mom explained. 
Lily nodded and then saw a boy playing with a ball. She went up to him and asked, "Can I play too?" 
The boy just shrugged and said, "Sure." So, Lily happily played with the boy and had a fun day in the park.

instruction:
Write a story about: A reliable red car goes on a long trip but runs out of gas and breaks down, leaving its owner stranded far from home.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the car went on a long trip. It drove and drove, but it didn't stop to get gas. The gas ran out and the car stopped. The owner tried to start the car again, but it wouldn't go. 
The owner was very sad because they were far away from home. They had to stay in the car all night. In the morning, someone came to help them. But it was too late. The car was broken and couldn't be fixed. The owner had to leave the car behind and find another way to go home.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bear sets out to travel and reaches the top of a big hill where he meets another bear before continuing his journey.

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

response:

instruction:
Write a story about: Layla gives away flowers to her classmates and becomes popular at school by spreading happiness and kindness.

response:

Layla was very popular at school because she always had a big smile on her face.
One day, on the way to school, Layla stopped to gather flowers from a nearby garden.
Layla soon filled her arms with so many pretty, colourful flowers that she could barely hold them.

Layla decided to gather her courage and gave the flowers away. The other kids were so surprised and happy!
Layla soon realized that giving away the flowers had made her the most popular kid in school!
Moral of the story: Being kind to others is a great way to make friends and be popular. When you make someone else smile, you will feel great too!

instruction:

response:

instruction:

The car breaks. The wheels and lights fall off. The toy is ruined. Lily and Ben are sad and angry. They blame each other. They do not say sorry. They do not hug. They do not play together anymore. They sit in their room alone. They are not happy. The end.

instruction:

response:

The next day, Lily woke up feeling sick. Her mom took her to the doctor and they found out that Lily had not been eating enough healthy food. Lily realized that she should have eaten the potatoes and listened to her mom. She promised to always eat her veggies from then on.
Unfortunately, Lily's refusal to eat the potatoes had already caused damage to her body. She had to stay in the hospital for a few days to get better. From then on, Lily always ate her veggies and never refused them again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy accidentally hits a bird with a golf club and feels sad, but his dad comforts him and promises to get ice cream another day.

Timmy felt very sad and started to cry. His dad hugged him and said, "It's okay, accidents happen. Let's go home and have some ice cream." instruction:
Write a story about: A small animal finds an empty basket and makes it his home. The basket becomes his best friend and magically transforms into a friend too.

response:

The animal liked his basket so much he began to spend all of his time in it. Soon, it wasn't just a basket but also a special friend. The animal and the basket were best friends and always together.
One day, when the animal was feeling lonely, he asked his basket to become a friend. To his surprise, the basket magically began to change. Soon, it was no longer just a basket but a fine friend too!
Now the animal and his basket are the best of friends. They play together every day and have lots of fun. What started out as an ordinary basket had become something really special.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bad man steals a herb from a garden and kidnaps a little girl who tried to stop him. He is never found, and neither is the girl.

response:

The bad man was walking away from the garden, when he heard a small voice.
"Hey! Don't steal that herb!"
It was a little girl. The bad man was angry and he wanted to teach the girl a lesson. He grabbed her, and then he ran away with the herb.
The bad man ran far away with the little girl. He locked her up in a dark room and he kept the herb. Soon the little girl's family found out what happened.
They began searching everywhere for the bad man and the herb, but they never found them. The bad man and the fine herb were never seen again. The little girl was never seen again either.

instruction:

response:

instruction:
Write a story about: A pink bird with a big yellow beak wants to eat fruit from a tree, but a snake is guarding it. The bird asks for help from a strong and brave friend, and they are able to get the fruit and learn the lesson that it's okay to ask for help.

response:

The bird went to its friend and asked for help. The friend agreed to help and together they went to the tree. The friend struck the snake with a stick and the snake went away. The bird and its friend were able to eat the fruit and they were very happy. The moral of the story is that it's okay to ask for help when you need it.

response:

instruction:

instruction:
Write a story about: Grandma surprises the little girl with a basket full of interesting things and tells her that her love for her is the biggest surprise of all.

Inside, the little girl found lots of interesting things. She found a toy dog, a book, a hat and many colorful pieces of paper. She was very happy. 
Then Grandma said, “There is one more surprise in the basket.” The girl was very curious. Grandma gave her a big hug and said, “It’s my love for you!” The little girl smiled and hugged Grandma back.

instruction:

From that day on, Lily and the bear became good friends and played together in the forest every day. They had lots of fun and never felt clumsy again.

instruction:

One day her mom and dad finally said yes and she was very excited. They gave her a big, warm slice of pie. It was delicious! She ate all of it in no time.
But she wanted more. She asked if she could have another slice and her parents said no. She started to complain again and didn't stop. She yelled and shouted until her mom and dad said yes.
Again she was very happy, but it would be her last slice because her mom and dad finally had enough. They told her she was being too greedy and that she wouldn't be getting anymore pie. She kept on complaining, but to no avail. The little girl never got her warm, delicious pie again.

Then all of a sudden he saw a caterpillar. The caterpilllar was having trouble climbing up the hill. The pumpkin was so helpful that he stopped sliding, and he went over to help the caterpillar. The pumpkin pushed and pulled until the caterpillar reached the top.
With a smile, the caterpillar thanked the pumpkin. The pumpkin smiled too and said, "It's nice to help others!"
The pumpkin realized that helping others was the best way to have fun! He decided to use his helpfulness to help people and creatures in his neighborhood.

"It's some junk," said Jack. 
"Oh," replied Emma. "What should we do with it?"
Jack thought for a moment. "Let's be organized and put it in the trash," he said.

instruction:

response:

The people were very sad because they lost their new building and some of their friends. They learned that sometimes even reliable things can't match the power of nature.
Summary: A new tall and shiny building was built in a big city, but it fell down during a strong earthquake, causing sadness and injuries among the people.

instruction:
Write a story about: Betty meets a goblin named Eddy in the woods and they become friends, having many adventures together.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Betty. Betty was very curious. One day, she went to explore the woods by her house. 
Suddenly, she saw an open door. Betty peeked inside and saw something very weird. She stepped into the room and found a big, green goblin! It had yellow eyes and a funny little nose.
Betty was scared, but bravely said, "Hello! Who are you?"
The goblin said, "Hello! I'm Eddy. I'm the goblin of the woods. What's your name?"
"I'm Betty," the little girl said.
The two of them talked for a while and became friends. Every day, Betty would go to the woods to meet Eddy. They would tell each other stories and share snacks. 
Betty was very happy that she got to meet Eddy. They became the best of friends and had many more adventures together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Molly climbs a tall oak tree in the park and enjoys the view from the top before heading back home.
With: happy ending
response:
Molly was running fast. She was running so fast with her legs going quickly. She was speeding through the park. The tree in the park was an oak tree. It was big and tall, with thin leaves and a rough bark.
Molly was feeling brave today and decided to climb the oak tree. She used her little hands to grab the trunk and her feet to climb the tree. Her hands felt a little bit rough on the bark, but soon she was close to the top.
From the top of the tree, Molly looked around. Everything was so different from up so high. The colours were dull and the world seemed like a small place. Molly stayed up there far longer than she'd planned - it was so much fun being in the tree!
Suddenly, it was getting dark. Molly knew it was time to go home. She quickly climbed down and started speed walking back towards her house.

One day, when Claire was in her bedroom, she heard a strange noise coming from outside. She peeked out the window and saw a big dog barking! Claire was fearful of the dog, so she quickly jumped back from the window and hide behind her bed.
She was so scared, she forgot about the book she had been holding. Suddenly, the book started to bounce on the floor! Claire was so surprised she forgot to be scared. Instead, she jumped up and grabbed the book.
The scary dog was gone, and Claire finished her book in her bedroom. She was thankful that the book had bounced to remind her of the stories inside.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy learns the importance of sharing after his little sister eats all the cereal in the house.
With: happy ending
response:
Later that day, Timmy's mom asked him if he ate all the cereal in his favorite bowl. Timmy felt guilty because he had eaten all the cereal and didn't tell his mom. He asked his mom if she could buy more cereal so he could fill up his favorite bowl again. 
The next morning, Timmy woke up to find that his little sister had eaten all the cereal in the house. Timmy felt angry and sad because he couldn't eat cereal from his favorite bowl. He asked his sister why she ate all the cereal, but she didn't answer. Timmy realized that he should have shared his toys with his little sister, and maybe then she wouldn't have eaten all the cereal. From that day on, Timmy learned to share his toys and his cereal with his sister.

instruction:
Write a story about: Daisy and Dan make a film together but lose it due to a mistake made by Dan, leaving them sad and frustrated.
With: sad ending
response:
Daisy and Dan were two children who loved to play together. They were best friends and had lots of fun every day.
One day, Daisy and Dan decided to make a film. Dan was very excited but Daisy was a bit nervous. She asked Dan, "Are you sure we can do this?"
Dan smiled. He said, "Yes, we can do it."
So they began to work. Daisy and Dan worked all day until they finished their film. They were so proud of themselves. 
But then Dan made a mistake. He pressed the wrong button and all their hard work was lost! Daisy was very sad and very nervous. She said, "What are we going to do now?"
Dan just shook his head sadly. They could never make the film again. Daisy and Dan were sad and a bit mad at each other. Then they had to walk home with their heads down.
Summary: Daisy and Dan make a film together but lose it due to a mistake made by Dan, leaving them sad and frustrated.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tim plants a magic seed in his garden to make it fun, but it grows into a mean tree that makes the garden dark and scary.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Tim saw the sun rise. He had an idea! He could plant a magic seed in the garden. He thought it would grow into a fun tree. Tim dug a hole, put the seed in, and covered it up.
Days went by, and the seed did not grow. Tim was sad. He wanted his garden to be fun. One day, a big rain came. The rain made the seed grow into a big tree. But the tree was not fun. It was a mean tree. It made Tim's garden dark and scary. The end.
Summary: Tim plants a magic seed in his garden to make it fun, but it grows into a mean tree that makes the garden dark and scary.

instruction:
Write a story about: Rose's luggage disappears, but her grandpa brings it back to her and she is happy.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Rose. She had some luggage with her. The luggage was filled with all sorts of nice things.
But one day, Rose looked away and her luggage vanished! Rose was very surprised. She looked everywhere, but it was no-where to be seen.
Rose looked around in the quiet street, but the luggage had gone. She asked everyone she met if they had seen the luggage, but no-one had.
Rose was very sad and she walked home slowly. But when she got to her house, she saw something very strange. All her luggage was on the doorstep!
Rose rushed inside and there, sitting in his chair, was her grandpa. He had brought her luggage home for her. Rose was so happy and gave her grandpa a big hug!

instruction:
Write a story about: A bunny and a squirrel make a big pile of leaves with a rake, but a mean dog ruins it and they can't play in the leaves anymore.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, the bunny met a squirrel. The squirrel wanted to play too. The bunny said, "I recommend we use the rake to make a big pile of leaves." The squirrel liked the idea. They worked together to make a big pile of leaves.
But then, a mean dog saw the big pile of leaves. The dog wanted to play too. The dog jumped into the leaves. The leaves went everywhere. The bunny and the squirrel were sad. The mean dog messed up their big pile of leaves. The bunny and the squirrel could not play in the leaves anymore.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves drinking milk from her bottle before bed, but one night she found it empty. Her mommy quickly refilled it and from then on, always made sure to have a full bottle for Lily before bed.
With: happy ending
response:
Lily's mommy rushed to the kitchen to get more milk for her. She quickly filled up the bottle and brought it back to Lily. Lily was so happy and drank all the milk until the bottle was empty again.
From that day on, Lily's mommy made sure to always have a full bottle of milk for her before bedtime. And Lily was happy knowing she would never have an empty bottle again.

instruction:
Write a story about: A wise cat and a fast dog had a race, and the cat put soap on the ground to make the dog slip. However, the cat fell into a hole and the dog couldn't help, teaching them both a lesson about playing tricks on friends.
With: sad ending
response:
The wise cat put the soap on the ground where the fast dog would run. The race began, and the fast dog and wise cat ran as fast as they could. When the fast dog got to the soap, he slipped and fell. The wise cat kept running.
But the wise cat did not see the big hole in the ground. She fell into the hole and could not get out. The fast dog got up and tried to help the wise cat, but he could not. They were both very sad. The race had a bad ending, and they learned that it is not nice to play tricks on friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy finds an ancient box in the woods but doesn't open it because his mom tells him not to. His friend Billy opens it and releases a scary monster, which chases them and they both get hurt. Timmy learns the lesson of listening to grown-ups and not being naughty.
With: sad ending
response:
Timmy asked his mom if he could open the box. "No, Timmy," she said. "It's a mystery. We don't know what's inside."
Timmy was sad, but he listened to his mom. He didn't open the box. But one day, his friend Billy came over. Billy was naughty and didn't listen to Timmy's mom. He opened the box and found a scary monster inside.
The monster chased Billy and Timmy, and they both got hurt. Timmy learned that sometimes it's best to listen to grown-ups and not open mysteries. He also learned that being naughty can lead to bad things happening. In the end, Timmy and Billy both smiled again, but they were sad because they knew they had made a mistake.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tweety the bird and Flutter the butterfly get trapped in a cage after following a laser pointer, teaching the moral of being aware of surroundings and not following blindly.
With: sad ending
response:
"Hello, Tweety!" said Flutter. "Do you want to join me in playing tag?"
"Yes, please!" said Tweety excitedly. 
As they were playing, they saw a laser pointer shining on the ground. They both became curious and followed it. Suddenly, they got trapped in a cage. 
"Oh no! How do we get out?" cried Tweety. 
"I don't know," said Flutter sadly. "We should have been more careful."
The moral of the story is to always be aware of your surroundings and not to follow things blindly.
Summary: Tweety the bird and Flutter the butterfly get trapped in a cage after following a laser pointer, teaching the moral of being aware of surroundings and not following blindly.

instruction:
Write a story about: A band plays music near a river and gets caught in a flood, leading to their defeat.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a band. They liked to play music and wanted to win. One day they decided to go to the river and play near the water. 
The band was so loud that they didn't notice the rain clouds coming. Suddenly, it started to rain and the river began to rise. 
The band got wet and very scared. They began to run, but it was too late. The water surrounded them and they couldn't escape. The band was swept away, and they never won.

instruction:
Write a story about: A restless frog discovers a shiny pastel in his pond, but when he touches it, a monster is awakened and scares him away.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a restless frog. He was always hopping around, disturbing the peace of his pond. One day, he saw something shiny and colorful in the water. He hopped closer to investigate and discovered it was a pastel! 
The frog was so excited. He reached out and grabbed it. But, as soon as the frog touched the pastel, the most horrible sound filled the air. 
The frog was so scared that he hopped away as fast as he could. When he looked back, he saw a big monster in the water. The monster had been disturbed by the frog and was now very angry. 
The frog was so scared, he ran away and never came back. He never saw the pastel again and was never able to enjoy its beautiful colors.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and Timmy find a mystery box in the forest, open it together, and find a note reminding them to be kind to others.
With: happy ending
response:
Timmy said, "I don't know, Lily. It looks scary. What if there's something bad inside?"
Lily replied, "Don't worry, Timmy. We can solve the mystery together. And if it's too spicy, we can always share some water."
They opened the box and found a note that said, "Don't forget to be kind to others." Lily and Timmy realized that even though they were scared, they helped each other and found something important. From that day on, they always remembered to be kind to others.

instruction:
Write a story about: A truck driver goes on an adventure to the mountains and drives on ice, but learns to be careful when he hears the ice cracking.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, the driver decided to go on a trip to the mountains. He drove and drove until he saw something shiny in the distance. It was ice! 
The driver got very excited and decided to drive on the ice. He drove around and around, but then he heard a loud cracking noise. Oh no! The ice was breaking! 
The driver quickly drove his truck back to safety. He learned that it's important to be careful when driving on ice. From then on, he always made sure to check the ice before driving on it again.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily loves her old dress and doesn't want a new one, but when she tries on a new dress, it shrinks and becomes too small. She learns that sometimes the old things we have are the best.
With: happy ending
response:
Her mom replied, "But this new dress is very pretty. Why don't you try it on?"
Lily tried on the new dress and looked at herself in the mirror. She didn't like it and shrugged her shoulders. Suddenly, the dress started to shrink and became too small for her. Lily's mom was surprised and said, "Oh no! We must have picked the wrong size." 
Lily learned that it's not always about having the newest fashion or the fanciest things. Sometimes, the old things we have are the best. She hugged her old dress and said, "I love you just the way you are."

instruction:
Write a story about: A little bunny wants to go outside and play but his mum says no because it's raining. Later, when the rain slows down, he gets to go outside and play in the rain, but gets very wet and has to take a warm bath.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who wanted to go outside and have some fun. He asked his mum if he could go out but she said no, because it was raining. He was so sorry that he couldn't go out and play, so he stayed inside and played instead.
Afterwards, he heard the rain slowing down, so he got very excited and asked his mum if he could go out and play now. His mum said yes, so he quickly put on his coat and boots and ran outside.
The bunny was so happy that he could go out and play, he laughed and jumped around in the rain. He ran around until he got so wet that he was almost swimming, then he ran back inside. His mum smiled as he came in, and said "Time for a nice warm bath!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Lucy, a brave little girl, goes out alone and finds a pile of shiny stones. Despite feeling scared on her way back, she remembers her bravery and makes it home safely.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was so brave! Every day, she wanted to go out in the cold street.
One day, Lucy decided to go out alone. She stepped off the doorstep and into the cold street. She felt a bit scared but bravely set out.
Lucy walked up and down the street, looking for something special. All of a sudden, she spotted it! It was a pile of shiny stones.
Lucy picked them up and put them in her pocket. She was so excited! 
On her way back, she felt a bit scared again. Suddenly, a big dog started barking. She was very scared, but she remembered that she was brave. And, she did it! She reached home safely.
Lucy was so proud of herself. She had succeeded!

instruction:
Write a story about: Jack hates noise and decides to use a hammer to make his brother's loud radio go away, which makes his dad proud and unhappy at the same time.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a boy named Jack who didn't like noise. He hated it when his brother played the radio. It was too loud and it hurt his ears. He wanted to find a way to make the noise go away. 
One day he got an idea. He ran to his dad's tool box and grabed a hammer. He crawled up to the radio, and started hitting it with the hammer. The radio got quieter and quieter until it was silent.
Jack was so happy that he jumped up and down. He had made the noisy radio all better. Now it was nice and quiet. His dad came into the room and saw what Jack had done. He wasn't too happy about it, but he was proud of Jack for finding a way to fix the problem.
Summary: Jack hates noise and decides to use a hammer to make his brother's loud radio go away, which makes his dad proud and unhappy at the same time.

instruction:
Write a story about: Ann and her talking cat friend Tom discover a secret room full of delicious treats in the kitchen cupboard and share them with their friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Just then, her friend, the talking cat named Tom, came into the kitchen. Tom said, "Please, Ann, can I have a cookie?" Ann smiled and gave Tom a cookie. They both ate their cookies and thought they were very delicious.
Suddenly, they heard a noise from the cupboard. They opened it and found a tiny door. Ann and Tom looked at each other and decided to see what was behind the door. They opened it and found a secret room full of more delicious treats! They couldn't believe their eyes. Ann and Tom shared the treats with their friends and had the best day ever.
Summary: Ann and her talking cat friend Tom discover a secret room full of delicious treats in the kitchen cupboard and share them with their friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tom the cat mistakes the sun for meat and tries to catch it, but a bird named Tim tells him it's impossible. A lady sees them and gives them real meat to eat, and they become friends.
With: happy ending
response:
Tom said, "I want to catch that big meat in the sky." He jumped and jumped, but he could not catch it. A little bird named Tim saw Tom and asked, "What are you doing, Tom?"
Tom said, "I want to catch that big meat in the sky." Tim laughed and said, "That's not meat, Tom! That's the sun! It's too hot and too far away. You can't catch it."
Tom felt sad, but then something unexpected happened. A nice lady saw Tom and Tim and gave them some real meat to eat. Tom and Tim were happy and became good friends. They learned that they could not catch the sun, but they could still have fun and eat together.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy pushes a hedge in his backyard and it falls over, making a loud noise. His mom gets angry and Timmy learns a lesson about pushing things too hard.
With: sad ending
response:
The hedge didn't move, so Timmy pushed harder. Suddenly, the hedge fell over and made a loud noise. Timmy was scared and ran inside to tell his mom. His mom came outside and saw the hedge on the ground. She was very angry with Timmy for pushing the hedge.
Timmy felt sad and knew he shouldn't have pushed the hedge. He learned that sometimes things can break when we push them too hard. In the end, Timmy had to help his mom clean up the mess and he never pushed anything again.
Summary: Timmy pushes a hedge in his backyard and it falls over, making a loud noise. His mom gets angry and Timmy learns a lesson about pushing things too hard.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily becomes curious about a trophy she finds in her mom's room and is inspired to work hard and earn one of her own.
With: happy ending
response:
Her mom replied, "That's a trophy. It's something you get when you do a really good job at something." 
Lily was very interested and asked, "Can I get a trophy too?" 
Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, if you study hard and do your best, you can get a trophy too!" 
From that day on, Lily worked hard and studied every day. She wanted to get a trophy just like her mom. And one day, she did! She was so proud of herself and showed her trophy to everyone she knew.
Summary: Lily becomes curious about a trophy she finds in her mom's room and is inspired to work hard and earn one of her own.

instruction:
Write a story about: A bald man named Jack loved candy but couldn't find any at the store, so he tried to steal some and ended up getting arrested.
With: sad ending
response:
Once, there was a bald man named Jack. He loved candy, and ate it all day. One day, he went to the store to add more candy to his bag. But when Jack got to the store, he saw that the candy was all gone. He was so sad!
Jack asked the shopkeeper: "Where is all the candy?". The shopkeeper just shook his head.  "I'm sorry, there is no candy left," he said. All of the candy had been sold.
Jack was very angry. He tried to take some candy from the store, but the shopkeeper stopped him. He shouted and tried to get away, but the shopkeeper held him until the police came.
The police took Jack away to jail and he couldn't eat any candy ever again. That was the bad ending of Jack's story.

instruction:
Write a story about: A new animal comes to the zoo and is put in a small cage. It escapes, scares the other animals, attacks the zookeeper, and the zoo is closed.
With: sad ending
response: One day, the new animal got out of its cage. It roamed around the zoo and scared all the other animals. The zookeeper tried to catch it, but it was too fast. Finally, the new animal revealed itself and attacked the zookeeper. The other animals were scared and ran away. The new animal had to be put down and the zoo was closed.

instruction:
Write a story about: Tweetie, a little bird, helps a group of ants carry a big piece of bread and feels proud of herself for being helpful.
With: happy ending
response:
The ants were very busy carrying food to their home. Tweetie saw that they were struggling to carry a big piece of bread. So, Tweetie decided to help the ants by carrying the bread with her beak. The ants were very happy and grateful to Tweetie.
After helping the ants, Tweetie felt very proud of herself. She went to the dictionary to find out what "proud" meant. She learned that it means feeling good about doing something helpful. Tweetie realized that it feels good to help others and decided to always be helpful to her friends.

instruction:
Write a story about: A lonely bear finds a stick and takes it with him, feeling like he has a friend. He later meets a firefly who becomes his new friend and they play together every night, making the little bear happy and no longer lonely.
With: happy ending
response:
As he walked through the forest with his stick, he saw something glowing in the distance. It was a firefly! The little bear had never seen anything so beautiful. The firefly flew over to him and landed on his stick. The bear was so happy to have a new friend. 
From that day on, the little bear and the firefly would play together every night. They would run around and have so much fun. The little bear was never lonely again because he had a friend who made him glow with happiness.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little bird builds his own wings with hard work and determination, and learns that he must do things for himself in order to achieve his goals.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a stubborn little bird who wanted to build his own wings. It was very hard work and he worked all day long; he chopped, he hammered and he glued.
"Why do I have to build my own wings?" he asked.
A wise old owl said, "You must build your own wings if you want to fly. Nobody else can do it for you."
The little bird was scared, but determined, and worked even harder. Finally, after many days of work, he had built majestic wings for himself. He flapped them for the very first time, and he was flying!
He was so happy and shouted, "I did it! I built my own wings! I can fly!"

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy's shy parrot Polly becomes the life of the party after she joins in on a water fight and starts dancing.
With: happy ending
response:
One day, Timmy and his friends decided to play outside. They found a can of water and started to spray each other. Polly saw them having fun and wanted to join in. So, Timmy sprayed some water on her feathers and she started to dance.
Everyone was amazed to see Polly dancing and singing. They had never seen her come out of her hidden spot before. From that day on, Polly was the life of the party and never hid again. And Timmy and his friends had a new game to play - spraying water on Polly and watching her dance!

instruction:
Write a story about: A little oat wished to be different and became pink, which made his friends jealous and resulted in him being taken away by their wicked master, teaching a lesson about the cost of standing out.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a little oat who wanted to stand out. He wanted to be different and so he wished and wished for something special. He wanted something really really spectacular, and one day, his wish came true! He was now pink! He was so excited and couldn't wait to show off his new color.
So he trotted off to show all his friends. They admired him so much and were so jealous of his pinkness. Somehow, their envy turned into something bad, and they decided to lend him to their wicked master. The poor oat was taken away and put in a dark, damp prison, never to be seen again.
The little oat was a lesson to all voices who dared to be different. That sometimes, in order to stand out, you can pay too high a price.

instruction:
Write a story about: Jim, a boy who struggles to understand how things work, uses a fake heart to figure out how his toy car's engine works and feels proud of himself for solving the puzzle.
With: happy ending
response:
Once there was a boy named Jim. Jim was a good boy but he sometimes had trouble understanding how things worked. He loved playing with his toy car, but he could never sort out how the engine worked. 
One day, he had an idea. He went to the toy shop and asked for a fake heart. The shopkeeper handed him a plastic heart with a smile. 
Jim was so excited to take the heart home and try it out. He raced home, but when he opened the heart, nothing happened. He was so confused. 
"What do I do now?" he asked no one in particular. Then he noticed the strings and wires inside. He started sorting the wires and pulling on the strings. Suddenly, the toy car burst to life and Jim whooped with delight! 
He had figured out how to sort out the fake heart, and he felt really proud. He had solved the puzzle all by himself!

instruction:
Write a story about: Buzz the stubborn bee learns to listen to his friends and work together with them after crashing into a flower while trying to prove he could fly faster than any other bee.
With: happy ending
response:
Buzz flew as fast as he could, but he didn't notice a big flower in front of him. He bumped into it and fell down. Buzz's friends came to help him. They asked him if he was okay. Buzz felt embarrassed because he thought he was the best flyer. 
Buzz realized that he should listen to his friends. They knew what was best for him. From that day on, Buzz was not as stubborn. He thought it was better to work together with his friends. They all flew together and had fun.
Summary: Buzz the stubborn bee learns to listen to his friends and work together with them after crashing into a flower while trying to prove he could fly faster than any other bee.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily and her dog Max play outside despite the cold, get lost and can't find their way back home.
With: sad ending
response:
Lily put on her coat and went outside with Max. They played and played until it was dark. Max found a stick and Lily said, "Bring it here, Max!" Max ran and brought the stick to Lily. They were having so much fun.
But it was getting colder and colder. Lily started to shiver and feel very cold. She wanted to go back inside, but she could not find the way home. Lily and Max were lost. They walked and walked, but they could not find their house. Lily was very sad and cold. The evening turned into a bad night for Lily and Max.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy mixes different things in a scary grill and creates a delicious dish that becomes famous.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time, there was a wild grill. It was big and scary, and nobody wanted to go near it.
One day, a boy had an idea. He wanted to mix things to see what would happen. So he gathered many different things, such as leaves and water and nuts.
He carefully put them into the wild grill. Then he stirred them all around. He waited and waited to see what would happen.
Finally, he saw something delicious sizzling over the grill. He tasted it and it was so good that everyone wanted to try it. The boy smiled happily, and everyone laughed together.
That's how the boy made his famous mix that everybody loved. The End!
Summary: A boy mixes different things in a scary grill and creates a delicious dish that becomes famous.

instruction:
Write a story about: A big plane impresses kids with its high flying abilities, but ends up breaking when it goes too high and falls from the sky.
With: sad ending
response:
The plane said, "Look, kids! Watch me fly!" The kids looked up and were so happy. The plane went up, up, up into the sky. The kids clapped and laughed. They loved the big plane.
But then, something bad happened. The plane went too high and it broke. It fell down, down, down from the sky. The kids were sad. The big plane couldn't fly anymore. The end.

instruction:
Write a story about: John makes a special surprise for Louise's birthday with flowers and stones, and they celebrate together.
With: happy ending
response:
The two friends Louise and John were happy. It was finally Louise's birthday. Louise was very excited and she was wearing a beautiful new dress. 
John did not have a present so he decided to make something special. He collected some flowers and carefully arranged them in a circle. He filled the center with stones he had found in the garden. He wanted to make it look nice. 
When all was done, they put the presents inside the circle and settled down. Louise couldn't believe the beautiful surprise! She thanked John with a big hug and they enjoyed the rest of her birthday together.

instruction:
Write a story about: A mouse tries to climb a long pole but realizes he can't, so he makes a ladder out of thin sticks and successfully reaches the top to see the world.
With: happy ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a pole that was very long. It sat in the field all alone. One day, a mouse wanted to climb it. He rushed up the pole, but noticed he was not made for the task. He knew he had to surrender and come back down.
The mouse sadly looked at the pole and he was sad he could not see past the end. Then he had an idea. He ran back to a small stream, and collected some thin sticks. Using the sticks, he made a really long ladder, which was much longer than the pole.
He was so proud of himself and brought his ladder back to the pole. He climbed the ladder up and up, until eventually he reached the top. Up above he saw the whole wide world and the sun in the sky and he was so happy. He could finally see past the end of the pole and it was amazing.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy draws on his mom's new armchair without permission, causing it to be ruined, and learns that it's not okay to change things without permission.
With: sad ending
response:
But then, Timmy got an idea. He wanted to make the armchair even more special. So, he took some paint and started to draw on the armchair. He drew all over it, making it look different and original. 
When Timmy's mom saw what he had done, she was very angry. She scolded Timmy and sent him to his room. Timmy felt sad and wished he had never painted on the armchair. 
In the end, Timmy's mom had to throw away the armchair because it was ruined. Timmy learned that it's not okay to change things without permission, even if you want to make them better.

instruction:
Write a story about: A boy who loved poems forgets one and becomes so frustrated that he gives up looking at the sky to say poems.
With: sad ending
response:
Once upon a time there was a boy who really liked poems. He loved poems so much that he had learned lots of them by heart. Every day he liked to look at the sky and say a poem.
One day he looked up in the sky and forgot what the poem was. He felt so sad. He tried and tried, but he just couldn't remember it.
He asked his mom for help but she said there was nothing she could do. He was so frustrated he threw his soft toy rabbit across the room. 
The boy never found the poem he had forgotten. He was so sad and mad, he never looked at the sky again to say any poems.

instruction:
Write a story about: Lily helps her dad prepare burgers for dinner, but becomes impatient waiting for them to cook. She prays for them to cook faster and eventually enjoys a delicious meal with her family.
With: happy ending
response:
But the grill was taking a long time to cook the burgers. Lily was getting impatient and wanted to eat them right away. Her dad told her to be patient and wait a little longer. So, Lily decided to pray for the burgers to cook faster.
After a few more minutes, the burgers were finally ready! Lily and her family sat down to eat and they all said a prayer to thank God for the delicious food. Lily was very happy that she was patient and waited for the burgers to cook. She enjoyed her dinner and went to bed with a full tummy. The end.
Summary: Lily helps her dad prepare burgers for dinner, but becomes impatient waiting for them to cook. She prays for them to cook faster and eventually enjoys a delicious meal with her family.

instruction:
Write a story about: Timmy goes to the grocery store by himself and eats too many cookies, getting sick and having to stay in the hospital for a long time. He learns to listen to grown-ups and not overindulge.
With: sad ending
response:
One day, Timmy's mommy felt better and let him go to the grocery store by himself. Timmy felt so independent. He picked out his favorite cereal and some cookies. When he got home, he spread his cookies on the table and ate them all. 
Later that night, Timmy's tummy started to hurt. He had eaten too many cookies! His mommy took him to the hospital, but it was too late. Timmy had to stay in the hospital for a long time because he had gotten very sick. Timmy learned that it's important to listen to grown-ups and not eat too many cookies.
Summary: Timmy goes to the grocery store by himself and eats too many cookies, getting sick and having to stay in the hospital for a long time. He learns to listen to grown-ups and not overindulge.

instruction:
Write a story about: A little boat meets a girl by the water and they become friends, playing together and having fun before saying goodbye.
With: happy ending
response:
